senses.meaning_zh: 达尔拉迪超群的；与该套主要形成于新元古代并延续至寒武纪的岩层有关的
senses.meaning_en: Relating to the Dalradian Supergroup, a succession chiefly of Neoproterozoic to Cambrian age.
senses.english_definition: Dalradian rocks belong to a large succession of ancient rocks found in Scotland and Ireland that were later changed by heat and pressure.
senses.collocation_en: Dalradian rocks; Dalradian Supergroup
senses.collocation_zh: 达尔拉迪岩层；达尔拉迪超群
senses.sentence_en: The team mapped Dalradian rocks exposed along the coast.
senses.sentence_zh: 研究小组对沿海出露的达尔拉迪岩层进行了地质填图。

senses.meaning_zh: 达尔拉迪超群；达尔拉迪岩系（通常与 the 连用）
senses.meaning_en: The Dalradian Supergroup or its rocks, usually used with the.
senses.english_definition: The Dalradian is a thick succession of ancient, largely metamorphosed rocks extending through parts of Scotland and Ireland.
senses.collocation_en: the Scottish Dalradian; the upper Dalradian
senses.collocation_zh: 苏格兰的达尔拉迪岩系；达尔拉迪岩系上部
senses.sentence_en: The Dalradian preserves evidence of ancient sedimentation and later mountain building.
senses.sentence_zh: 达尔拉迪岩系保存着古代沉积作用及后来造山作用的证据。

etymology_story.zh: 地质学家 Archibald Geikie 于1891年采用 Dalradian 一名，取自古代盖尔王国 Dalriada（Dál Riata）。这一地名转为地质名称，用来统称苏格兰和爱尔兰的一套古老变质岩。[来源：Geikie 原文](https://www.e-rara.ch/download/pdf/29876362.pdf)
etymology_story.en: Geologist Archibald Geikie introduced Dalradian in 1891, adapting the name of the ancient Gaelic kingdom Dalriada, or Dál Riata. The geographical name became a geological designation for ancient metamorphic rocks in Scotland and Ireland. [Source: Geikie's original account](https://www.e-rara.ch/download/pdf/29876362.pdf)

morphology_enriched.zh: 可分析为专名词干 Dalrad-（由 Dalriada 调整而来）+ -ian“属于……的”→ Dalradian；名词用法表示相应岩层整体。相关形式包括地名 Dalriada、历史名称 Dál Riata，以及指该古王国或其居民的 Dalriadan；Dalriadan 不是地质名称 Dalradian 的可随意替换形式。地质搭配 Dalradian Supergroup 意为“达尔拉迪超群”。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation can be analyzed as the adapted proper-name stem Dalrad-, from Dalriada, + -ian, meaning relating to; the noun denotes the rock succession collectively. Related forms include Dalriada, Dál Riata, and Dalriadan, which refers to the historical kingdom or its inhabitants and is not freely interchangeable with the geological term Dalradian. Dalradian Supergroup is the formal geological combination.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Dalradian Supergroup（达尔拉迪超群）是其地质名词用法的正式全称；Dalradian succession（达尔拉迪岩层序列）强调地层先后关系。Precambrian（前寒武纪的）范围更广，且不能完整涵盖延续至寒武纪的部分，因此不是严格近义词。[来源：英国地质调查局](https://earthwise.bgs.ac.uk/index.php/Geology_of_the_Aberfoyle_district%3A_Neoproterozoic_to_Cambrian%3A_Dalradian_supergroup)
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Dalradian Supergroup is the formal expanded equivalent of the geological noun; Dalradian succession emphasizes the sequence of strata. Precambrian is broader and excludes the Cambrian portion, so it is not an exact synonym. [Source: British Geological Survey](https://earthwise.bgs.ac.uk/index.php/Geology_of_the_Aberfoyle_district%3A_Neoproterozoic_to_Cambrian%3A_Dalradian_supergroup)

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 古地名 Dalriada +“属于……的”→ 以该地区命名的古老岩层。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Dalriada + relating to → ancient rocks named after the historical region.

forms: 比较程度用 more / most rumbustious。
family: rumbustiously 喧闹地；rumbustiousness 喧闹活跃。

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆；rumbustious + -ly → rumbustiously（喧闹地）。

etymology.text: 英语 robustious 后来变成 rumbustious，保留了“精力十足、闹腾”的意味。可以想象一群活力旺盛、闹个不停的孩子。

usage_note: 主要用于英式英语。可形容孩子、聚会或辩论，强调活跃而喧闹，不必然含有恶意。

teaching.contrast: rumbustious 兼有活力和喧闹；quiet 则强调安静。它不等于一定危险或暴力。

teaching.translation: 一场热闹的辩论让议事厅充满了笑声和喊声。

senses.meaning_zh: 喧闹而精力旺盛的；闹腾的（主要用于英式英语）
senses.meaning_en: Noisy, energetic, and sometimes difficult to control; chiefly British.
senses.english_definition: Someone or something that is rumbustious is full of lively energy and makes a lot of noise.
senses.collocation_en: rumbustious children; a rumbustious debate
senses.collocation_zh: 闹腾的孩子们；热烈喧闹的辩论
senses.sentence_en: The rumbustious children turned the quiet garden into a noisy playground.
senses.sentence_zh: 精力旺盛、闹个不停的孩子们把安静的花园变成了喧闹的游乐场。

etymology_story.zh: 该词出现于18世纪，通常被认为是 robustious“强健而粗豪的”的变体，不过具体形成过程并不完全确定。它保留了旺盛精力的意味，并突出喧闹、闹腾的行为。[来源：柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/rumbustious)
etymology_story.en: The word appeared in the eighteenth century and is usually treated as an alteration of robustious, meaning robust or boisterous, although its precise formation is uncertain. It retains the idea of vigorous energy while emphasizing noisy, exuberant behavior. [Source: Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/rumbustious)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜把 rumbustious 作为完整形容词词基记忆，不应把 rum 或 bust 当作意义确定的构词成分。派生式：rumbustious + -ly → rumbustiously“喧闹地”；rumbustious + -ness → rumbustiousness“喧闹、闹腾”。比较形式为 more rumbustious、most rumbustious。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, rumbustious is best learned as a whole adjective base; rum and bust should not be assigned definite component meanings. Derivatives are rumbustious + -ly → rumbustiously, meaning in a noisy, energetic manner, and rumbustious + -ness → rumbustiousness, meaning noisy exuberance. Its comparative forms are more rumbustious and most rumbustious.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: boisterous（喧闹活泼的）最接近，强调声音大、动作多；rambunctious（闹腾难管的）是常见的美式对应词；unruly（不守规矩的）更突出难以管束，通常比 rumbustious 更带批评意味。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Boisterous is the closest general synonym and stresses noisy activity; rambunctious is a common American equivalent; unruly emphasizes resistance to control and is usually more critical than rumbustious.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“精力旺盛得闹出声”：有活力，也有响动。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture energy spilling over into noise: lively enough to become boisterous.

etymology.text: 来自英语方言 spiff，原来指衣着花哨的人，后来变成 spiv，常让人联想到穿着光鲜、靠小聪明谋生的投机客。

usage_note: 英国非正式用语，带贬义；常见于描写黑市交易或旧时社会生活的文字，不宜当作普通商人的中性称呼。

senses.meaning_zh: 靠不正当交易谋生的投机客；黑市贩子（英国非正式用语，贬义）
senses.meaning_en: A person who makes a living through shady dealings, especially black-market trading; British, informal, and disapproving.
senses.english_definition: A spiv is someone who makes money through dishonest or illegal deals, often while appearing stylish and confident.
senses.collocation_en: a wartime spiv; a City spiv
senses.collocation_zh: 战时黑市贩子；伦敦金融城里靠不正当交易牟利的人
senses.sentence_en: The film follows a wartime spiv who sells scarce goods on the black market.
senses.sentence_zh: 这部电影讲述了一名战时投机客在黑市出售紧缺商品的故事。

etymology_story.zh: 词源尚不确定，可能与表示衣着光鲜的方言词 spiving 或 spiff 有关。它在第二次世界大战及战后英国尤其引人注目，常指穿着体面、从事黑市交易的小骗子。[来源：柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/spiv)、[在线词源词典](https://www.etymonline.com/word/spiv)
etymology_story.en: Its origin is uncertain, with proposed connections to dialect spiving or spiff, associated with smart dress. The word became especially prominent in wartime and postwar Britain for a flashily dressed petty crook involved in black-market trading. [Sources: Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/spiv), [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/spiv)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 spiv 是不可进一步拆分的词基，复数为 spivs。派生式：spiv + -y → spivvy“投机客似的、衣着浮华而可疑的”；spiv + -ery → spivvery“投机诈骗行为”，另见变体 spivery。前两种常用派生拼写均双写 v；spivish、spivvish“投机客似的”较罕见。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern spiv is an unanalyzable base, with the plural spivs. Derivatives include spiv + -y → spivvy, meaning characteristic of a spiv or flashily disreputable, and spiv + -ery → spivvery, meaning shady dealing, also spelled spivery. The usual spellings spivvy and spivvery double v; spivish and spivvish, meaning characteristic of a spiv, are rarer.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: black marketeer（黑市贩子）专指非法市场交易者；swindler（诈骗者）强调通过欺骗夺取钱财；wide boy（靠小聪明钻营的家伙，英国非正式用语）强调机灵、油滑和可疑生意。spiv 常兼有衣着光鲜、游手好闲和小规模非法交易的形象。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Black marketeer specifically denotes someone trading in an illegal market; swindler emphasizes obtaining money by deception; wide boy is British informal language for a streetwise, slick operator involved in dubious business. Spiv often adds the image of flashy dress, avoidance of regular work, and small-time illegal trading.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住“衣着光鲜，生意不干净”的英国投机客形象。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a flashy dresser making a living through shady deals.

senses.sentence_en: The story follows a het couple and their closest friends.
senses.sentence_zh: 这个故事围绕一对异性恋伴侣及其最亲密的朋友展开。

senses.pos: adj. 形容词（主要用于 het up；非正式）
senses.meaning_zh: 激动的；烦躁的；恼火的
senses.meaning_en: Agitated, upset, or excited, especially in the expression het up.
senses.english_definition: If someone gets het up about something, they become very worried, angry, or excited about it.
senses.collocation_en: get het up; het up about something
senses.collocation_zh: 变得激动或烦躁；为某事激动或恼火
senses.sentence_en: Don't get so het up about a small mistake.
senses.sentence_zh: 别为一个小错误这么恼火。

etymology_story.zh: 表示“异性恋”的 het 是 heterosexual 的非正式截短形式；heterosexual 中的 hetero- 最终来自希腊语，意为“不同的、另一种的”。het up 中的 het 则来自 heat 的旧式或方言过去式、过去分词形式，与性取向义没有词源关系。
etymology_story.en: Het meaning “heterosexual” is an informal clipping of heterosexual, whose element hetero- ultimately comes from Greek meaning “different” or “other.” The het in het up comes instead from an older or dialectal past form of heat and is etymologically separate from the sexuality-related word.

morphology_enriched.zh: 异性恋义：heterosexual → het，属于截短构词，现代 het 本身不再拆分；名词复数为 hets。相关词族包括 hetero（非正式截短词）、heterosexual（异性恋的；异性恋者）、heterosexuality（异性恋倾向）、heterosexually（以异性恋方式）；het up 是另一个来源的固定表达。
morphology_enriched.en: Sexuality-related formation: heterosexual → het by clipping; modern het is not further segmented. Its noun plural is hets. Related forms include hetero, heterosexual, heterosexuality, and heterosexually. Het up is a fixed expression with a separate origin.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: heterosexual（异性恋的／异性恋者）中性且较正式；straight（异性恋的／异性恋者）在日常交流中更常见；het 更像特定社群或讨论语境中的简略说法。het up 的近义表达是 worked up，表示情绪激动，与上述性取向义无关。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Heterosexual is neutral and relatively formal; straight is more usual in everyday conversation; het is a shortened form associated with particular communities or discussions. For the separate expression het up, worked up is a close equivalent meaning emotionally agitated.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: heterosexual 截短成 het，词变短，异性恋含义保留；het up 则联想情绪“热起来”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Shorten heterosexual to het while keeping its meaning; separately, picture emotions heating up to remember het up.

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 比较级 peakier；最高级 peakiest。
family: peakily 憔悴地；peakiness 憔悴、虚弱的样子。

morphology.text: peak(ed)（消瘦憔悴的）+ -y → peaky（显得虚弱的）；peaky + -ness → peakiness（憔悴），y 变 i。整词作为独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语把表示憔悴的 peaked 与形容词后缀 -y 联系起来，形成 peaky。记住的是病后没精神的脸色，不是山峰的高度。

usage_note: 主要见于英式非正式表达，常说 look a bit peaky。描述外观或感觉，不是疾病诊断。
sentence: You look peaky after that sleepless night.
translation: 一夜没睡后，你看起来脸色苍白、很虚弱。
scenario: 早晨见面：朋友注意到你熬夜后气色不佳。
cloze: You look _____ after that sleepless night.
collocation:
look peaky after the flu 流感后显得憔悴（病后恢复）
a peaky passenger on a ferry 渡轮上脸色苍白的乘客（出行）
context_hint: Notice the effect of a night without sleep.

teaching.contrast: peaky 强调虚弱、憔悴的状态；sleepy 主要表示想睡，两者不完全相同。
teaching.sentence: The peaky passenger asked for some fresh air on the ferry.
teaching.translation: 那位脸色苍白的乘客在渡轮上想透透气。

senses.pos: adj. 形容词（主要为英式非正式用法）
senses.meaning_zh: 脸色不佳的；显得虚弱或不舒服的
senses.meaning_en: Looking pale, weak, or slightly ill.
senses.english_definition: If someone looks peaky, they look pale or tired, as if they are not feeling well.
senses.collocation_en: look peaky; feel a bit peaky
senses.collocation_zh: 看起来气色不好；觉得有点不舒服
senses.sentence_en: You look a bit peaky—perhaps you should get some rest.
senses.sentence_zh: 你看起来气色不太好，也许该休息一下。

senses.meaning_zh: 峰值突出的；输出或需求集中在狭窄范围内的
senses.meaning_en: Having pronounced peaks or concentrating output or demand within a narrow range.
senses.english_definition: Something is peaky if its level rises sharply in a limited range, such as an engine that produces most of its power within a narrow band of speeds.
senses.collocation_en: a peaky engine; peaky demand
senses.collocation_zh: 动力集中在狭窄转速区间的发动机；峰值集中的需求
senses.sentence_en: The engine is peaky, so it needs high revs to deliver its best performance.
senses.sentence_zh: 这台发动机的动力集中在较窄的转速区间，因此需要高转速才能发挥最佳性能。

etymology_story.zh: 表示“憔悴”的 peaky 与 peak 表示“消瘦、衰弱”的旧动词用法及形容词 peaked 有关，不能简单理解成“山峰很高”。技术语境中的 peaky 则直接利用 peak“峰、峰值”的含义，表示曲线或输出有明显尖峰。
etymology_story.en: Peaky meaning “sickly-looking” is related to the older verb peak meaning “grow thin or weak” and to peaked. Its technical meaning draws directly on peak as a high point, describing sharply concentrated levels or output.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代可分析为 peak + -y（具有某种特征的），但“憔悴”义需要结合 peak 的旧义理解。屈折形式：peakier、peakiest；派生词：peakiness（憔悴；峰值突出程度）、peakily（罕见副词）；相关词有 peak、peaked、peaking，其中 peaked 的发音随含义而变化。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: peak + -y, meaning “characterized by,” although the sickly sense depends on an older meaning of peak. Inflected forms are peakier and peakiest; derivatives include peakiness and the rare adverb peakily. Related forms include peak, peaked, and peaking; peaked has different pronunciations in different uses.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pale（苍白的）主要描述颜色；wan（苍白憔悴的）兼含疲惫或病弱，语体较书面；sickly（病弱的）可描述长期体弱。peaky 通常是较口语化地说某人眼下显得不舒服；技术义则接近 sharply peaked“峰值尖锐的”。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pale mainly describes colour; wan suggests pallor together with tiredness or illness and is more literary; sickly can suggest persistent poor health. Peaky is usually an informal description of someone looking temporarily unwell. Its technical sense is close to sharply peaked.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 人物 peaky：脸瘦、没精神；曲线 peaky：尖峰明显。先看修饰的是人还是数据。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A peaky person looks drawn and unwell; a peaky curve has sharp peaks. Let the thing being described select the meaning.

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 技术性形容词，不作常规比较级变化；常用于复合词。
family: oxyhemoglobin 氧合血红蛋白；oxygen 氧。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；oxy（与氧有关）+ hemoglobin（血红蛋白）→ oxyhemoglobin（氧合血红蛋白）。

etymology.text: 来自法语 oxygène（氧）的短形式 oxy，进入英语后用来表示“含氧的”。看到 oxy，就联想到氧参与其中。

usage_note: 技术用语，常与其他词组合，如 oxyhemoglobin。本卡只教“含氧的”这一形容词义，不教其他同形缩略称呼。
sentence: The chemist described the substance as an oxy compound because it contained oxygen.
translation: 化学家称这种物质为含氧化合物，因为它含有氧。
scenario: 实验室：按是否含氧对化合物作描述。
cloze: The chemist described the substance as an _____ compound because it contained oxygen.
collocation:
an oxy compound 含氧化合物（化学分类）
oxy fuel for an engine 发动机用含氧燃料（动力试验）
context_hint: The substance contains oxygen.

teaching.contrast: oxy 表示含氧；oxygen-free 表示不含氧，方向相反。
teaching.sentence: The engineer selected an oxy fuel with added oxygen for the engine test.
teaching.translation: 工程师为发动机试验选择了一种额外含氧的燃料。

comprehension_check.sentence: The chemist described the substance as an oxy compound because it contained oxygen.
comprehension_check.question: 句中目标词表示哪一种意思？
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: 句子直接说明物质含有氧，所以 oxy 表示含氧，而非不含氧。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（含氧的／不含氧的）
fields.wrong_reason: 句子直接说明物质含有氧，所以 oxy 表示含氧，而非不含氧。

senses.meaning_zh: 羟考酮；含羟考酮的药片
senses.meaning_en: Oxycodone or a tablet containing it.
senses.english_definition: Oxy is an informal name for oxycodone, an opioid medicine used to treat pain, or for a tablet containing it.
senses.collocation_en: take oxy; oxy pills
senses.collocation_zh: 服用羟考酮；羟考酮药片
senses.sentence_en: In the interview, he used the word oxy to refer to oxycodone.
senses.sentence_zh: 采访中，他用 oxy 这个词指代羟考酮。

senses.pos: combining form 构词成分（写作 oxy-；化学及技术用语）
senses.meaning_zh: 表示“氧的、含氧的、与氧结合的”
senses.meaning_en: Indicating oxygen, combination with oxygen, or the use of oxygen.
senses.english_definition: In technical words, oxy- indicates that oxygen is present, combined with another substance, or used in a process.
senses.collocation_en: oxy-fuel combustion; oxyacetylene welding
senses.collocation_zh: 氧燃料燃烧；氧乙炔焊接
senses.sentence_en: Oxy-fuel combustion uses oxygen instead of air to burn the fuel.
senses.sentence_zh: 氧燃料燃烧使用氧气代替空气来燃烧燃料。

senses.pos: combining form 构词成分（写作 oxy-；学术用语）
senses.meaning_zh: 表示“尖的、锐的、酸的”
senses.meaning_en: Indicating sharpness, pointedness, or acidity.
senses.english_definition: In some learned words, oxy- carries the older Greek meaning of sharp, pointed, or acid.
senses.collocation_en: an oxytone word; an oxymoron
senses.collocation_zh: 末音节重读的词；矛盾修辞
senses.sentence_en: In oxymoron, oxy- carries the Greek idea of sharpness.
senses.sentence_zh: 在 oxymoron 一词中，oxy- 保留了希腊语中“锐利”的含义。

etymology_story.zh: 较古老的 oxy- 来自希腊语 oxys，意为“尖锐的、酸的”；氧相关用法经法语 oxygène 发展而来，该名称原意为“成酸者”，反映了早期认为氧是所有酸必要成分的错误认识。独立俚语名词 oxy 则是 oxycodone 等药名的截短形式，不宜把它的一切用法都解释成独立形容词“含氧的”。
etymology_story.en: The older combining form oxy- comes from Greek oxys, meaning “sharp” or “acid”; its oxygen-related use developed through French oxygène, originally “acid-former,” a name based on an early mistaken theory about acids. The independent slang noun oxy is a clipping of drug names such as oxycodone, rather than a general standalone adjective meaning “oxygen-containing.”

morphology_enriched.zh: 独立名词：oxycodone → oxy，属于截短构词。构词成分：oxy- + haemoglobin/hemoglobin → oxyhaemoglobin/oxyhemoglobin（氧合血红蛋白）；oxy- + acetylene → oxyacetylene（氧乙炔的）；oxy- + tone → oxytone（末音节重读的词）。oxygen（氧）、oxygenate（使充氧）、oxygenation（充氧）是相关历史词族，不是俚语名词 oxy 的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Independent noun: oxycodone → oxy by clipping. Combining-form constructions include oxy- + haemoglobin/hemoglobin → oxyhaemoglobin/oxyhemoglobin, oxy- + acetylene → oxyacetylene, and oxy- + tone → oxytone. Oxygen, oxygenate, and oxygenation belong to the related historical family; they are not derivatives of the slang noun oxy.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 药物义中，oxycodone（羟考酮）是准确通用名；OxyContin（奥施康定）是特定缓释制剂的商品名，不能与所有羟考酮制剂完全互换。氧相关语境中，oxygen-containing 表示含氧，oxygenated 表示已充氧或已与氧结合，不能在所有复合词中机械替换 oxy-。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the drug sense, oxycodone is the precise generic name; OxyContin is a brand of an extended-release formulation and is not interchangeable with every oxycodone product. In oxygen-related contexts, oxygen-containing describes composition, while oxygenated describes oxygen being supplied or bound; neither mechanically replaces oxy- in every compound.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 独立 oxy 常指药物；连写 oxy- 先查“氧”，再留意希腊语“尖、酸”的旧义。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Standalone oxy often names the drug; attached oxy- usually points to oxygen, but some learned words preserve the older idea of sharpness or acidity.

meaning: 扫兴的人（常用于 party pooper）

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 可数名词；复数 poopers。
family: party pooper 扫兴的人；poop 是其构词相关动词。

morphology.text: poop + -er（做某事的人）→ pooper；party + pooper → party pooper（聚会中扫兴的人）。整词作为独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语用 poop 加表示人的 -er 形成 pooper，并在 party pooper 这一俚语中指不肯一起尽兴的人。把“聚会中的扫兴者”作为一个场景来记。

usage_note: 非正式用语，通常与 party 连用。带取笑或轻微责备语气；他人拒绝活动也可能有合理原因。

teaching.contrast: party pooper 是让人扫兴的人；host 是主持或招待活动的人，不代表一定扫兴。
teaching.sentence: I hate to be a party pooper, but the camping trip is cancelled.
teaching.translation: 我不想扫大家的兴，不过露营之旅取消了。

comprehension_check.wrong_reason: 丹不肯加入游戏，pooper 指扫兴者，而不是带动气氛的人。

fields.wrong_reason: 丹不肯加入游戏，pooper 指扫兴者，而不是带动气氛的人。

senses.pos: n. 名词（非正式；主要用于 party pooper）
senses.meaning_zh: 扫兴的人；不愿参与欢乐活动的人
senses.meaning_en: Someone who spoils other people's enjoyment or refuses to join the fun.
senses.english_definition: A party pooper is someone who spoils other people's fun, often by refusing to take part in what they are enjoying.
senses.collocation_en: a party pooper; be a party pooper
senses.collocation_zh: 扫兴的人；做扫兴的人
senses.sentence_en: I hate to be a party pooper, but we need to leave soon.
senses.sentence_zh: 我也不想扫大家的兴，但我们得马上走了。

senses.meaning_zh: 排便的人或动物
senses.meaning_en: A person or animal that defecates.
senses.english_definition: A pooper is a person or animal that poops; the word is informal and often humorous.
senses.collocation_en: a serial pooper; a pooper-scooper
senses.collocation_zh: 反复随地排便的人或动物；宠物粪便清理器
senses.sentence_en: The puppy is a frequent pooper, so we take him outside regularly.
senses.sentence_zh: 这只小狗排便很频繁，所以我们会定时带它出去。

senses.meaning_zh: 肛门；屁股
senses.meaning_en: The anus or, loosely, the bottom.
senses.english_definition: Someone's pooper is their anus or bottom; this is a vulgar slang expression.
senses.collocation_en: on the pooper; in the pooper
senses.collocation_zh: 在屁股上；在肛门里
senses.sentence_en: He used pooper as a crude word for the anus.
senses.sentence_zh: 他用 pooper 这个粗俗说法指代肛门。

etymology_story.zh: Pooper 由 poop 加 -er 构成，字面上可以指排便者；俚语还把它用来指排便的身体部位。party pooper 在二十世纪中叶已见使用，其“扫兴者”义常与 poop“使疲惫、耗尽精力”的用法联系起来，不宜直接编成“排便所以扫兴”的词源故事。
etymology_story.en: Pooper is formed from poop and -er and can literally name someone or something that defecates; slang also applies it to the relevant body part. Party pooper was established by the mid-twentieth century, and its killjoy meaning is often connected with poop meaning “exhaust,” rather than a literal story about defecation.

morphology_enriched.zh: poop + -er → pooper；复数 poopers。复合词包括 party pooper（扫兴者）、pooper-scooper（宠物粪便清理器）；相关词族包括 poop、poops、pooped、pooping，以及 party-pooping（扫兴的）。-er 通常表示行为者，但 pooper 的身体部位义属于俚语扩展。
morphology_enriched.en: Poop + -er → pooper; plural poopers. Compounds include party pooper and pooper-scooper. Related forms include poop, poops, pooped, pooping, and party-pooping. Although -er normally marks a doer, the body-part sense is a slang extension.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: killjoy（扫兴者）强调破坏别人的快乐；spoilsport（扫兴的人）常指不肯配合游戏或共同活动的人；wet blanket（令人扫兴的人）强调冷淡或消极态度使气氛降温。这些词只对应 party pooper 的扫兴义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Killjoy emphasizes spoiling other people's pleasure; spoilsport often describes someone who will not cooperate in a game or shared activity; wet blanket emphasizes a discouraging attitude that dampens enthusiasm. These equivalents apply only to the party-pooper sense.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 party pooper 整体记成“让聚会没了兴致的人”；单独 pooper 还可能有排便或粗俗身体部位义。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember party pooper as the person who drains the party's fun; outside that phrase, check for a literal or vulgar meaning.

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 第三人称单数 laits；过去式、过去分词 laited；现在分词 laiting。
family: laiting 寻找这一行为（-ing 形式）；本卡只教方言动词。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；lait + -ing → laiting（寻找这一行为，可作动名词）。

etymology.text: 由古诺尔斯语 leita（寻找）进入中古英语，成为 laiten，后来在英格兰方言中保留为 lait。可以把它与四处寻找失物的场景联系起来。

usage_note: 英格兰方言、较少见，也见于旧苏格兰语资料。日常通用英语通常说 look for 或 search for。这里不是法语“牛奶”的同形词。

teaching.contrast: lait 是方言里的“寻找”，接近 look for；find 强调成功找到。
teaching.sentence: Can you lait my keys while I check the garden?

senses.pos: v. 动词（英格兰北部方言；非常用标准英语）
senses.meaning_zh: 寻找；寻求
senses.meaning_en: To look for or seek.
senses.english_definition: In some northern English dialects, if you lait something, you look for it.
senses.collocation_en: lait work; lait a lost animal — illustrative dialect combinations, not established high-frequency standard-English collocations
senses.collocation_zh: 找工作；寻找走失的动物——方言用法示例，并非标准英语中的固定高频搭配
senses.sentence_en: I've been laiting my keys all morning.
senses.sentence_zh: 我整个上午都在找钥匙。（原句使用方言动词。）

etymology_story.zh: Lait 经中古英语 laiten 来自古诺尔斯语 leita“寻找”，体现了斯堪的纳维亚语言对英格兰北部方言的影响。它在部分地方用语中保留了“寻找”的含义，但并不是现代标准英语的常用动词。
etymology_story.en: Lait comes through Middle English laiten from Old Norse leita, meaning “seek,” reflecting Scandinavian influence on northern English dialects. It survives regionally with the meaning “look for,” but is not a common verb in modern standard English.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 lait 作为不可进一步拆分的方言动词词干记忆，不把字母组合强行分析为词根和词缀。规则形式为 laits、laited、laiting；laiting 可作现在分词或动名词，没有需要作为常用词掌握的标准英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, lait is an unanalyzed dialect verb stem; its letters should not be forced into a root-and-affix explanation. Regular forms are laits, laited, and laiting. Laiting can function as a present participle or gerund, and there is no substantial common standard-English derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: look for（寻找）是最自然的日常对应表达；seek（寻求）较正式，也常用于机会、帮助等抽象对象；search for（搜寻）更突出仔细或系统地找。lait 的主要区别在于地域方言身份，而不是独特的寻找方式。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Look for is the ordinary everyday equivalent; seek is more formal and often takes abstract objects such as opportunities or help; search for suggests more careful or systematic looking. Lait differs chiefly in its regional dialect status, rather than in describing a special method of searching.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 lait 直接对接 look for“寻找”；读音像 late，但两词没有这里所暗示的词源联系。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Map lait directly to look for. It sounds like late, but that resemblance is only a memory aid, not an etymological connection.

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 第三人称单数 scrams；过去式、过去分词 scrammed；现在分词 scramming，双写 m。
family: scramming 可作动名词，表示赶快离开的行为。

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆；scram + -ing → scramming（赶快离开这一行为，可作动名词），加后缀时双写 m。

etymology.text: 英语把 scramble 截短为 scram，形成“赶紧走开”的俚语。短促的词形适合联想急急忙忙离开的动作。

usage_note: 非正式用语。命令别人 Scram! 语气很不客气；叙述自己赶紧离开时也可用。另有核工程名词义，本卡不考。
sentence: We had to scram before the angry owner reached the gate.
translation: 愤怒的主人走到大门前，我们就得赶紧离开。
scenario: 叙事场景：有人正生气地走来，你们决定赶紧离开。
cloze: We had to _____ before the angry owner reached the gate.
collocation:
scram before trouble starts 在惹上麻烦前溜走（自我脱身）
tell a trespasser to scram 叫擅自闯入者滚开（驱赶）
context_hint: They want to leave before the owner arrives.

teaching.contrast: scram 强调赶快离开，语气随意甚至粗鲁；leave 是更中性的说法。
teaching.sentence: The guard told the troublemakers to scram.
teaching.translation: 保安叫那些闹事者赶快走开。

comprehension_check.sentence: We had to scram before the angry owner reached the gate.
comprehension_check.question: 句中目标词表示哪一种意思？
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: 大家要在主人走到门前离开，scram 与留下等待相反。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（赶快离开／留下等待）
fields.wrong_reason: 大家要在主人走到门前离开，scram 与留下等待相反。

senses.meaning_zh: 赶快离开；滚开（非正式，常用于命令）
senses.meaning_en: to leave immediately or in a hurry, especially when ordered to
senses.english_definition: If someone tells you to scram, they are telling you rather rudely to leave immediately.
senses.collocation_en: tell someone to scram; scram out of here
senses.collocation_zh: 叫某人赶快走开；赶快离开这里
senses.sentence_en: The owner came out and told us to scram.
senses.sentence_zh: 店主走出来，叫我们赶快走开。

senses.meaning_zh: 使（核反应堆）紧急停堆；（核反应堆）紧急停堆
senses.meaning_en: to shut down a nuclear reactor rapidly, or to undergo such a shutdown
senses.english_definition: When operators scram a nuclear reactor, they rapidly stop its chain reaction, usually as a safety measure.
senses.collocation_en: scram the reactor; automatically scram
senses.collocation_zh: 使反应堆紧急停堆；自动紧急停堆
senses.sentence_en: The operators scrammed the reactor after the cooling system failed.
senses.sentence_zh: 冷却系统发生故障后，操作人员使反应堆紧急停堆。

senses.meaning_zh: （核反应堆的）紧急停堆
senses.meaning_en: a rapid shutdown of a nuclear reactor
senses.english_definition: A scram is a rapid shutdown that stops a nuclear reactor's chain reaction.
senses.collocation_en: reactor scram; automatic scram
senses.collocation_zh: 反应堆紧急停堆；自动紧急停堆
senses.sentence_en: A faulty sensor triggered an automatic scram.
senses.sentence_zh: 一个有故障的传感器触发了自动紧急停堆。

etymology_story.zh: scram 在20世纪初的美国俚语中出现，通常被认为可能是 scramble 的截短形式，但其来源并未完全确定。后来，该词又用于核工程，表示迅速停止反应堆运行。
etymology_story.en: Scram appeared in early twentieth-century American slang and is often thought to be a shortening of scramble, although its origin is not completely certain. It later acquired a nuclear-engineering meaning referring to the rapid shutdown of a reactor.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为不可再分析的词基使用，没有能产的前后缀结构。屈折形式：scrams、scrammed、scramming；加 -ed 或 -ing 时双写 m；核工程名词 scram 与动词同形，也可写作 SCRAM。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, scram functions as an unanalyzed base without productive internal affixes. Its inflected forms are scrams, scrammed, and scramming, with m doubled before -ed and -ing; the nuclear-engineering noun has the same form and is also written SCRAM.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 日常义中，leave（离开）语气中性；clear off（走开）与 scram 一样口语化，作命令时可显得粗鲁。技术义中，shut down（关闭；停堆）范围更广，而 scram 特指迅速停止核链式反应。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In everyday use, leave is neutral, while clear off resembles scram in being informal and potentially rude as a command. In technical use, shut down is broader, whereas scram specifically denotes a rapid stop to a nuclear chain reaction.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“立即结束当前状态”：人赶快离开，反应堆迅速停堆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think 'end the current activity immediately': a person leaves at once, and a reactor stops its chain reaction rapidly.

meaning: 少年流行乐歌迷的；迎合少年歌迷的

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 形容词通常不变形；相关名词 teenybopper，复数 teenyboppers。
family: teenybopper 热衷流行音乐的少年歌迷。

morphology.text: teeny（此处指青少年 teenager）+ -bopper → teenybopper（少年流行乐歌迷）；teenybopper → teenybop（逆构为形容词，表示少年歌迷的）。整词作为独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语先有指少年歌迷的 teenybopper，后来去掉看似表示人的结尾，逆构出 teenybop，表示“这类歌迷的”。

usage_note: 非正式表达，常修饰 music、fans、magazine 等；可带轻微揶揄，不能泛指所有年轻人。
sentence: The station plays teenybop music for young pop fans.
translation: 这家电台为年轻流行乐歌迷播放迎合他们口味的音乐。
scenario: 电台节目：面向热衷流行音乐的少年听众选曲。
cloze: The station plays _____ music for young pop fans.
collocation:
teenybop music 少年歌迷喜爱的流行音乐（广播选曲）
a teenybop magazine 面向少年歌迷的杂志（出版）
context_hint: Look at the age and musical interests of the audience.

teaching.contrast: teenybop 指少年流行乐歌迷相关的事物；teenage 只说明年龄，并不说明音乐爱好。
teaching.sentence: She edited a teenybop magazine filled with interviews with pop stars.
teaching.translation: 她编辑了一本面向少年歌迷的杂志，里面有很多流行歌星访谈。

comprehension_check.sentence: The station plays teenybop music for young pop fans.
comprehension_check.question: 句中目标词表示哪一种意思？
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: 电台的听众是年轻流行乐歌迷，teenybop 对应这一受众群体。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（面向少年歌迷的／面向老年戏迷的）
fields.wrong_reason: 电台的听众是年轻流行乐歌迷，teenybop 对应这一受众群体。

senses.meaning_zh: 迎合低龄青少年流行乐歌迷的；少年流行音乐文化的
senses.meaning_en: relating to pop music or entertainment aimed at young teenagers
senses.english_definition: Teenybop music or entertainment is intended mainly for young teenagers, especially enthusiastic fans of pop stars.
senses.collocation_en: teenybop music; a teenybop idol
senses.collocation_zh: 面向低龄青少年的流行音乐；少年歌迷的偶像
senses.sentence_en: The band moved away from its teenybop image and began writing more serious songs.
senses.sentence_zh: 这支乐队逐渐摆脱迎合少年歌迷的形象，开始创作更严肃的歌曲。

etymology_story.zh: teenybop 通常被解释为从 teenybopper（少年流行乐歌迷）逆构而来，属于20世纪流行音乐文化中的非正式用语。teenybopper 结合了 teeny 的年幼联想与 bopper 的流行音乐、舞蹈联想，随后 teenybop 用来修饰迎合这类歌迷的音乐和娱乐。
etymology_story.en: Teenybop is generally explained as a back-formation from teenybopper, an informal term for a young teenage pop fan that arose in twentieth-century popular culture. Teenybopper combines the suggestion of youth in teeny with the music-and-dancing associations of bopper, and teenybop came to describe entertainment aimed at those fans.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式为形容词 teenybop，也见连字符拼写 teeny-bop；可联系 teenybopper → teenybop 的逆构关系，但 -er 在这里并非一个可自由套用的形容词后缀。主要相关词形为 teenybopper（少年流行乐歌迷）、teenyboppers（复数）；该词没有常用的比较级、最高级或规则派生副词。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern adjective is teenybop, also written teeny-bop, and can be understood through its back-formation from teenybopper; this does not make -er a productive adjective-forming suffix. The principal related forms are teenybopper, meaning a young teenage pop fan, and its plural teenyboppers; the adjective has no established everyday comparative, superlative, or regularly derived adverb.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: teen-oriented（面向青少年的）是中性且范围更广的表达；bubblegum（泡泡糖流行乐风格的）强调轻快、上口的音乐风格；teenybop 更强调低龄少年歌迷及其偶像文化，有时略带轻视。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Teen-oriented is neutral and applies more broadly to things intended for teenagers. Bubblegum emphasizes a catchy, lightweight pop style, while teenybop emphasizes young fans and their idol culture and can sound mildly dismissive.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: teen 联想到少年，bop 联想到流行乐节奏：给少年歌迷听的音乐。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect teen with young fans and bop with a pop beat: music made for young teenage listeners.

pronunciation.note: 重音符号标出重读音节；本卡采用美式读音。

forms: 常用单数 the whole caboodle；复数 caboodles。
family: boodle 一批东西；kit and caboodle 全套东西。

morphology.text: ca-（不另添词义的起首音节）+ boodle（一批东西）→ caboodle（全套东西）。成词后作为独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语在 boodle（一批东西）前加上起首音节 ca-，形成 caboodle。记忆时想象把零零散散的东西一股脑儿全打包。

usage_note: 非正式用语，常见 the whole caboodle 或 the whole kit and caboodle，强调一件也不落下。
sentence: We packed the tent, the stove, and the whole caboodle into the van.
translation: 我们把帐篷、炉子以及其余全套东西都装进了面包车。
scenario: 露营出发：把整套装备一次装车。
cloze: We packed the tent, the stove, and the whole _____ into the van.
collocation:
pack the whole caboodle 把整套装备打包（露营出行）
buy the whole kit and caboodle 买下店内全套东西（店铺清算）
context_hint: The tent, stove, and all the other equipment go together.

teaching.contrast: the whole caboodle 强调整批全部；a selection 只表示从中挑出的一部分。
teaching.sentence: When the shop closed, she bought the whole caboodle, including the shelves.
teaching.translation: 商店关门时，她把整套东西都买了下来，连货架也包括在内。

comprehension_check.sentence: We packed the tent, the stove, and the whole caboodle into the van.
comprehension_check.question: 句中目标词表示哪一种意思？
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: 句子把帐篷、炉子和其他装备一起装车，强调全部而非挑选的一小部分。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（整套东西／少量选出的东西）
fields.wrong_reason: 句子把帐篷、炉子和其他装备一起装车，强调全部而非挑选的一小部分。

senses.meaning_zh: 整批人或东西；全套；全部（通常用于固定短语）
senses.meaning_en: an entire collection of people or things, usually in a fixed expression
senses.english_definition: The whole caboodle, or the whole kit and caboodle, means all the people or things being discussed.
senses.collocation_en: the whole caboodle; the whole kit and caboodle
senses.collocation_zh: 全部；全套人马或东西
senses.sentence_en: We packed the whole kit and caboodle into the van.
senses.sentence_zh: 我们把全部东西都装进了那辆厢式货车。

etymology_story.zh: caboodle 见于19世纪美国英语，通常被解释为在 boodle（一群人；一批东西）前添加 ca- 音节形成，但细节并不确定。它后来尤其固定在 the whole caboodle 和 the whole kit and caboodle 中，强调“一样不落的全部”。
etymology_story.en: Caboodle is recorded in nineteenth-century American English and is usually explained as boodle, meaning a crowd or collection, with an added initial syllable ca-, although the details are uncertain. It became especially established in the whole caboodle and the whole kit and caboodle, emphasizing an entire collection.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜把 caboodle 作为完整词基学习；历史上的 ca- 不是具有稳定词义的能产前缀。复数形式为 caboodles，但常见固定短语通常使用单数；没有常用的标准派生词族，boodle 是历史相关词，kit and caboodle 是固定搭配。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, caboodle is best learned as a whole base; its historical ca- is not a productive prefix with a stable meaning. The plural is caboodles, though the familiar fixed expressions normally use the singular; there is no common standard derivational family, while boodle is historically related and kit and caboodle is a fixed expression.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: the lot（全部）简洁而口语化；the whole shebang（整套东西；整个事情）同样俏皮、非正式；collection（一批收藏或聚集物）语气中性，不一定表示相关事物一个不剩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The lot is a concise informal expression for everything concerned, while the whole shebang is similarly playful and informal. Collection is neutral and describes things gathered together without necessarily emphasizing that nothing is excluded.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 the whole kit and caboodle 整块记住：一整套，统统带走。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Learn the whole kit and caboodle as one chunk: the complete set, with everything included.

pronunciation.note: 采用英式读音，首音节重读。

forms: 可数名词；复数 bentos。bento box 也可专指便当盒。
family: bento box 便当盒；packed lunch 自带的盒装午餐。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；bento + box → bento box（日式便当盒），这是借词进入英语后的复合名词。

etymology.text: 从日语 bentō（便当、盒装午餐）借入英语。可以联想把米饭和配菜分格装好的一份午餐。

usage_note: 普通名词通常小写。可指便当这顿饭；bento box 还可指分格便当盒。本卡主教盒饭义。
sentence: I bought a bento with rice and grilled fish for lunch.
translation: 我买了一份配米饭和烤鱼的便当作午餐。
scenario: 午餐购买：在店里选一份日式盒饭。
cloze: I bought a _____ with rice and grilled fish for lunch.
collocation:
order a fish bento 点一份鱼肉便当（餐厅点餐）
pack a bento for a school trip 为学校出游装便当（家庭准备）
context_hint: Notice the rice and grilled fish packed as lunch.

teaching.contrast: bento 是日式盒饭；lunch 是午餐的统称，未必装盒，也未必是日式。
teaching.sentence: She packed a bento for her child before the school trip.
teaching.translation: 学校组织出游前，她为孩子装好了一份便当。

comprehension_check.sentence: I bought a bento with rice and grilled fish for lunch.
comprehension_check.question: 句中目标词表示哪一种意思？
comprehension_check.wrong_reason: 米饭和烤鱼组成一份盒装午餐，bento 在这里指便当，不是汤。

fields.label: 句中目标词表示（日式盒饭／日式热汤）
fields.wrong_reason: 米饭和烤鱼组成一份盒装午餐，bento 在这里指便当，不是汤。

senses.meaning_zh: 日式便当；分装在盒中的日式餐食
senses.meaning_en: a Japanese-style meal packed in a box, often with separate compartments
senses.english_definition: A bento is a Japanese-style meal packed in a box, usually containing rice and several accompanying foods.
senses.collocation_en: a bento lunch; prepare a bento
senses.collocation_zh: 一份日式便当午餐；准备一份便当
senses.sentence_en: She packed a bento with rice, grilled salmon, and vegetables.
senses.sentence_zh: 她装了一份便当，里面有米饭、烤三文鱼和蔬菜。

etymology_story.zh: bento 借自日语 bentō（弁当），指便于携带的盒装餐食。进入英语后，它保留了日本饮食文化中的这一含义，并常见于复合词 bento box。
etymology_story.en: Bento was borrowed from Japanese bentō, meaning a packed meal carried in a box. In English, it retained this association with Japanese food culture and became familiar in the compound bento box.

morphology_enriched.zh: bento 是整体借入的名词，在现代英语中不拆分为 ben- 与 -to，也没有英语派生后缀。可作可数名词，复数为 bentos，也可泛指这类餐食；常见复合词有 bento box（便当盒，也可转指整份盒饭）和 bento lunch（便当午餐）；bento box 中的 bento 是名词作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: Bento is a borrowed noun and is not divided into English elements ben- and -to or analyzed as containing an English suffix. It can be countable, with the plural bentos, or refer generally to this kind of food; common compounds include bento box, meaning the container or sometimes the complete boxed meal, and bento lunch. In bento box, bento is an attributive noun.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: packed lunch（自备午餐）范围更广，不限于日式餐食或特定容器；boxed lunch（盒装午餐）强调包装形式；lunchbox（午餐盒）主要指容器，而 bento 通常指餐食。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Packed lunch is broader and does not imply Japanese food or a particular container. Boxed lunch emphasizes the packaging, while lunchbox primarily names the container; bento usually names the meal.

etymology.text: 从法语 céladon 借入，表示这种柔和的灰黄绿色。可以用青瓷釉面的淡绿色来记住这一色名。

etymology_story.zh: celadon 借自法语 céladon，其名称来自奥诺雷·德·于尔费17世纪小说《阿斯特蕾》中的牧羊人 Céladon，据传统解释，他与淡绿色服饰有关。这个名称先成为色名，后来也用于具有相近釉色的东亚陶瓷。
etymology_story.en: Celadon comes from French céladon, named after Céladon, a shepherd in Honoré d'Urfé's seventeenth-century novel L'Astrée who was traditionally associated with pale green clothing. The name became a color term and was subsequently applied to East Asian ceramics with a similar glaze.

morphology_enriched.zh: celadon 是整体借入的词基，现代英语中没有可拆分的能产前后缀；名词与颜色形容词同形。指青瓷或颜色时通常不可数，谈论多件青瓷器或不同青瓷品类时可用 celadons；相关矿物名 celadonite（绿鳞石）可联系 celadon 与矿物名称后缀 -ite 来理解，但属于专业词汇。
morphology_enriched.en: Celadon is a borrowed base without productive internal English affixes; its noun and color-adjective forms are identical. It is usually uncountable when naming the ceramic material or color, though celadons can refer to individual pieces or varieties of the ware. The related specialist mineral name celadonite can be understood through celadon and the mineral-name suffix -ite.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 颜色义中，sage green（鼠尾草绿）也偏灰，但通常更显土色或更暗；seafoam green（海沫绿）通常更偏蓝；青瓷义可用 greenware（青釉陶瓷）作近义表达，但 greenware 在一般陶艺语境中也指未烧制的坯体，必须结合上下文理解。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the color, sage green is also muted but often earthier or darker, while seafoam green is usually bluer. For the ceramics, greenware can refer to green-glazed ware, but in general pottery terminology it also means unfired clay objects, so context is essential.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a pale gray-green ceramic bowl: celadon names both the ware and its characteristic color.

meaning: 霍霍巴；其种子可产化妆品用液态蜡的灌木

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；音标按词典读音转写为国际音标。

forms: 名词；指植物时可数，复数 jojobas；作材料名称时常不计数。
family: jojoba oil 霍霍巴油；jojoba seed 霍霍巴种子

morphology.text: jojoba + -s → jojobas（多株霍霍巴）。整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语从墨西哥西班牙语借入 jojoba，其名称来自犹他—阿兹特克语系，和奥奥德姆语 hohowai、雅基语 hohoovam 的植物名有关。可以把这个名字与干旱地区长出的油料灌木联系起来。

senses.meaning_zh: 霍霍巴：原产北美西南部、种子可提取液态蜡的常绿灌木

etymology_story.zh: 英语 jojoba 借自墨西哥西班牙语，名称源于犹他—阿兹特克语系，与奥奥德姆语 hohowai 和雅基语 hohoovam 等植物名称有关。英语中也用植物名指其种子提取物。[词源来源：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jojoba)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed jojoba from Mexican Spanish; the name has Uto-Aztecan origins and is related to plant names such as O’odham hohowai and Yaqui hohoovam. In English, the plant name also refers to its seed extract. [Etymology source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jojoba)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作有效词根、词缀拆分的借词。可数植物名的复数为 jojoba + -s → jojobas；表示提取物时通常不可数。常用组合包括 jojoba oil（霍霍巴油）、jojoba seed（霍霍巴种子）、jojoba-based（以霍霍巴提取物为基础的）；没有常用的独立派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, jojoba is a borrowed base without a productive root-and-affix breakdown. The countable plant noun forms jojoba + -s → jojobas; the extract sense is normally uncountable. Common formations include jojoba oil, jojoba seed, and jojoba-based. There is no established family of common independent derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: goatnut（霍霍巴的另一俗名）可指同一种植物；jojoba oil（霍霍巴油）明确指提取物；liquid wax（液态蜡）说明物质性质，但范围更广，并非该植物的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Goatnut is another common name for the same plant; jojoba oil explicitly names the extract; liquid wax describes the substance but is a broader category, not a synonym for the plant.

meaning: 心轴；插入工件孔内以支承加工的轴

morphology.text: mandrel + -s → mandrels（多根心轴）。整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语借自中世纪拉丁语 maundrellus；更早通常追溯到古奥克语 mandre，意为轴销。记住穿进工件中间、把它撑稳的轴，便容易联想到心轴。

etymology_story.zh: 韦氏词典将 mandrel 追溯至中世纪拉丁语 maundrellus，并认为它最终可能源于古奥克语 mandre，意为轴销。从中心轴销的概念，可理解其支承工件、充当成形芯棒及承载旋转工具的意义联系。[来源：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mandrel)
etymology_story.en: Merriam-Webster traces mandrel to Medieval Latin maundrellus, probably ultimately from Old Occitan mandre, meaning a kingpin. The idea of a central pin helps connect its uses as a work support, forming core, and tool-carrying shaft. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mandrel)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中按单一词基 mandrel 记忆，不拆成 man + drel。mandrel + -s → mandrels；异体拼写为 mandril。常用技术组合包括 mandrel bending（芯棒弯管）、mandrel-bent（采用芯棒弯制的）、mandrel-supported（由芯棒支承的）；没有常用的普通词汇派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat mandrel as a single modern base, not as man + drel. Mandrel + -s → mandrels; mandril is a spelling variant. Technical formations include mandrel bending, mandrel-bent, and mandrel-supported. There is no common general-vocabulary family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: arbor（刀具或工件安装轴）在部分机械语境中最接近 mandrel；spindle（主轴、旋转轴）更强调旋转功能；core（芯、芯体）强调内部成形或支承，不一定是轴状工具。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Arbor is a close equivalent in some machining contexts; spindle emphasizes a rotating shaft; core emphasizes internal shaping or support and need not be a shaft-like tool.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 中间一根轴：里面撑工件，外面带工具。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture one central shaft: it supports work from inside or carries a tool outside.

senses.meaning_zh: 撅嘴的表情；表示不满、怀疑或轻蔑的小怪相

etymology_story.en: English borrowed moue from French, retaining its meaning of a pout or slight grimace. The French word is traced to Frankish *mauwa, which had a similar meaning. [Source: Dictionnaire de l’Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9M2976)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作有效拆分的法语借词。moue + -s → moues（多个撅嘴表情）；没有常用的派生词族。它主要是文学性名词，偶见动词用法，不属于常用词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Moue is a French borrowing without a productive modern breakdown. Moue + -s → moues; it has no common family of derivatives. It is primarily a literary noun; occasional verbal uses do not constitute a common part of speech.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pout（撅嘴）最直接、最日常，常带闹情绪的意味；grimace（面部扭曲的表情）范围更广，可表示疼痛或厌恶；frown（皱眉）主要涉及眉额，而 moue 主要涉及嘴唇。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pout is the everyday equivalent and often suggests sulkiness; grimace covers a wider facial distortion, including pain or disgust; frown primarily involves the brow, whereas moue focuses on the lips.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 嘴唇向前一撅：小小不满，尽在嘴边。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Lips pushed forward: a small objection expressed with the mouth.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 naan 借自印地语、乌尔都语和波斯语相关形式，最终来自波斯语 nān，意思是面包。这个原本泛指面包的名称，在英语中主要指与南亚饮食相关的发酵扁面包。[来源：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/naan)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed naan through Hindi, Urdu, and Persian forms, ultimately from Persian nān, meaning bread. A name with the general meaning of bread became, in English, a term chiefly for the leavened flatbread associated with South Asian cooking. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/naan)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是单一借词词基，没有可识别的英语前后缀。泛指食物时可不可数；按张计数时可用 a naan、two naans，即 naan + -s → naans。异体拼写为 nan；常用组合包括 garlic naan（蒜香馕）、butter naan（黄油馕）和 naan bread（南亚馕饼），没有常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Naan is a single borrowed base with no identifiable English affixes. It can be uncountable as food or countable as an individual bread: a naan, two naans, with naan + -s → naans. Nan is a spelling variant. Common combinations include garlic naan, butter naan, and naan bread; there is no common family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: flatbread（扁面包）是上位词，包括多种发酵或不发酵的面饼；roti（罗蒂薄饼）在许多南亚语境中通常指不发酵的面饼；chapati（恰巴提薄饼）通常指在平锅上烙制的全麦无酵薄饼，二者均不等同于 naan。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Flatbread is the broader category, covering both leavened and unleavened breads; roti commonly denotes unleavened bread in many South Asian contexts; chapati usually means an unleavened wholemeal flatbread cooked on a griddle. Neither is an exact equivalent of naan.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 波斯语里的“面包” → 英语餐桌上的南亚发面馕。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Persian bread → the soft, leavened South Asian flatbread on an English menu.

etymology_story.zh: Sateen 是 satin（缎子）的变体，十九世纪初已见于英语。它与 satin 的词形联系反映了织物表面的相似光泽，而 sateen 通常用于指以棉等短纤维纱线织成的缎纹织物。[来源：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sateen)
etymology_story.en: Sateen developed as an alteration of satin and was recorded in English by the early nineteenth century. Its resemblance to satin reflects the fabrics’ similar sheen, while sateen usually denotes satin-weave fabric made from staple-fiber yarns such as cotton. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sateen)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 sateen 作为整体词基；它不是 sate（使充分满足）加上后缀 -en。通常作不可数材料名词；专业语境中的 sateens 可指不同品种。常用组合包括 cotton sateen（缎纹棉布）、sateen sheets（缎纹棉床单）、sateen weave（纬面缎纹）；前置修饰是名词作定语，没有常用的独立形容词或派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat sateen as a whole modern base, not as sate plus -en. It is normally an uncountable material noun; technical plural sateens can refer to varieties. Common combinations include cotton sateen, sateen sheets, and sateen weave. Premodifying uses are attributive nouns; there is no common independent adjective or derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: satin（缎子）通常指用长丝纱线织成的光滑缎纹织物；sateen 通常用棉等短纤维纱线织成。Cotton satin（棉缎）在商业语境中可与 cotton sateen 接近；percale（高密平纹棉布）则采用平纹组织，通常更挺括、光泽更弱，并非同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Satin usually refers to a glossy satin-weave fabric made with filament yarns, whereas sateen generally uses staple-fiber yarns such as cotton. Cotton satin can be a close commercial equivalent of cotton sateen; percale is a plain-weave fabric with a crisper, less lustrous finish, not a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从 satin 联想缎面光泽：sateen 常是棉纱织出的光滑亮面。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect sateen with satin’s sheen: often cotton yarns woven into a smooth, lustrous surface.

etymology.text: 借自意大利语 terrazzo，原意为露台。由露台联想到铺地面，再记住石粒嵌在基料中、磨出光泽的水磨石。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 terrazzo 借自意大利语 terrazzo，原指露台或平台，最终与拉丁语 terra（土地）有关。英语借用该词来命名这种铺地饰面材料。[词源与释义来源：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/terrazzo)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed terrazzo from Italian terrazzo, meaning a terrace or balcony and ultimately related to Latin terra, meaning earth. In English, the borrowing names the flooring material. [Etymology and definition: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/terrazzo)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再分析的借入名词：terrazzo，不宜拆成英语词根和词缀。材料义通常不可数，无常用派生词；terrazzo floor（水磨石地面）、terrazzo tile（水磨石砖）和 terrazzo flooring（水磨石地面材料）是名词组合，前置使用不必另列形容词。等级说明：CEFR-C2 为本条目的编辑估级，并非官方逐词定级；无充分依据添加考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, terrazzo is an unanalyzed borrowed noun, with no productive English root-and-affix breakdown. The material sense is normally uncountable and has no common derivatives; terrazzo floor, terrazzo tile, and terrazzo flooring are noun combinations, with terrazzo functioning attributively. Level note: CEFR-C2 is an editorial estimate, not an official word-level rating; no unsupported examination tags are assigned.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 无严格同义词。mosaic（马赛克）强调小块材料拼成的图案；polished concrete（磨光混凝土）强调混凝土表面的磨光处理；stone flooring（石材地面）是更宽泛的类别，均不能无条件替换 terrazzo。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact synonym. Mosaic emphasizes a design assembled from small pieces; polished concrete emphasizes the finishing of a concrete surface; stone flooring is a broader category. None is automatically interchangeable with terrazzo.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 露台 terrazzo → 铺地材料：石屑嵌进去，表面磨出来。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a terrace: stone chips embedded in its floor, then polished smooth.

etymology_story.en: The animal name dama entered English through a New Latin specific epithet, historically used in Gazella dama. It comes from Latin dama or damma, a name applied to fallow deer and certain antelope-like animals. [Etymology and definition: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dama)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：dama 为不可再分析的借入词；dama + -s → damas（复数），无常用英语派生词。dama gazelle（赤额瞪羚）是更明确的物种名称；大写斜体 Dama 表示黇鹿属，是另一个分类学名称，不能与小写 dama 的动物义混同。等级说明：CEFR-C2 为编辑估级，并非官方逐词定级；无充分依据添加考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: dama is an unanalyzed borrowing; dama + -s → damas, the plural, with no common English derivatives. Dama gazelle is the more explicit species name; capitalized, italicized Dama denotes the fallow-deer genus and must be distinguished from the lowercase animal noun. synonyms_and_nuances.zh: dama gazelle（赤额瞪羚）是明确的对应名称；addra gazelle（阿达瞪羚）可作别名，但有些用法专指其东部亚种；gazelle（瞪羚）是上位类别，不能准确限定到本物种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Dama gazelle is the explicit equivalent; addra gazelle is an alternative name but sometimes refers specifically to the eastern subspecies; gazelle is a broader term that does not identify this particular species.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 无完全对应的普通同义词。base（基座）只说明支承位置；panel（画板）可指任何一块绘画板面；altarpiece（祭坛画或祭坛装饰屏）指整体，predella 通常只是其下部。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact everyday synonym. Base describes the supporting position; panel can mean any individual painted board; altarpiece names the complete work, of which the predella is usually the lower section.

morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: timbale is a whole-word borrowing; timbale + -s → timbales. Culinary and musical uses have different pronunciations, and the instrument name is normally plural; there are no common English derivatives. Related combinations include timbale mold, timbale case, and timbale iron. Level note: CEFR-C2 is an editorial estimate, not an official word-level rating; no unsupported examination tags are assigned.

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Molded dish is a broad culinary near-equivalent; pastry case matches only the edible-shell sense; bongos are related instruments rather than synonyms, usually played with the hands, whereas timbales are played with sticks.

morphology.text: gam + -s → gams（腿，复数）。整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 先见于英国隐语，通常认为来自地中海混合语 gamba，意为腿，而 gamba 又来自意大利语及更早的晚期拉丁语。记住 gamba 到 gam 的缩短联系即可。

usage_note: 老式俚语，常用复数 gams；普通交流直接说 leg 更自然。另一个同形词表示捕鲸人间的拜访闲谈，与本课腿义分开记。

etymology_story.zh: 表示腿的 gam 最初见于英国隐语，可能经地中海通用混合语的 gamba（腿）追溯到意大利语及晚期拉丁语。表示交谈或鲸群的同形词来源不确定，可能是旧词 gammon（闲谈）的缩略形式，交谈义又产生了动词。[词源与释义来源：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/gam)
etymology_story.en: Gam meaning a leg probably passed through Lingua Franca gamba from Italian and Late Latin. The separate conversational and whale-group noun has an uncertain origin, possibly a shortening of gammon meaning talk; its conversational sense produced the verb. [Etymology and definitions: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/gam)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式：gam 是单纯词；名词复数 gams，动词第三人称单数 gams，过去式及过去分词 gammed，现在分词 gamming，后两者双写 m。腿义与交谈义属于不同词源的同形词；均无常用派生词，也不应与表示婚配的构词成分 -gam 混同。等级说明：CEFR-C2 为编辑估级，并非官方逐词定级；无充分依据添加考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern forms: gam is a simplex word; noun plural gams; verb forms gams, gammed, and gamming, with doubled m in the latter two. The leg and conversation meanings are etymologically separate homonyms; neither has common derivatives, and neither should be confused with the combining form -gam relating to marriage. Level note: CEFR-C2 is an editorial estimate, not an official word-level rating; no unsupported examination tags are assigned.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: leg（腿）是中性名称，gam 带俚语色彩；chat（闲谈）是交谈义的普通对应词，gam 保留航海或旧式语感；pod（鲸群）是表示鲸群时更常用的词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Leg is neutral, while gam is slang; chat is the everyday equivalent of the conversational sense, while gam sounds nautical or old-fashioned; pod is the more usual word for a group of whales.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 分两路记：gamba → gam 是腿；捕鲸船相遇 → gam 是聚谈，鲸聚在一起也可称 gam。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep two tracks: gamba leads to the leg; meeting whalers leads to a chat, with a whale group also called a gam.

etymology_story.zh: 借自意大利语 poco，意为“少许”，可追溯至拉丁语 paucus，意为“少的”。英语通过意大利音乐术语借入这个词，用它限制速度、力度等指示的变化程度。
etymology_story.en: Poco comes from Italian poco, meaning 'a little,' ultimately from Latin paucus, meaning 'little' or 'few.' English borrowed it through Italian musical terminology to limit the degree of an instruction concerning tempo, dynamics, or expression.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 poco 视为不可再拆分的借词，没有能产的英语前后缀，也无常用英语派生词。相关组合：un poco＝稍许；poco a poco＝一点一点地、逐渐地；这些是意大利语短语，并非英语派生构词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, poco is an unanalyzed loanword with no productive English affixes or established common derivatives. Related expressions include un poco, 'a little,' and poco a poco, 'little by little' or 'gradually'; these are Italian phrases rather than English derivations.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: slightly（稍微）最直接地表示程度小；a little（少许）更口语化；somewhat（有点）程度较模糊。poco 专用于音乐指示，替换为这些普通英语表达后便不再是原有的意大利语乐谱术语。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Slightly most directly expresses a small degree; a little is more conversational; somewhat leaves the degree less precise. Poco is a conventional musical direction, whereas these alternatives are ordinary English explanations.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: poco＝只调一点；poco a poco＝一点再一点，逐渐变化。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Poco means a small adjustment; poco a poco means one small adjustment after another.

meaning: 你好；再见（源自希伯来语的问候语）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；音标按词典读音转写为国际音标。

forms: 感叹词；用于问候和道别，不加时态或复数词尾。
family: shalom aleichem 愿你们平安（问候语）

morphology.text: shalom + aleichem → shalom aleichem（愿你们平安，问候语组合）。整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 直接借自希伯来语 shālōm，原意是平安。问候或道别时把平安送给对方，因此既可用于见面，也可用于分别。

usage_note: 在犹太文化语境中可作问候或道别。句首按普通规则大写，句中可写 shalom。

senses.meaning_zh: 你好；再见（希伯来语问候或道别用语，含祝愿平安之意）
senses.meaning_en: Hello or goodbye, with a wish for peace.

senses.meaning_zh: 平安；安宁与福祉（尤指犹太思想中的完整、和谐状态）
senses.meaning_en: Peace, well-being, and wholeness, especially in Jewish thought.
senses.english_definition: In Jewish thought, shalom is a condition of peace and well-being that includes harmony and wholeness.
senses.collocation_en: the concept of shalom; a vision of shalom
senses.collocation_zh: 平安与完整的观念；对和平福祉的愿景
senses.sentence_en: The discussion explored shalom as more than the absence of conflict.
senses.sentence_zh: 这次讨论探讨了 shalom 的含义，认为它不仅仅是没有冲突。

etymology_story.zh: 借自希伯来语 shālōm，意为“平安、安康”，属于表达完整、健全等意义的闪米特语词根词族。这个表示平安与福祉的名词也被用作问候和道别语，英语沿用了这些用法。
etymology_story.en: Shalom comes from Hebrew shālōm, meaning 'peace' or 'well-being,' and belongs to a Semitic root family associated with completeness and soundness. The noun also serves as a greeting and farewell, uses that English has borrowed.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 shalom 是整体借入的独立词素，不应按英语字母片段强行拆解。作平安概念时通常不可数；无常用英语派生词。相关短语 shalom aleichem 意为“愿你们平安”，不是英语词缀派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, shalom is a single borrowed base and should not be divided into supposed English word parts. It is normally uncountable when naming the concept of peace and has no established common English derivatives. Shalom aleichem, 'peace be upon you,' is a related Hebrew expression rather than an English affixal derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hello（你好）只用于见面问候；goodbye（再见）只用于道别；peace（平安、和平）对应其名词核心义。shalom 兼有问候、道别和祝愿平安的文化内涵，名词义还可包含福祉与完整。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hello is a greeting, goodbye is a farewell, and peace corresponds to the core noun meaning. Shalom combines greeting or leave-taking with a culturally meaningful wish for peace, while its noun use can also include well-being and wholeness.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把“愿你平安”送给对方：见面能说，分别也能说。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Offer someone peace when you meet and when you part.

meaning: 令人害怕的事物；想象中的可怕东西

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；音标按词典读音转写为国际音标。

forms: 可数名词；复数 bugaboos。
family: bugaboos 令人害怕的事物（复数）

morphology.text: bugaboo + -s → bugaboos（令人害怕的事物，复数）。整词作为独立词素记忆。

etymology.text: 英语里较早写作 buggybow、bugger-bo，后来形成 bugaboo，用来称呼想象中吓人的东西。可把这个古怪的声音与故事里让孩子害怕的小怪物联系起来；更早的来源尚无定论。

relations.meaning: 令人担忧或恐惧的事物

usage_note: 非正式，既可指想象中的怪物，也可比喻让人害怕的问题；语气常带“未必真有那么可怕”的意味。

senses.english_definition: A bugaboo is an imaginary creature that frightens people, especially children.

etymology_story.zh: bugaboo 的早期相关形式包括 bugger-bo，与旧时表示“鬼怪、吓人物”的 bug 一类词有关，但更早的来源并不确定。它从想象中的可怕怪物，扩展为让人忧惧或反复头疼的事物。
etymology_story.en: Earlier related forms of bugaboo include bugger-bo, associated with the old word bug meaning a frightening spirit; the deeper origin is uncertain. Its meaning expanded from an imaginary monster to something that causes anxiety or recurring difficulty.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以 bugaboo 为整体词基，不宜分析成表示“昆虫”的 bug 加感叹词 boo。屈折变化：bugaboo + -s → bugaboos；无常用的能产派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats bugaboo as a whole base, rather than a transparent combination of bug meaning 'insect' and the exclamation boo. Its regular plural is bugaboos, formed with -s; there is no established common productive family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: bugbear（长期令人烦恼或害怕的事）最接近其比喻义；bogeyman（吓人的妖怪或被渲染的威胁）突出恐惧与想象；stumbling block（绊脚石）强调实际阻碍，不一定让人害怕。bugaboo 可以指真实难题，也可以指被夸大的恐惧对象。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Bugbear is closest to the figurative sense of a persistent source of irritation or fear; bogeyman emphasizes an imagined or exaggerated threat; stumbling block emphasizes an actual obstacle without necessarily implying fear. A bugaboo can be either a real difficulty or an inflated object of anxiety.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 先是故事里吓人的怪物，再是心里挥不去的难题。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A monster in a story becomes a problem that keeps haunting you.

etymology.text: 经法语 anolis 借入英语，更早来自多米尼加岛的加勒比语 anáoli，原本就是一种蜥蜴的名称。可以把名字与枝头伸展喉扇的小蜥蜴联系起来。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 anole 经法语 anolis 借入，通常追溯至加勒比地区原住民语言中的一种蜥蜴名称。它原本就是动物名称，后来成为英语中这类美洲蜥蜴的通称。
etymology_story.en: English anole was borrowed through French anolis, generally traced to an Indigenous Caribbean name for a lizard. Originally an animal name, it became the English common name for this group of American lizards.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 anole 是不可再拆分的借词，不含可识别的英语前缀或后缀。屈折变化：anole + -s → anoles；无常用英语派生词。相关属名 Anolis 是科学分类名称，不是 anole 加英语词缀形成的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, anole is an unanalyzed loanword with no identifiable English prefix or suffix. Its regular plural is anoles, formed with -s, and it has no common English derivatives. The related genus name Anolis is a scientific taxonomic name, not an English affixal derivative of anole.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: anole 没有通用而严格等义的单词替代项。lizard（蜥蜴）是范围更大的上位词；American chameleon（美洲变色龙）是部分安乐蜥的非正式称呼，但它们并非真正的变色龙；green anole（绿安乐蜥）只指其中一种，不能替代整个类群名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Anole has no widely used exact one-word synonym. Lizard is a broader category; American chameleon is an informal name for certain anoles, although they are not true chameleons; green anole names one species rather than the whole group.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the whole name with a small lizard displaying its throat fan on a branch.

etymology_story.zh: bubba 源于 brother 的儿语式或亲昵称呼形式，在美国南方发展为常见男性昵称 Bubba。这个昵称后来又泛化为对某类南方白人男性的刻板称呼，因语境不同可带亲切、戏谑或贬低色彩。
etymology_story.en: Bubba developed as a childish or affectionate form of brother and became a familiar male nickname in the American South. The nickname later broadened into a stereotypical label for certain Southern white men, with affectionate, humorous, or derogatory force depending on context.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 bubba 是整体词基；它与 brother 的关系来自语音变化，并非可套用的前后缀构词公式。普通名词复数为 bubbas；作昵称时通常大写为 Bubba；无常用的能产派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, bubba is a whole base; its relationship to brother reflects a change in pronunciation rather than a productive root-plus-affix formula. The common-noun plural is bubbas, and the personal nickname is normally capitalized Bubba. There is no established common productive family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: buddy（老兄、朋友）对应亲昵称呼义，通常没有南方或族群指向；good ol' boy（南方老哥、熟人圈中的传统男性）突出地域文化与男性关系网；redneck（乡巴佬）通常更具贬义，强调被视为粗俗或缺乏教养的乡村白人形象。bubba 可因称呼对象和语气而显得亲切或冒犯。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Buddy matches the friendly form of address without usually implying a region or ethnicity; good ol' boy emphasizes Southern male culture and social connections; redneck is generally more disparaging and stresses a rural white stereotype of roughness or lack of sophistication. Bubba can sound affectionate or insulting depending on the relationship and tone.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: brother 的亲昵称呼变成 Bubba 昵称，再从一个人的昵称扩展成一类人的标签。
mnemonic_anchor.en: An affectionate form of brother becomes the nickname Bubba, then a label for a stereotyped group.

pronunciation.note: 美式读音；音标采用 IPA。

forms: 可数名词；复数 stopes。
family: stoping 分层采矿；stope 也可作动词，表示分层开采。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；stope + -ing → stoping（分层采矿，去掉词尾 e）。采场随矿层逐层挖出，可联想阶梯。

etymology.text: 词典认为可能借自低地德语 stope，原义为“台阶”。地下逐层开采后留下的阶梯状空间，正好帮助记住这个采矿术语；这条来源尚非定论。

relations.meaning: 挖掘形成的空间，范围比采场广

usage_note: 采矿专业用语，指地下取走矿石后形成的开采空间；不是整座矿井。

senses.english_definition: A stope is a space in an underground mine where miners extract ore.

senses.sentence_zh: 矿山关闭之前，这条狭窄矿脉已经采尽。

etymology_story.zh: stope 的来源未有定论，通常认为可能与低地德语中表示“台阶”的 stope 有关。它可能因早期地下开采形成的阶梯状工作面而得名，后来指地下采场，并用作开采矿石的动词。
etymology_story.en: The origin of stope is uncertain, but it is often linked to Low German stope, meaning a step. The name may reflect the stepped working faces of early underground mining; it came to denote an excavation and also became a verb for extracting ore.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以 stope 为不可再作常规拆分的词基，没有可独立识别的常用前后缀。名词和动词同形；复数或动词第三人称单数为 stopes，过去式和过去分词为 stoped，现在分词为 stoping（去掉词尾 e）；stoping 也作名词，指地下采场开采作业。相关组合：open-stope mining（空场采矿法）、stope back（采场顶板）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, stope is a base with no productive internal prefix or suffix. The noun and verb have the same form; inflections are stopes, stoped, and stoping, with final e dropped before -ing. Stoping also functions as a noun for underground ore extraction. Related combinations include open-stope mining and stope back, meaning the roof of a stope.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 名词近义词：excavation（开挖空间）范围最广，working（矿山作业区或巷道）不一定专指采矿石的空间；stope 特指地下采矿石的采场。动词近义词：mine（开采）适用范围更广，stope 强调在地下采场中开采。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the noun, excavation is broader, while a working can be a mine passage or another area of mining activity; stope specifically identifies an underground ore-extraction space. For the verb, mine is broader, whereas stope specifies extraction in underground stopes.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把可能的“台阶”来源联想到地下逐级采矿：采出的空间是 stope，开采这一空间的作业是 stoping。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the possible step origin with mining underground in stages: the excavation is a stope, and the extraction process is stoping.

forms: 可数名词；复数 budgerigars。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；budgerigar + keeping → budgerigar-keeping（饲养虎皮鹦鹉）。这是整词参与的复合表达。

etymology.text: 借自澳大利亚原住民语言中的鸟名，词典列出类似 betcherrygah 的形式，并认为可能来自加米拉雷语。确切语言和字面原义尚未完全确定；记住它是澳大利亚小鹦鹉的本土名字。

usage_note: 指原产澳大利亚的小型鹦鹉；日常英式英语中常说 budgie。

etymology_story.zh: budgerigar 借自澳大利亚原住民语言中的鸟名，早期记录有 betcherrygah 等拼写，通常与加米拉雷语联系起来。具体借入路径和原名的字面含义仍有争议，不宜将其确定解释为“好吃”。
etymology_story.en: Budgerigar was borrowed from an Australian Aboriginal bird name, recorded in early spellings such as betcherrygah and commonly associated with Gamilaraay. The precise borrowing route and literal meaning remain disputed, so the popular interpretation 'good to eat' should not be treated as established.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：budgerigar 是整体借入的简单词，不能按英语词根词缀可靠拆分；复数为 budgerigars。常用缩略形式是 budgie，复数为 budgies。相关复合表达包括 budgerigar breeder（虎皮鹦鹉繁育者）和 budgerigar-keeping（虎皮鹦鹉饲养）；没有常用的独立动词或形容词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: budgerigar is a borrowed simple word with no reliable English root-and-affix breakdown; its plural is budgerigars. The familiar shortened form is budgie, plural budgies. Related compounds include budgerigar breeder and budgerigar-keeping; there are no usual independent verb or adjective derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: budgie（虎皮鹦鹉）是日常口语中的直接对应词；parakeet（长尾小鹦鹉）范围更广，但在美国日常用语中常指虎皮鹦鹉；parrot（鹦鹉）是涵盖更多种类的上位词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Budgie is the familiar everyday equivalent. Parakeet is broader, though in everyday American usage it often means a budgerigar. Parrot is the wider category containing many other kinds of bird.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 本土鸟名整体记：澳大利亚的小型长尾鹦鹉，日常昵称 budgie。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the borrowed bird name as a whole: a small Australian parrot with a long tail, familiarly called a budgie.

pronunciation.note: 美式读音；音标采用 IPA。

forms: 规范展示拼写为 Tampax；品牌名通常不加复数词尾，多个产品可说 Tampax tampons。
family: tampon 卫生棉条；Tampax 是其品牌之一。

morphology.text: Tampax 是英语商标名，整词作为独立词素记忆；Tampax + tampon → Tampax tampon（丹碧丝品牌卫生棉条）。这是品牌名与产品名组成的复合表达；Tampax 本身不可硬拆成词根词缀。

etymology.text: 这是英语商标名。Oxford 将其解释为以 tampon（卫生棉条）为基础任意创制的名称，可通过 tampon 记住产品类别；名称的后半部分不是通用英语后缀。

usage_note: 品牌名首字母大写，写 Tampax。本课指该品牌的卫生棉条；泛指产品类别时用 tampon 更准确。

etymology_story.zh: Tampax 是以 tampon（卫生棉条）为基础创制的商标名称，后来也可借指该品牌的产品。其后半部分不是具有固定意义的通用英语后缀。
etymology_story.en: Tampax was coined as a trademark based on tampon and subsequently came to refer to products sold under that brand. Its final element is not an ordinary English suffix with a fixed meaning.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：Tampax 是不可按通用词根词缀分析的专有品牌名，标准写法首字母大写。没有常用的派生词族；产品通常写作 a Tampax tampon（一支丹碧丝卫生棉条）或 Tampax tampons（丹碧丝卫生棉条），复数标记加在产品名 tampon 上。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: Tampax is a proprietary brand name without a productive root-and-affix analysis and is normally capitalized. It has no usual derivative family; products are commonly described as a Tampax tampon or Tampax tampons, with plural marking on tampon.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tampon（卫生棉条）是对应产品类别的通用名称，不限定品牌；sanitary pad（卫生巾）和 menstrual cup（月经杯）是相关经期用品，分别采用体外吸收和体内收集的方式，并非 Tampax 的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tampon is the generic product term and does not specify a brand. Sanitary pad and menstrual cup name related menstrual products that absorb externally and collect internally, respectively; they are not synonyms for Tampax.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Tampax 联想到 tampon：品牌名连接产品类别，后半部分无需硬拆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link Tampax to tampon: remember the brand through its product category without forcing a meaning onto the ending.

family: chukka boot 踝靴；chukka 另可表示马球比赛的一节。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；chukka + boot → chukka boot（踝靴）。鞋名整体记忆，不把 chukka 的字母硬拆成英语词缀。

etymology.text: 英语把表示“马球比赛一节”的 chukka 用作这类靴子的名称。可以用“马球运动—短靴”的联系记忆；本课学的是靴子义。

usage_note: 本课只教鞋类义，通常指鞋帮到脚踝、有少量鞋带孔的靴子；马球赛一节是另一义项。

etymology_story.zh: chukka 表示马球比赛的一节，来自印地语 cakkar，意为“圈、轮次”，最终可追溯到梵语 cakra（轮、圆圈）。短靴名称 chukka boot 后来沿用了这一马球术语。
etymology_story.en: Chukka, a period in polo, comes from Hindi cakkar, meaning a circle or round, ultimately from Sanskrit cakra, meaning a wheel or circle. The later footwear name chukka boot adopted this polo term.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：chukka 是整体借入的简单词，无可按英语规则拆分的词缀；复数为 chukkas。chukker 是马球义的另一种拼写。chukka + boot → chukka boot（丘卡靴），复数为 chukka boots；鞋类语境中可简写为 chukkas。没有常用的动词或形容词派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: chukka is a borrowed simple word without productive English affixes; its plural is chukkas. Chukker is an alternative spelling for the polo sense. Chukka + boot forms chukka boot, plural chukka boots, often shortened to chukkas in footwear contexts. There is no usual family of derived verbs or adjectives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 马球义：period（比赛的一节）是通用说法，chukka 是马球专用术语。鞋类义：ankle boot（及踝靴）范围更广；desert boot（沙漠靴）通常指绒面革鞋面、绉胶底的一类丘卡靴，并不涵盖所有 chukkas。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In polo, period is the general equivalent, while chukka is the sport-specific term. In footwear, ankle boot is broader; desert boot usually identifies a type of chukka with a suede upper and crepe sole, rather than every chukka.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “一圈、一轮”连接马球的一节；再由马球术语连接同名及踝短靴。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A circle becomes a round of play: remember the polo period first, then connect it to the ankle boot bearing the same name.

etymology.text: 词典认为 fug 可能是英语 fog（雾）的变体。把室内混浊不散的空气想成一团闷人的“雾”，有助于记住它；这条词源仍带有不确定性。

usage_note: 多用于英式英语，常描写通风不良房间里的烟气、热气或混浊空气。

etymology_story.zh: fug 的来源不确定，通常被认为可能是 fog（雾）的变体。其意义集中于封闭空间中闷热、污浊而不流通的空气，后来也用作表示形成这种空气状态的动词。
etymology_story.en: The origin of fug is uncertain, though it is often considered a possible alteration of fog. It came to describe warm, stale air in an enclosed space and also developed a verb use for producing or entering that condition.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：fug 是简单词，名词与动词同形。动词变化为 fugs、fugged、fugging，后两者双写 g；fug + -y → fuggy（闷热污浊的），也双写 g，比较级和最高级为 fuggier、fuggiest；fuggy + -ness → fugginess（闷浊）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: fug is a simple word used as both noun and verb. Verb forms are fugs, fugged, and fugging, with g doubled in the latter two. Fug + -y forms fuggy, meaning warm and stuffy, again doubling g; its comparative and superlative are fuggier and fuggiest. Fuggy + -ness forms fugginess.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: stuffiness（闷、不通风）强调空气不流通，不一定有烟雾；haze（薄雾、烟霭）强调可见的悬浮物，不一定闷热；烟雾义的 smog（烟雾污染）通常指室外空气污染。fug 则常把室内的闷热、污浊和异味结合起来。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Stuffiness emphasizes poor ventilation without necessarily implying smoke. Haze emphasizes visible suspended particles without necessarily implying warmth. Smog usually describes outdoor air pollution. Fug commonly combines indoor warmth, stale air, and unpleasant smells.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 fug 想成被关在室内、带着热气和异味的一团 fog：雾感加闷感。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture fog trapped indoors with warmth and stale smells: a fog-like atmosphere that feels stuffy.

etymology_story.zh: ordo 经中世纪拉丁语进入英语，源头是意为“次序、秩序”的拉丁语 ordō；教会用它指按规定次序安排的礼仪，以及逐日列出礼仪安排的年度指南。参见[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ordo)与[柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/ordo)。
etymology_story.en: Ordo entered English through Medieval Latin from Latin ordō, meaning 'order'; its church uses concern the ordered arrangement of worship and the annual guide prescribing daily observances. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ordo) and [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/ordo).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作常用词缀拆分的借词：ordo；复数为 ordos 或拉丁式 ordines。没有常用的英语派生词族；liturgical ordo（礼仪规程）是词组，不能把 -o 当作英语后缀。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, ordo is an unanalyzed loanword with no productive English prefix or suffix. Its plurals are ordos and the Latin form ordines; it has no common English derivative family, and liturgical ordo is a phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: liturgical calendar（礼仪年历）侧重日期和节期；directory（指南）泛指提供规则或指示的手册；order of service（礼拜程序）侧重一次礼仪的进行顺序。ordo 是教会专门用语，可指年度指南或礼仪规程。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A liturgical calendar emphasizes dates and observances; a directory is a broader guide containing instructions; an order of service gives the sequence of one service. Ordo is a specialist church term for an annual guide or a prescribed liturgical arrangement.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“次序”：把礼仪按全年日期或举行步骤排好，就是 ordo。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think 'order': worship arranged by the days of the year or by the steps of a service.

etymology.text: 借自意大利语 alla primavera，意思是“春天风格”，其中 primavera 就是“春天”。想象春天新鲜蔬菜做成的面食，就能记住烹饪中的这个形容词。

usage_note: 烹饪用语，多放在 pasta 等菜名后，表示配有多种鲜蔬；不保证一定是纯素菜。

etymology_story.zh: primavera 借自意大利语 alla primavera，意为“春天风格的”，其中 primavera 表示“春天”，更早可追溯至拉丁语中表示“初春”的表达。英语烹饪用法由春天联想到鲜蔬，但并不限定只能使用当季春蔬。参见[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/primavera)。
etymology_story.en: Primavera comes from Italian alla primavera, 'in the style of springtime'; Italian primavera means 'spring' and ultimately reflects a Latin expression for early spring. The English culinary meaning evokes fresh vegetables without requiring exclusively seasonal spring produce. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/primavera).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语构词：primavera，作为完整意大利语借词使用，没有能产的英语词缀拆分，也没有常用英语派生词族。通常后置于菜名，如 pasta + primavera；词源中的“最初”和“春天”属于历史分析，不是现代英语构词公式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: primavera, borrowed intact from Italian, with no productive English affixation or common English derivative family. It usually follows a dish name, as in pasta + primavera; the historical elements meaning 'first' and 'spring' are not a modern English formation.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: vegetable-based（以蔬菜为主的）强调主要原料；vegetarian（素食的）强调不含肉类或鱼类；spring-style（春日风格的）只是宽泛描述。primavera 专指配多种鲜蔬的烹饪方式，本身不保证整道菜符合素食要求。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Vegetable-based emphasizes the main ingredients; vegetarian excludes meat and fish; spring-style is a loose description. Primavera specifically indicates preparation with mixed fresh vegetables and does not by itself guarantee that every ingredient is vegetarian.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 春天 → 多彩鲜蔬 → primavera 菜式。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Spring → colorful fresh vegetables → a primavera dish.

etymology_story.zh: mim 一般被解释为模仿抿嘴动作或抿嘴说话的摹拟性词语，继而表示由这种姿态传达的矜持或做作。其副词和动词用法见于苏格兰语资料，不能视为通用英语常用词性。参见[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mim)及[苏格兰语词典](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/mim)。
etymology_story.en: Mim is generally explained as an imitative formation associated with pursing the lips or speaking through pursed lips, hence restrained or affected behavior. Its adverb and verb uses are recorded in Scots and are not common general-English uses. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mim) and [Dictionaries of the Scots Language](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/mim).

morphology_enriched.zh: mim 是简单词干；形容词比较级、最高级为 mimmer、mimmest。方言词族包括 mim + -ly/-lie → mimly/mimlie（拘谨地），mim + -ness → mimness（拘谨、假正经），以及 mim-mouthed（说话故作端庄的）、mim-spoken（说话拘谨的）、mimmery（做作的端庄举止）；这些形式均不属普通高频词汇。
morphology_enriched.en: Mim is a simple stem; its comparative and superlative are mimmer and mimmest. Its dialectal family includes mim + -ly/-lie → mimly/mimlie, 'primly'; mim + -ness → mimness, 'prudishness'; mim-mouthed, 'affectedly prim in speech'; mim-spoken, 'restrained in speech'; and mimmery, 'affected primness.' These are not ordinary high-frequency vocabulary.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: prim（拘谨古板的）强调过分讲究规矩；demure（文静矜持的）可以是真诚而自然的；coy（故作羞怯的）常带有欲迎还拒或卖关子的意味。mim 带鲜明地域色彩，常含抿嘴装端庄的意味。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Prim suggests excessive concern with propriety; demure can describe naturally quiet modesty; coy often suggests deliberately displayed shyness or reluctance. Mim is regionally marked and often evokes an affectedly prim, pursed-lip manner.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抿起嘴，装端庄：由嘴部姿态记住 mim。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Purse the lips and look prim: the mouth gesture anchors mim.

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；hod + carrier → hod carrier（扛砖灰斗的工人）。整词与 carrier 组成实际职业名称。

usage_note: 本课指建筑工地上肩扛的长柄砖灰斗；hod 另有煤斗义，须按语境区分。

etymology_story.zh: hod 的来源并不确定；一种解释认为它可能来自中古荷兰语 hodde，另一种解释将其联系到古法语 hotte“背篓”。其英语意义围绕承载物料的容器展开，包括工地砖灰斗和家用煤斗。参见[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hod)与[柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/hod)。
etymology_story.en: The origin of hod is uncertain: one account suggests Middle Dutch hodde, while another connects it with Old French hotte, 'pannier.' Its English meanings concern containers for carrying materials, including builders' hods and household coal containers. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hod) and [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/hod).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语构词：hod，为不可再分析的简单词干；复数 hods。相关复合词包括 hod + carrier → hod carrier/hod-carrier（扛砖灰斗的工人），hod + carrying → hod-carrying（扛砖灰斗的工作），coal + hod → coal hod（煤斗）；没有常用的前后缀派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: hod, an unanalyzed simple stem; plural hods. Related compounds include hod + carrier → hod carrier/hod-carrier, a worker carrying building materials; hod + carrying → hod-carrying, that work; and coal + hod → coal hod. There is no common family formed with prefixes or suffixes.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: coal scuttle（煤斗）与 hod 的盛煤义接近；trough（槽）强调细长敞口形状，不一定用于搬运；bucket（桶）通常靠提手搬运。建筑用 hod 的识别特征是长柄和肩扛方式。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Coal scuttle closely matches the coal-container sense; trough emphasizes an elongated open container without implying transport; bucket usually suggests a vessel carried by a handle. A builder's hod is distinguished by its long pole and shoulder-carrying design.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 hod 想成“装料的斗”：工地装砖灰，炉边装煤。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a load-carrying container: bricks on the building site, coal beside the fire.

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；attar + maker → attar-maker（花精油制作者）。这是完整借词参与的复合表达。

etymology.text: 经波斯语的香气词而来，词典联系波斯语 ʽaṭir（芬芳的）与阿拉伯语 ʽiṭr（香料）。沿着“芬芳—香料”的线索，可以记住这种浓香的花精油。

usage_note: 通常指从花瓣提取的芳香精油，常见 attar of roses；不是任何带香味的水都叫 attar。

etymology_story.zh: attar 经波斯语传入英语，词源与阿拉伯语 ʿiṭr“香料、香水”有关。英语中它主要指花中提取的芳香精油，也可由香油转指香气本身。参见[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/attar)。
etymology_story.en: Attar reached English through Persian and is ultimately associated with Arabic ʿiṭr, 'perfume.' In English it chiefly denotes fragrant oil extracted from flowers and can also extend from the scented substance to its fragrance. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/attar).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语构词：attar，为完整借词，不能拆成有意义的英语前后缀。通常作不可数名词，表示不同品种时可用复数 attars；异体拼写包括 otto、ottar。rose attar（玫瑰精油）和 attar-maker（花精油制作者）是复合表达，没有常用英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: attar, an intact loanword without meaningful English prefixes or suffixes. It is usually a mass noun, with attars available for varieties; spelling variants include otto and ottar. Rose attar and attar-maker are compound expressions, and there is no common English derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: essential oil（精油）范围更广，可来自植物的多种部位；perfume（香水、香料）泛指用于增香的制品，可能含酒精；fragrance（香气）主要指气味。attar 通常强调花源浓香油，尤与玫瑰精油相关。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Essential oil is broader and may come from many plant parts; perfume is a scented preparation that may contain alcohol; fragrance primarily denotes a smell. Attar usually emphasizes concentrated floral perfume oil, especially rose oil.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一滴油，浓缩一朵花的香：attar。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A flower's fragrance concentrated into a drop of oil: attar.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆；blat + -ing → blatting（正在咩咩叫，双写 t）。这是动词的现在分词形式。

etymology.text: 词典认为可能是英语 bleat（咩咩叫）的变体。两词都让人联想到羊或小牛的叫声；这条变化关系属于可能的词源解释。

usage_note: 较少见的动词；本课指羊或小牛的咩咩叫声。另有大声乱嚷、脱口说出等义，本课不考。
