etymology_story.zh: 鼓乐义很可能源于拟声，模仿两下紧挨着的鼓击；“骗局、欺骗”这一组意义则通常被解释为 flimflam 的缩略形式，不能断言两组意义有共同来源。参见[《韦氏词典》的鼓乐词源](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/flam)及[《柯林斯词典》的两组词义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/flam)。
etymology_story.en: The drumming word is probably imitative of two closely spaced strikes; the deception word is generally explained as a shortening of flimflam. The two groups of meanings should not be assumed to share one origin. See [Merriam-Webster on the drumming origin](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/flam) and [Collins on the separate entries](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/flam).

morphology_enriched.zh: flam 是单纯词，鼓乐名词可零派生为动词；复数及第三人称单数为 flams，过去式和过去分词为 flammed，现在分词为 flamming，添加后缀时双写 m。常见专业组合有 flam accent（双击重音练习）、flam tap（双击后接单击的基本鼓法）、flam paradiddle（带双击装饰音的复合鼓法）；flimflam 与欺骗义有关，不能分析成现代英语 flim- + flam。鼓乐动词用法参见[伦敦鼓乐课程](https://www.hwdrumstudio.com/post/the-flam-drum-lessons-london)。
morphology_enriched.en: Flam is a simple base, and its drumming noun also functions as a verb by conversion. Its plural and third-person singular are flams; the past tense and past participle are flammed, and the present participle is flamming, with doubled m. Technical compounds include flam accent, flam tap, and flam paradiddle. Flimflam is related to the deception sense, but flim- is not a productive modern prefix. For the drumming verb, see [Drum Lessons London](https://www.hwdrumstudio.com/post/the-flam-drum-lessons-london).

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 鼓乐比较项：double stroke（双击）通常指同一只手连续敲两下，flam 通常由两只手奏出紧邻的轻、重两击；drag（拖音鼓法）通常在主音前加两个装饰音。欺骗义近义词 trick（骗局）泛指欺骗手段，flam 带旧式或方言色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In drumming, a double stroke usually consists of two strokes with the same hand, whereas a flam normally uses alternating hands for a grace stroke and a main stroke; a drag usually has two grace strokes before the main note. For deception, trick is a general word, while flam is dated or dialectal.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 鼓乐义：轻一下，紧接重一下；欺骗义：联想 flimflam，另线记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: For drumming: a little stroke immediately before a big one. For deception: connect it separately with flimflam.

etymology_story.zh: 借自意大利语 duce（领袖），上溯拉丁语 dux（领袖、统帅），与 ducere（引领）相关。英语中尤其与墨索里尼的称号 Il Duce 相联系，因而带有明确的历史政治色彩。参见[《柯林斯词典》](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/duce)。
etymology_story.en: Borrowed from Italian duce, meaning 'leader', it ultimately comes from Latin dux, meaning 'leader' or 'commander', related to ducere, 'to lead'. In English it is particularly associated with Mussolini's title Il Duce and therefore carries a specific historical and political context. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/duce).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借入的名词，不拆作 du- + -ce；复数可见 duces 或保留意大利语形式 duci。Il 是意大利语定冠词，Il + Duce 表示“这位领袖”，作为历史称号通常大写。没有常用的直接英语派生词；duke（公爵）和 doge（威尼斯或热那亚的总督）是同源借词，duc-/duct-（引领）也见于更广的拉丁语源词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, duce is a whole-word loan, not du- + -ce; recorded plurals include duces and Italian duci. Il is the Italian definite article, so Il + Duce means 'the leader', normally capitalized as the historical title. There are no common direct English derivatives. Duke and doge are historical relatives, and duc-/duct-, meaning 'lead', occurs in a wider Latin-derived family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: leader（领导者）语义最广，通常中性；dictator（独裁者）强调不受有效制约的统治权；autocrat（专制统治者）强调权力集中于一人。duce 尤其唤起意大利法西斯主义及墨索里尼的历史背景。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Leader is broad and usually neutral; dictator emphasizes rule without effective constraints; autocrat emphasizes power concentrated in one person. Duce especially evokes Italian Fascism and Mussolini.

mnemonic_anchor.en: 'Lead' → 'leader'; Il Duce anchors the word to its Italian historical title.

etymology_story.zh: 通常追溯至中古荷兰语或低地德语中表示木片、木钉、桩的词，与荷兰语 spijl 有关。小木钉的形态连接了“堵孔木塞”“支撑木桩”和“插孔导液管”等用途。参见[《柯林斯词典》](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/spile)及[Wordsmyth 的名词、动词释义](https://www.wordsmyth.net/?ac=5830&mode=fmfree&rid=39812)。
etymology_story.en: The word is generally traced to Middle Dutch or Low German words for a splinter, wooden pin, or stake, related to Dutch spijl. The pin-like shape connects its uses as a vent plug, supporting stake, and inserted sap spout. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/spile) and [Wordsmyth's noun and verb entries](https://www.wordsmyth.net/?ac=5830&mode=fmfree&rid=39812).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以 spile 为完整词基，名词可零派生为动词。spile + -s → spiles（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）；去末尾不发音的 e 后加 -ed、-ing → spiled、spiling。相关组合有 spile hole／spile-hole（塞栓孔、通气孔）、sap spile（树液导管）；没有常用的形容词或副词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats spile as a complete base, with noun-to-verb conversion. Spile + -s gives spiles, the noun plural or third-person singular verb; dropping final silent e before -ed and -ing gives spiled and spiling. Related combinations include spile hole or spile-hole and sap spile. There are no common adjective or adverb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: spout（导流嘴）突出液体流出的通道；spigot（塞栓、龙头）突出桶或容器的出液装置；pile（桩）突出承重支撑。spile 可对应这些不同用途，但具体所指必须结合采液、酿酒或工程语境判断。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Spout emphasizes a channel for liquid; spigot usually denotes a plug or outlet on a container; pile emphasizes structural support. Spile overlaps with each in different contexts, so its interpretation depends on whether the topic is sap collection, brewing, or construction.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a rod inserted into a hole or the ground: it can plug, channel liquid, or support.

etymology_story.zh: 直接借自拉丁语 domus（房屋、家），在英语历史与考古语境中用于古罗马或中世纪住宅；古罗马建筑分类中尤其指富裕家庭的独户住宅。参见[《韦氏词典》](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/domus)及[盖蒂艺术与建筑词库](https://www.getty.edu/vow/AATFullDisplay?find=300310162&logic=AND&note=&subjectid=300005506)。
etymology_story.en: Borrowed directly from Latin domus, meaning 'house' or 'home', the English term denotes an ancient Roman or medieval dwelling. In Roman architectural classification it particularly identifies a substantial private house for a wealthy household. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/domus) and the [Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus](https://www.getty.edu/vow/AATFullDisplay?find=300310162&logic=AND&note=&subjectid=300005506).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借词，不把 -us 当作英语派生后缀；标准词典所列复数仍为 domus。没有常用的直接派生词。与其同源的家庭、居住词族包括 domestic（家庭的）、domestically（在家庭方面；在国内）、domesticity（家庭生活）、domesticate（驯化）、domestication（驯化）、domicile（住所）、domiciliary（居家的）；dome（穹顶）也是经其他语言传入的历史同源词，并非 domus 的现代直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Domus is an unsegmented English loanword; -us is not an English derivational suffix here, and the dictionary plural remains domus. There are no common direct derivatives. Historical relatives concerning home and residence include domestic, domestically, domesticity, domesticate, domestication, domicile, and domiciliary. Dome is another historical relative borrowed through other languages, rather than a direct modern derivative of domus.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: house（房屋）是最普通、时代不限的名称；villa（别墅、庄园住宅）在古罗马语境中通常指乡间住宅或庄园；residence（住宅、府邸）较正式。domus 突出特定历史建筑类型，尤其是古罗马城市独户住宅。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: House is the ordinary term without a historical restriction; villa usually denotes a country house or estate in Roman contexts; residence is more formal. Domus identifies a historical building type, especially the Roman urban private house.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: dom- 联想到“家”：domestic 是“家庭的”，domus 是古人的住宅。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect dom- with 'home': domestic concerns the home, and a domus is a historical home.

etymology_story.zh: 由哲学家 H. Paul Grice 的姓氏 Grice 加表示归属或关联的后缀 -an 构成。该词用于指称他的思想及其理论传统，尤其涉及说话者意义、合作原则和会话含义。
etymology_story.en: The word was formed from the surname of philosopher H. Paul Grice with the relational suffix -an. It identifies his ideas and the theoretical tradition associated with them, especially speaker meaning, the cooperative principle, and conversational implicature.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：Grice（人名）+ -an（与……有关的；……学派的人）→ Gricean，保留姓氏末尾的 e。名词复数为 Griceans；相关构词包括 Griceanism（格赖斯主义）、neo-Gricean（新格赖斯学派的）、post-Gricean（后格赖斯学派的）和 non-Gricean（非格赖斯式的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: Grice, a personal name, + -an, meaning 'associated with' or 'an adherent of,' produces Gricean, retaining the final e. The noun plural is Griceans; related formations include Griceanism, neo-Gricean, post-Gricean, and non-Gricean.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有完全对应的普通近义词。pragmatic（语用学的）范围更广；neo-Gricean（新格赖斯学派的）指对格赖斯理论的特定发展；post-Gricean（后格赖斯学派的）指在其思想基础上进一步发展或作出修正的理论。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact everyday synonym. Pragmatic covers a broader field; neo-Gricean identifies particular developments of Grice's theories; post-Gricean describes approaches that develop or revise his intellectual legacy.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Grice + -an：格赖斯的理论，研究“话外之意”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Grice + -an: Grice's approach to what speakers mean beyond what they say.

etymology_story.zh: 表示爱尔兰土堡的 rath 借自爱尔兰语 ráth，指土垒或设有土垒的围护地。表示印度神像车的同形词来源不同，经南亚语言追溯至梵语 ratha，意为“战车、车辆”。
etymology_story.en: The Irish archaeological word comes from Irish ráth, meaning an earthen rampart or an enclosure protected by one. The identically spelled Indian word has a separate origin, reaching English through South Asian languages from Sanskrit ratha, meaning 'chariot' or 'vehicle.'

morphology_enriched.zh: 两个义项都是整词借入，现代英语中均不宜拆成词根和词缀；复数都是 raths。rath site（土堡遗址）和 ceremonial rath（仪式用神像车）是短语，不是派生词；没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Both senses are whole-word borrowings without a useful modern English root-and-affix breakdown; both have the plural raths. Rath site and ceremonial rath are phrases rather than derivatives, and neither sense has a common productive family of derived words.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ringfort（环形堡址）与爱尔兰考古义最接近，但也可包括石墙围护的遗址；earthwork（土方遗构）范围更广。chariot（战车、仪式车）对应印度义，但本身不限定宗教巡游用途。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ringfort is the closest archaeological equivalent, though it can also include stone-walled enclosures; earthwork is a broader term for structures made from earth. Chariot corresponds to the Indian sense but does not itself specify religious processions.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 爱尔兰义记“土垒围成一圈”；印度义记“神像乘车巡游”，两词同形而不同源。
mnemonic_anchor.en: For Ireland, picture a ring of earth around a settlement; for India, picture a deity's procession chariot: one spelling, two origins.

senses.meaning_zh: 从；来自；自……起〔苏格兰语及苏格兰方言用语〕
senses.meaning_en: From; indicating origin, separation, or a starting point in Scots and Scottish dialect.
senses.english_definition: In Scots and Scottish dialect, frae means from and indicates where something begins, comes from, or moves away from.
senses.collocation_en: frae Scotland; far frae hame
senses.collocation_zh: 来自苏格兰；远离家乡
senses.sentence_en: She came frae a small village near the coast.
senses.sentence_zh: 她来自海岸附近的一个小村庄。

etymology_story.zh: frae 延续了中古英语北部及苏格兰语中表示“从”的形式，与古诺尔斯语 frá 有历史联系。它与标准英语 from 意义相对应，至今保留在苏格兰语、方言和相关文学表达中。
etymology_story.en: Frae continues northern Middle English and Scots forms meaning 'from' and is historically connected with Old Norse frá. It corresponds in meaning to standard English from and survives in Scots, dialect speech, and associated literary writing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形态：frae 是不可再作实用拆分的介词，无屈折变化，也没有常用的派生词族。from 是其标准英语对应词，不是由 frae 派生而来；frae hame（从家中；离家）属于短语。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern morphology: frae is an unanalyzable preposition with no inflected forms or common productive derivatives. From is its standard English equivalent, not a derivative of frae; frae hame, meaning 'from home,' is a phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: from（从、来自）是最直接的标准英语对应词；out of（从……里面出来）强调内部来源；since（自……以来）只在部分表示时间起点的语境中相近，不能普遍替换 frae。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: From is the direct standard English equivalent; out of emphasizes movement or origin from an interior; since overlaps only in some contexts involving a starting point in time and cannot generally replace frae.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 frae 与 from 配对：都指向来源或起点。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pair frae with from: both point back to a source or starting point.

senses.meaning_zh: 常用对数的非负小数部分；对数尾数
senses.meaning_en: The nonnegative fractional part of a common logarithm.
senses.english_definition: The mantissa of a common logarithm is the fractional part left after the logarithm is written as an integer plus a number from zero up to, but not including, one.

senses.meaning_zh: 浮点数或科学记数法中的有效数部分〔亦称 significand〕
senses.meaning_en: The significand of a number expressed in floating-point or scientific notation.
senses.english_definition: In computing, the mantissa is the part of a floating-point representation that supplies the significant digits, while the exponent determines their scale.
senses.collocation_en: mantissa and exponent; mantissa bits
senses.collocation_zh: 尾数与指数；尾数位
senses.sentence_en: For the number written as 6.25 × 10³, the mantissa, in this usage, is 6.25.

etymology_story.zh: 来自拉丁语 mantisa 或 mantissa，原指“添加物、补足分量的东西”，其更早来源通常被认为可能与伊特鲁里亚语有关。该词后来用于对数的小数部分，并进一步用于浮点表示中的有效数部分。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Latin mantisa or mantissa, meaning an addition or something added to make up a quantity, with a possible earlier Etruscan origin. It was later applied to the fractional part of a logarithm and subsequently to the significand in floating-point notation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形态：mantissa 是整体借入的名词，不宜硬拆成英语词根和词缀。复数为 mantissas，也可用拉丁式复数 mantissae；mantissa bit（尾数位）、mantissa field（尾数字段）属于复合表达，没有常用的其他派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern morphology: mantissa is a borrowed noun without a useful English root-and-affix breakdown. Its plurals are mantissas and the Latin-style mantissae; mantissa bit and mantissa field are compound expressions, and there are no other common derived forms.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fractional part（小数部分）对应对数义，但必须明确所指的是对数的小数部分；significand（有效数）是浮点义中更精确、歧义更少的术语；coefficient（系数）在科学记数法中可指同一部分，但适用范围更广。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fractional part matches the logarithmic sense when the logarithm is explicitly identified; significand is the more precise and less ambiguous term for the floating-point sense; coefficient can identify the same component in scientific notation but has a much broader mathematical use.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 原义是“补上的部分”：对数中记整数后的尾数；计算机中另记“有效数 × 底数的指数次幂”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with 'an added part': in logarithms, remember the fractional remainder; in computing, remember significand × base to an exponent.

etymology_story.zh: 中古英语经法语形式如 egremoine 借入，追溯至拉丁语 agrimonia，并与拉丁语 argemonia、希腊语 argemōnē 这一植物名称有关。古代名称所指的植物与现代龙芽草并不完全相同，名称在流传过程中发生了转用。
etymology_story.en: Middle English borrowed the word through French forms such as egremoine, ultimately tracing it to Latin agrimonia and its connection with Latin argemonia and Greek argemōnē, a plant name. The ancient name did not identify exactly the same plant as modern agrimony and was transferred during its history.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形态：agrimony 是整体借入的植物名，不能按 agri-（农业）等现代词素硬拆。作可数名词时复数为 agrimonies；common agrimony（普通龙芽草）和 fragrant agrimony（香龙芽草）是植物名称组合，Agrimonia 是相关的拉丁属名；没有常用的英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern morphology: agrimony is a borrowed plant name and should not be artificially divided into elements such as agri-, meaning 'agriculture.' Its countable plural is agrimonies; common agrimony and fragrant agrimony are plant-name combinations, while Agrimonia is the related Latin genus name; there is no common productive English derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: common agrimony（普通龙芽草）明确指 Agrimonia eupatoria，比可泛指整个属的 agrimony 更具体；church steeples（俗名，字面义为“教堂尖塔”）和 sticklewort（俗名）也可指普通龙芽草，但地域性较强，精确识别宜用学名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Common agrimony specifically identifies Agrimonia eupatoria and is narrower than agrimony when the latter refers to the genus generally. Church steeples and sticklewort are vernacular names for common agrimony, but their use is regional; the scientific name gives the clearest identification.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整词联想一幅图：细长花穗，一串黄花。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the whole word through one image: a slender spike carrying a string of yellow flowers.

etymology_story.zh: 借自法语 allée，原指通道或步道，来自 aller（走、去）的过去分词形式。英语主要保留其园林用法，指两侧整齐植树或种植灌木的步道。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from French allée, meaning a passage or walkway, formed from the past participle of aller, meaning 'to go.' English mainly uses it for a landscaped walk bordered by orderly rows of trees or shrubs.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步拆分的借入名词，不含英语前缀或后缀；也拼作 allée，复数为 allees 或 allées。没有常用的派生词族；tree-lined allee（林荫步道）和 allee planting（林荫道栽植）是短语组合，不是派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, allee is an unanalyzed borrowed noun with no English prefix or suffix; the spelling allée is also used, with plurals allees or allées. It has no established common derivative family; tree-lined allee and allee planting are phrase combinations rather than derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: avenue（林荫大道）通常更宽，也可供车辆通行；walk（步道）只强调供人行走；promenade（散步道）强调休闲漫步，而 allee 特别突出两侧植物排列整齐的园林布局。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: An avenue is often broader and may carry vehicles; a walk simply provides a pedestrian route; a promenade emphasizes leisurely strolling, while an allee specifically suggests an orderly landscaped passage between rows of vegetation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从法语“走、去”联想到“一条供人走过两排树之间的路”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect its French origin, 'to go,' with going down a path between two orderly rows of trees.

senses.meaning_en: A target-ball sport, especially the Paralympic sport, in which players aim balls as close as possible to a smaller target ball.
senses.english_definition: Boccia is a sport in which players throw, roll, or use a ramp to send balls as close as possible to a small target ball.

senses.sentence_zh: 在硬地滚球比赛中，她借助斜槽将自己的球送到目标球附近。

etymology_story.zh: 借自意大利语 boccia，意为“球”，其意大利语复数形式是 bocce。现代英语中的 boccia 尤指为有严重身体障碍的运动员发展起来的目标球运动，与 bocce 有历史联系，但两者的规则和器材不同。
etymology_story.en: Boccia comes from Italian boccia, meaning 'ball,' whose Italian plural is bocce. In modern English, boccia especially names a target-ball sport developed for athletes with severe physical impairments; it is historically related to bocce but has different rules and equipment.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 boccia 作为完整的借入名词使用，不拆分为英语词根和词缀；作为运动名称，通常不可数。没有常用的英语派生词族；boccia player（硬地滚球运动员）和 boccia ball（硬地滚球用球）是名词组合，bocce 则是相关的另一英语运动名称。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats boccia as a complete borrowed noun without English roots or affixes; as the name of a sport, it is normally uncountable. It has no common English derivative family; boccia player and boccia ball are noun combinations, while bocce is a related but distinct English sport name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有完全等义的常用替换词：bocce（意式地滚球）是相关但规则不同的运动；bowls（草地滚球）通常使用具有偏转特性的球；boules（法式滚球类运动）是较宽泛的名称，均不宜直接替换残奥项目名称 boccia。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym: bocce is a related sport with different rules; bowls usually uses biased balls; boules is a broader term for French-style ball games. None directly replaces boccia as the name of the Paralympic sport.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 意大利语原义是“球”：记住把自己的球送到目标球旁边。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Its Italian source means 'ball': picture sending your ball beside the target ball.

etymology_story.zh: 来自法语 donjon，古法语中指城堡主塔，词源最终与拉丁语 dominus（主人、领主）有关。它与 dungeon 同源，但现代英语中 donjon 保留“主塔”义，而 dungeon 通常指地牢。
etymology_story.en: Donjon comes from French donjon, an Old French term for a castle's principal tower, ultimately related to Latin dominus, meaning 'master' or 'lord.' It shares its origin with dungeon, but donjon retains the tower meaning while dungeon usually means an underground prison.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是完整借入的单纯名词，不应拆成 don + jon；复数为 donjons。没有常用派生词；dungeon（地牢）是历史同源词，不是由现代 donjon 加词缀派生而来。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, donjon is a simple borrowed noun and should not be divided into don + jon; its plural is donjons. It has no common derivatives; dungeon is a historical doublet, not a word formed by adding an affix to modern donjon.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: keep（城堡主堡、主塔）是最接近的常用对应词；tower（塔）泛指各种塔楼；stronghold（据点、要塞）强调防御能力，通常指整个据点而非其中的一座主塔。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Keep is the closest common equivalent; tower is a general word for a tall structure; stronghold emphasizes a defended place and usually refers to an entire position rather than its principal tower.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 沿着“领主”这一词源记：领主居住和固守的城堡主塔。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical link to 'lord': the donjon is the lord's main residential and defensive tower.

etymology_story.zh: 生物学等技术义由希腊语来源的 iso-（相同）与 type（类型、模式）组合而成，体现“同类或同一模式”的概念。图像统计体系名称 Isotype 则是 International System of Typographic Picture Education 的缩略词，与奥托·纽拉特及其团队的图像信息设计工作有关。
etymology_story.en: The biological and other technical uses combine Greek-derived iso-, meaning 'equal' or 'same,' with type, expressing a shared class or pattern. The graphic system's name Isotype instead abbreviates International System of Typographic Picture Education and is associated with the information-design work of Otto Neurath and his team.

morphology_enriched.zh: 技术义的现代构词式为 iso-（相同）+ type（类型、模式）；图像体系专名 Isotype 则按缩略词理解。复数为 isotypes；主要同族词有 isotypic、isotypical（同种型的、同型的）、isotypically（以同型方式）、isotypy（同型性）和 isotyping（同种型鉴定）。
morphology_enriched.en: For the technical senses, the modern structure is iso- ('same') + type ('class or pattern'); the graphic-system name Isotype is understood as an acronym. The plural is isotypes; principal family members include isotypic and isotypical ('of the same type'), isotypically ('in an isotypic manner'), isotypy ('sameness of type'), and isotyping ('identification of an immunoglobulin isotype').

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pictogram（象形图符）不一定代表固定数量；class（类别）在免疫学中可对应较大的同种型类别，但 isotype 也可细分到亚类；duplicate type（重复模式标本）是植物学义的近似释义，必须满足与正模式来自同一次采集这一条件。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A pictogram need not represent a fixed quantity; class can name a major immunoglobulin isotype, while isotype may also refer to a subclass; duplicate type approximates the botanical meaning only when the specimen comes from the same gathering as the holotype.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用“同一类型或同一单位”串联：抗体按同类分组，标本来自同次采集，统计图符按相同单位重复。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link the senses through 'the same type or unit': antibodies share a class, specimens share a gathering, and chart symbols repeat the same numerical unit.

etymology_story.zh: 借自法语 muscadet，其名称在历史上与 musc（麝香）这一词族有关。如今这个名称主要指用勃艮第香瓜葡萄酿成的卢瓦尔河地区干白葡萄酒，并不意味着酒中必有麝香气味。
etymology_story.en: Borrowed from French muscadet, a name historically associated with the word family of musc, meaning 'musk.' Today it chiefly names a Loire dry white wine made from Melon de Bourgogne grapes, without implying that the wine necessarily smells musky.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整借词处理：Muscadet，不宜拆成英语词根和词缀。通常作不可数名词；指不同酒款时可用复数 Muscadets；Muscadet wine 是名词修饰名词的组合，没有常用的英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Muscadet is an unanalyzed loanword rather than an English root-plus-affix formation. It is usually uncountable, but Muscadets can refer to different wines; Muscadet wine is a noun modifying another noun, and there are no established common English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有完全等义的常用单词。dry white wine（干白葡萄酒）是上位表达；Loire white wine（卢瓦尔河白葡萄酒）范围更广；wine made from Melon de Bourgogne（勃艮第香瓜葡萄酿制的葡萄酒）说明原料，但不能单凭葡萄品种确定其为 Muscadet。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact one-word synonym. Dry white wine is a broader category; Loire white wine includes other regional whites; wine made from Melon de Bourgogne identifies the grape, but the grape alone does not establish that a wine is Muscadet.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史名称联想到“麝香”，现代所指锁定“卢瓦尔河干白”；不要把名称当成必有的香味。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let the historical name suggest 'musk,' but anchor the modern meaning to 'Loire dry white'; the name does not guarantee the aroma.

etymology_story.zh: 经法语 piastre 借入英语，源自意大利语 piastra，意为“金属薄片、板片”，后来也用于指硬币。这个名称先用于某些银币，随后又成为不同货币体系中的单位名称。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed piastre through French from Italian piastra, meaning a metal plate or sheet and subsequently a coin. The name was applied to certain silver coins and later to units in different monetary systems.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可继续分析的借词 piastre；复数为 piastres。piaster 是另一拼写，复数为 piasters；没有常用派生词，piastre coin 中的 piastre 作名词定语。

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Piaster is an alternative spelling of the same word. Coin names a physical object, whereas piastre can also name a unit of account; cent is a comparable small unit in other monetary systems, not an interchangeable equivalent.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Metal plate → minted coin → monetary unit: remember the movement from a physical object to a name for money.

senses.meaning_zh: 插接式适配器；为电脑等设备增加连接或其他功能的小型外接装置
senses.meaning_en: a small plug-in device that adds connectivity or another function

senses.meaning_zh: 软件加密狗；插入电脑以验证软件使用许可的硬件装置
senses.meaning_en: a hardware device required to authorize the use of software
senses.english_definition: A dongle is a small hardware device that must be connected to a computer before certain software can be used.
senses.collocation_en: a software protection dongle; a license dongle
senses.collocation_zh: 一个软件保护加密狗；一个软件许可加密狗

etymology_story.zh: 这是起源未定的英语计算机术语，可能与 dangle（悬挂、垂吊）有关，但这一解释尚不能确定。它早期用于软件保护硬件，后来也广泛指提供连接或其他功能的小型插接设备。
etymology_story.en: Dongle is a computing term of uncertain origin, possibly related to dangle, although that explanation is unconfirmed. It was used early for software-protection hardware and later became a broad term for small plug-in devices providing connectivity or other functions.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中把 dongle 作为单一词素处理，不能可靠地拆成 dong + -le；复数为 dongles。USB dongle、Bluetooth dongle 和 license dongle 是常见名词组合；没有需要掌握的常用标准派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats dongle as a single morpheme, not as a reliably analyzable dong + -le formation; its plural is dongles. USB dongle, Bluetooth dongle, and license dongle are common noun combinations; there is no established common derivational family to learn.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: adapter（适配器）强调接口或功能适配，不一定体积小或直接插接；receiver（接收器）强调接收信号，只适用于部分 dongle；hardware key（硬件密钥）强调授权或认证，对应安全用途。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Adapter emphasizes compatibility or conversion and need not be small or directly attached. Receiver emphasizes receiving signals and describes only some dongles; hardware key emphasizes authorization or authentication and fits security-related uses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 想象接口上挂着一个小装置：插上，就多一种功能；dangle 只作联想，不作确定词源。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a little device hanging from a port: plug it in and gain a function; use dangle as an association, not a proven origin.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆。slub + -ing → slubbing（牵伸并轻捻纤维）；拼写时双写 b。

etymology.text: 英语动词由 slubbing 逆构而来：人们把原有形式中的 -ing 去掉，形成动词 slub。把它与纺纱前对纤维的轻度处理联系起来。

senses.meaning_zh: 纱线上的粗节或不规则增粗部分，可天然形成或刻意制造
senses.meaning_en: a thick or uneven section in yarn, occurring naturally or made deliberately
senses.english_definition: A slub is a thick part of a thread or yarn that may occur naturally or be made deliberately to give fabric texture.
senses.collocation_en: slub yarn; natural slubs
senses.collocation_zh: 竹节纱；天然粗节
senses.sentence_en: The natural slubs give the silk an uneven texture.
senses.sentence_zh: 这些天然粗节使丝绸呈现出不均匀的纹理。

senses.meaning_zh: 将纤维束初步牵伸并轻度加捻，为进一步纺纱作准备
senses.meaning_en: to draw out and loosely twist fibers in preparation for spinning
senses.english_definition: When fibers are slubbed, they are drawn out and given a slight twist before they are spun further.
senses.collocation_en: slub wool; slub the fibers
senses.collocation_zh: 将羊毛初步牵伸并轻捻；将纤维初步牵伸并轻捻
senses.sentence_en: The machine slubs the wool before the next stage of spinning.
senses.sentence_zh: 这台机器在下一道纺纱工序前对羊毛进行初步牵伸和轻度加捻。

etymology_story.zh: 纺织动词 slub 由较早的 slubbing 逆构而来，即去掉被理解为词尾的 -ing；更早的来源并不确定。相关名词用于指纱线上的粗节，这些粗节既可能是纺纱不匀的结果，也可能成为刻意保留的织物纹理。
etymology_story.en: The textile verb slub was back-formed from the earlier slubbing by removing what was interpreted as the ending -ing; the earlier origin is uncertain. The related noun denotes thick places in yarn, which may result from uneven spinning or be deliberately retained for texture.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式以单一词干 slub 为基础：名词复数及动词第三人称单数 slubs；过去式和过去分词 slubbed；现在分词 slubbing，添加这些元音开头的词尾时双写 b。常见或专业词族包括 slubbing（初步牵伸轻捻工序或其产物）、slubber（相关机器或操作工）、slubby（有粗节的）、slubbiness（粗节特征）；slubby 的比较级和最高级为 slubbier、slubbiest。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern forms use the single stem slub: slubs is the noun plural and third-person singular verb; slubbed is the past tense and past participle; slubbing is the present participle, with b doubled before these vowel-initial endings. Common or technical family members include slubbing, the preliminary drawing-and-twisting process or its product; slubber, a corresponding machine or operator; slubby, having slubs; and slubbiness, the quality of having slubs. The comparative and superlative of slubby are slubbier and slubbiest.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 名词近义表达 thick place（粗节）直接描述纱线局部增粗；nub（小凸结）强调小而突出的结状部分，并非所有 slub 都像结。动词近义词 twist（加捻）范围更广，不包含 slub 所指的特定初步加工工序。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the noun, thick place directly describes a local increase in yarn thickness; nub suggests a small projecting lump, whereas a slub need not resemble a knot. For the verb, twist is broader and does not specify the preliminary processing operation expressed by slub.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“纺纱”这一场景：动词是初步拉伸轻捻，名词是纱线上摸得到的粗节。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor both senses in spinning: the verb is preliminary drawing and light twisting; the noun is a thick place you can feel in the yarn.

senses.meaning_zh: 小孩；小家伙（英国俚语，常带亲昵或戏谑意味）
senses.meaning_en: A child, especially someone's own child, in informal British usage.
senses.english_definition: Someone's sprogs are their children; this is an informal British expression that is often affectionate or humorous.

etymology_story.zh: 该词在第二次世界大战时期的英国军队俚语中指新兵或受训人员，后来也用来戏称小孩。其更早的来源不明，不能可靠地拆解成具有确定含义的词根。
etymology_story.en: The word was used in British service slang during the Second World War for a recruit or trainee and subsequently became a humorous term for a child. Its ultimate origin is uncertain, so a definite root-based explanation would be misleading.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再分析的词基 sprog；名词复数为 sprogs。没有常用的前缀或后缀派生词；不应把临时搭配当作独立派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, sprog is an unanalyzable base; its noun plural is sprogs. It has no established common prefixal or suffixal derivatives, and freely formed phrases should not be presented as derived words.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: child：中性、适用范围最广；kid：常见口语，地域限制较少；youngster：强调年纪小，也可指少年。sprog 更具英国俚语色彩，常用于亲昵或戏谑地谈论孩子。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Child is neutral and broadly applicable; kid is a widespread informal alternative; youngster emphasizes youth and can include adolescents. Sprog is distinctly British slang and often sounds affectionate or teasing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住语义桥梁：队伍里的“新来的小家伙”→家里的“小家伙”；这只是记忆联想，不是确定的词源解释。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the semantic bridge: the new little member of a unit becomes the little member of a family. This is a memory association, not a proven account of the word's origin.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借入俄语 ataman，用来称呼哥萨克社群或部队的首领。这一称号通常被认为与突厥语来源有关，但其更早的具体构成存在争议。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Russian ataman as a title for the leader of a Cossack community or military unit. The title is generally associated with a Turkic origin, although its precise earlier formation is disputed.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语构词：ataman（完整借入的词基），复数 atamans。不能把末尾的 man 当作英语“男人”来分析；英语中没有广泛使用的常规派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English structure: ataman, a borrowed base, with the plural atamans. Its ending should not be analyzed as the English word man, and it has no widely used regular family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chieftain：泛指部族或群体首领；commander：强调军事指挥职责；hetman：东欧历史上的另一种军政首领称号，与 ataman 的使用范围有交集，但具体制度和历史背景不同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chieftain broadly denotes the leader of a tribe or group; commander emphasizes military command; hetman is another historical Eastern European leadership title whose use overlaps with ataman but differs by institution and historical setting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 ataman 当作完整的历史头衔记忆：哥萨克队伍前面的那位首领。

senses.meaning_zh: 杂烩；杂乱而不协调的混合物（文学用语）
senses.meaning_en: A confused or incongruous mixture of different things.
senses.english_definition: A gallimaufry is a mixture of many different things that do not seem to belong together.
senses.collocation_en: a gallimaufry of styles; a gallimaufry of ideas
senses.collocation_zh: 各种风格的杂糅；各种想法的大杂烩
senses.sentence_en: The exhibition was a gallimaufry of photographs, costumes, and old advertisements.
senses.sentence_zh: 这场展览是照片、服装和旧广告拼成的大杂烩。

etymology_story.zh: 该词于16世纪由法语 galimafrée 借入，原指用多种食材、尤其是肉类做成的杂炖菜。英语随后把“一锅杂炖”的具体含义扩展为各种事物的杂乱混合。
etymology_story.en: The word entered English in the sixteenth century from French galimafrée, a mixed dish or ragout, especially of meat. English extended the image of a mixed stew to a confused assortment of other things.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 gallimaufry 是不可再分析的借词词基，不宜按现代英语词根和后缀强行拆分。复数为 gallimaufries，即辅音字母加 y 结尾变为 -ies；没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, gallimaufry is an unanalyzable borrowed base and should not be forced into an English root-and-affix analysis. Its plural is gallimaufries, following the consonant-plus-y to -ies pattern; it has no common derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hodgepodge：强调杂乱拼凑，较口语化；medley：强调多样组合，未必杂乱，常用于音乐；miscellany：指不同材料组成的集合，语气较中性。gallimaufry 更具文学色彩，常暗示混杂或不协调。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hodgepodge stresses a disorderly mixture and is less literary; medley emphasizes variety and need not imply disorder, especially in music; miscellany is a more neutral collection of varied material. Gallimaufry is literary and often suggests incongruity or confusion.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一锅杂炖→一堆杂物：从食材混合记住事物混杂。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A mixed stew becomes a mixed collection: carry the original food image into the figurative meaning.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自意大利语 innamorata，即 innamorato 的阴性形式，意为“恋爱中的女子”，源自动词 innamorare（使爱上），并最终与 amore（爱）有关。进入英语后，它主要指某人心爱的女子或女情人。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Italian innamorata, the feminine form of innamorato, meaning a woman in love, from innamorare, to cause someone to fall in love, ultimately related to amore, love. In English it came to denote a female beloved or lover.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以完整借词 inamorata 为词基，不把 -ata 当作可自由使用的英语后缀。复数为 inamoratas，也可见意大利语式复数 inamorate；对应的男性名词为 inamorato，复数 inamoratos 或 inamorati。相关同源词有 enamour/enamor、enamoured/enamored，但它们不是由 inamorata 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats inamorata as a borrowed base, with no productive English suffix -ata. Its plurals are inamoratas and the Italian-style inamorate; the male counterpart is inamorato, with plurals inamoratos or inamorati. Related cognates include enamour/enamor and enamoured/enamored, but these are not direct derivatives of inamorata.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sweetheart：亲昵地指恋人，不限性别；beloved：强调深爱之情，语体较庄重或文学化；lover：强调恋爱或性关系，也不限性别。inamorata 专指女性，常带刻意的文学或戏谑色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sweetheart is affectionate and gender-neutral; beloved emphasizes deep love and sounds elevated or literary; lover emphasizes a romantic or sexual relationship and is also gender-neutral. Inamorata specifically denotes a woman and often sounds deliberately literary or humorous.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住与 amore“爱”的历史联系：inamorata＝心中所爱的女子。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to its historical connection with amore, love: an inamorata is a woman someone loves.

usage_note: 可数名词，西非传统弦乐器；谈演奏可说 play the kora。

senses.meaning_zh: 转经；绕行圣地的朝圣活动或路线（藏传佛教语境）
senses.meaning_en: A devotional circuit around a sacred place in Tibetan Buddhist practice, or the route followed.
senses.english_definition: A kora is a journey around a sacred mountain, temple, or other holy place as an act of devotion, or the route used for that journey.
senses.collocation_en: complete a kora; a kora route
senses.collocation_zh: 完成一次转经绕行；转经路线

etymology_story.zh: 乐器名 kora 来自西非曼丁语族语言中的名称，英语保留了它对这种传统弦乐器的指称。另一个同形词来自藏语 skor ra，指绕行圣地的活动或路线，与乐器名没有词源关系。
etymology_story.en: The instrument name kora comes from a Manding-language name in West Africa, retained in English for the traditional string instrument. A separate homonym comes from Tibetan skor ra and denotes a devotional circuit or its route; it is etymologically unrelated to the instrument name.

morphology_enriched.zh: 两种含义在现代英语中都以 kora 为完整借词词基，复数均为 koras，没有常用的词缀派生词。kora player（科拉琴演奏者）和 kora route（转经路线）是名词组合，不是后缀派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Both meanings use kora as a complete borrowed base in modern English, with the plural koras and no common affixal derivatives. Kora player and kora route are noun combinations, not suffix-derived forms.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 乐器义没有完全对应的常用近义词：harp（竖琴）和 lute（琉特琴）可帮助说明其形制，但都不能直接替代 kora。宗教义中，circumambulation 强调绕行，pilgrimage 强调朝圣旅程；kora 特指藏传佛教语境中的圣地绕行或路线。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The instrument sense has no exact common synonym: harp and lute help describe aspects of its construction but cannot simply replace kora. For the religious sense, circumambulation emphasizes going around something, while pilgrimage emphasizes a devotional journey; kora specifically names the sacred circuit or route in a Tibetan Buddhist context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 分开记两幅图：西非葫芦共鸣箱上的二十一根弦；藏地朝圣者绕圣地走一圈。这是两个来源不同的同形词。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep two separate pictures: twenty-one strings over a West African calabash body, and Tibetan pilgrims circling a sacred place. These are two identically spelled words with different origins.

meaning: 作品中冗长乏味的部分

etymology.text: 借自法语 longueur，原义是长度。英语用它说作品中“长得让人厌倦”的部分，记忆时抓住拖长的感觉。

usage_note: 文艺评论用语，可数；复数 longueurs 更常见，单数可指具体某一拖沓段落。

senses.meaning_zh: 作品、演出或讲话中冗长乏味的部分；通常用复数 longueurs
senses.meaning_en: A tedious passage or stretch in a work, performance, or speech; usually plural.
senses.english_definition: A longueur is a part of a book, film, performance, or speech that seems too long and becomes boring.
senses.collocation_en: occasional longueurs; the longueurs of the novel
senses.collocation_zh: 偶尔出现的拖沓段落；小说中冗长乏味的部分

senses.sentence_zh: 这部小说虽然中间有几处拖沓，但总体上引人入胜。

etymology_story.zh: 借自法语 longueur，原义为“长度”，由 long（长的）与名词后缀 -eur 构成。英语借用了它表示“令人厌倦的过度延长”的引申义，尤其指作品中的拖沓部分。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed French longueur, meaning 'length', formed from long ('long') and the noun suffix -eur. The English use develops the figurative idea of excessive length into a tedious stretch, especially in a creative work.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整借词处理，不拆成具有英语构词功能的词根和词缀；longueur + -s → longueurs（复数，也是更常见的形式）。没有常用的英语派生词；法语中的 long + -eur 属于来源语言的构词分析。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, longueur is a whole-word borrowing rather than a productive combination of English roots and affixes. Its plural is longueur + -s → longueurs, the more usual form; there are no established common English derivatives. French long + -eur explains its source-language structure.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tedious passage（冗长乏味的段落）是最直接的释义；dull stretch（沉闷的一段）适用范围更广，也可指经历；padding（凑篇幅的内容）强调内容多余，而 longueur 强调读者或观众感受到的拖沓。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tedious passage is the closest plain-English equivalent; dull stretch applies more broadly, including to experiences; padding emphasizes unnecessary material, while longueur emphasizes the resulting sense of tedious length.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从法语“长度”联想到阅读感受：长到令人厌倦的那一段。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with the French idea of 'length': a longueur is the stretch that feels tediously long.

etymology_story.zh: 借自夏威夷语 pāhoehoe，原词指表面平滑、连续的熔岩。英语地质学沿用这一当地名称，用来区别于表面粗糙、呈碎块状的 ʻaʻā 熔岩。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Hawaiian pāhoehoe, a name for lava with a smooth, unbroken surface. Geologists adopted the local term to distinguish this lava from rough, clinkery ʻaʻā.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语构词分析为 pahoehoe（不可进一步作英语词素切分的借词）；通常作不可数名词，没有常用派生词。pahoehoe lava 和 pahoehoe flow 是名词作定语的组合，不是派生词，也不另立常用形容词词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats pahoehoe as an unanalyzed borrowing, normally used as a mass noun, with no common derivatives. Pahoehoe lava and pahoehoe flow contain an attributive noun; they are combinations rather than derivatives and do not establish a separate common adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ropy lava（绳状熔岩）强调绳索状表面，是常用的描述性对应表达；smooth-surfaced lava（表面平滑的熔岩）强调表面质地，但范围更宽。pahoehoe 是地质名称，其表面并不总有明显绳纹。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ropy lava is a common descriptive equivalent emphasizing the rope-like surface; smooth-surfaced lava emphasizes texture but is broader. Pahoehoe is the geological name, and its surface need not always show conspicuous ropes.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Link the Hawaiian name to one image: a lava skin folding like soft rope.

senses.collocation_zh: 一把锋利的马来砍刀；用马来砍刀清除灌木杂草
senses.sentence_en: He used a parang to cut a path through the thick undergrowth.
senses.sentence_zh: 他用一把马来砍刀在茂密的灌木丛中开出了一条路。

senses.meaning_zh: 帕朗音乐；特立尼达和多巴哥等地常在圣诞期间演奏的西班牙语传统民间音乐
senses.meaning_en: Traditional, usually Spanish-language folk music associated especially with Christmas in Trinidad and Tobago.
senses.english_definition: Parang is a style of traditional music, usually sung in Spanish, that is especially popular at Christmas in Trinidad and Tobago.
senses.collocation_en: parang music; a parang band
senses.collocation_zh: 帕朗音乐；一支帕朗乐队
senses.sentence_en: A parang band performed Spanish Christmas songs at the community celebration.
senses.sentence_zh: 一支帕朗乐队在社区庆祝活动上演唱了西班牙语圣诞歌曲。

etymology_story.zh: 刀具义借自马来语 parang，原词指一种大型刀具或砍刀。音乐义是来源不同的同形词，源自西班牙语 parranda（结伴欢庆、狂欢），与传入特立尼达的委内瑞拉音乐传统有关。
etymology_story.en: The knife sense comes from Malay parang, a name for a large knife or chopping blade. The unrelated musical homonym derives from Spanish parranda ('a festive outing or revelry') and is associated with Venezuelan musical traditions brought to Trinidad.

morphology_enriched.zh: 两个词义在现代英语中都按完整借词处理，不作英语词根与词缀拆分。刀具义的规则复数为 parangs；音乐义通常不可数；没有常用派生词，parang band 等属于名词修饰名词的组合。
morphology_enriched.en: Both senses are whole-word borrowings in modern English, without a productive English root-and-affix breakdown. The knife has the regular plural parangs; the music sense is normally uncountable. There are no common derivatives, and combinations such as parang band use the noun attributively.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 刀具义：machete（大砍刀）是最接近的通用名称；cleaver（劈刀、砍肉刀）更强调劈砍用途；cutlass（短弯刀）通常指武器，在部分地区也指砍草刀。音乐义：Christmas folk music（圣诞民间音乐）和 Caribbean folk music（加勒比民间音乐）只是更宽泛的类别名称，不能完全替代 parang。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the knife, machete is the closest general term; cleaver emphasizes heavy chopping; cutlass usually denotes a weapon, although it also names a vegetation-cutting tool in some regions. For the music, Christmas folk music and Caribbean folk music are broader category descriptions, not exact substitutes for parang.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 两幅画面分开记：马来树林里的宽刃砍刀；特立尼达圣诞节上的西班牙语歌声。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep two separate images: a broad chopping blade in a Malay forest, and Spanish-language Christmas singing in Trinidad.

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；riyal + coin → riyal coin（里亚尔硬币）。

etymology_story.zh: 借自阿拉伯语 riyāl，最终来自西班牙语 real，后者既有“王室的”之义，也曾是一种西班牙硬币的名称。这个词随西班牙银币的国际流通而传播，后来成为若干地区本国货币的名称。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Arabic riyāl, ultimately from Spanish real, meaning 'royal' and also naming a Spanish coin. The name spread with internationally circulating Spanish silver coins and later became the name of local currencies.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为完整借词 riyal，不作英语词根与词缀拆分；riyal + -s → riyals。没有常用派生词；rial 是历史相关的货币名称或拼写形式，但特定国家货币的规范英文名称不能任意互换。
morphology_enriched.en: Riyal is a whole-word borrowing in modern English; its regular plural is riyal + -s → riyals. It has no common derivatives. Rial is a historically related currency name or spelling, but the conventional English names of particular national currencies are not freely interchangeable.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: currency unit（货币单位）是上位概念；rial（里亚尔）是历史相关的名称，但具体指哪国货币取决于规范用法。riyal 没有普遍适用的严格近义词，Saudi riyal 与 Qatari riyal 也分别表示不同货币。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Currency unit is a broader category; rial is a historically related name whose reference depends on conventional national usage. Riyal has no universally interchangeable exact synonym, and Saudi riyal and Qatari riyal name different currencies.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 沿着“王室的 → 王室硬币 → 里亚尔”的历史链条记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical chain: 'royal' → a royal coin → riyal.

pronunciation.note: 按 Merriam-Webster 的 ˈten-yə-wəs 转写；末两音节为 /jə.wəs/。

forms: 单数 tenuis；传统拉丁语式复数 tenues。
family: tenues 是复数形式；unaspirated（不送气的）是释义相关词。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；tenuis + consonant → tenuis consonant（不送气清塞音）。

etymology.text: 经中世纪拉丁语 tenuis（细的、轻的）进入语音术语，用来翻译希腊语 psīlós（裸的、平的）。可用“没有额外送出一口气”帮助理解。

usage_note: 语音学技术名词；不可仅凭字母 p、t、k 判断是否送气，须看具体发音环境。

senses.meaning_zh: 不送气清塞音；传统语音学术语
senses.meaning_en: An unaspirated voiceless stop consonant, in traditional phonetic terminology.
senses.english_definition: A tenuis is a stop consonant made without vocal-cord vibration and without the strong puff of air called aspiration.
senses.collocation_en: a tenuis stop; the tenues /p t k/
senses.collocation_zh: 一个不送气清塞音；/p t k/ 这组不送气清塞音
senses.sentence_en: The traditional classification distinguishes a tenuis from an aspirated stop.
senses.sentence_zh: 传统分类将不送气清塞音与送气塞音区分开来。

etymology_story.zh: 来自拉丁语 tenuis（细的、薄的、轻的），在传统语法中用来对应希腊语 psilos（裸的、无附加成分的）。其语音学含义强调这类塞音既不带浊音，也不带送气。
etymology_story.en: Tenuis comes from Latin tenuis ('thin, slender, or light'), used in traditional grammar to render Greek psilos ('bare' or 'plain'). In phonetic terminology, it identifies a stop without either voicing or aspiration.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是完整的拉丁语借词，不宜拆成英语词根和后缀；保留拉丁式复数 tenues /ˈtenjuːiːz/。没有常用的直接英语派生词；tenuous（细弱的、牵强的）与它有拉丁语词源联系，但不是由英语 tenuis 加后缀构成。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats tenuis as a whole Latin borrowing rather than an English root-plus-suffix formation. It retains the Latin plural tenues /ˈtenjuːiːz/ and has no common direct English derivatives. Tenuous is related through Latin, but is not formed by adding an English suffix to tenuis.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: unaspirated voiceless stop（不送气清塞音）是现代术语中的直接对应表达；voiceless stop（清塞音）范围更广，也包括送气音；unaspirated stop（不送气塞音）只说明不送气，本身不排除浊音。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Unaspirated voiceless stop is the direct modern equivalent; voiceless stop is broader and includes aspirated stops; unaspirated stop specifies the absence of aspiration but does not by itself exclude voicing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把“裸的塞音”理解为两项都没有：无浊音、无送气。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of a 'bare stop' with two features absent: no voicing and no aspiration.

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆；vair + lining → vair lining（灰白松鼠皮毛衬里）。

etymology.text: 经盎格鲁法语 vair（杂色的）借入，追溯到拉丁语 varius（多样、杂色）。灰白相间的皮毛正好帮助记住“杂色”这条线索。

usage_note: 历史服饰材料名，通常不可数；本卡不教纹章中的引申义。

senses.collocation_en: a field of vair; a shield bearing vair
senses.collocation_zh: 松鼠皮纹盾底；带有松鼠皮纹的盾徽

etymology_story.zh: 英语经盎格鲁法语借入 vair；其法语来源表示“杂色的”，可追溯至拉丁语 varius，意为“多样的、杂色的”。该词先指灰白相间的松鼠皮，后来也用于模仿这种毛皮的纹章图案。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed vair through Anglo-French from a word meaning 'variegated', ultimately from Latin varius, 'varied' or 'multicoloured'. The name of the grey-and-white squirrel fur also became the heraldic term for a pattern representing that fur.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 vair 是不可再按英语词缀分析的借入词，通常作不可数名词。相关词形包括 vairy（饰有松鼠皮纹的，纹章学形容词）、counter-vair（对置松鼠皮纹）和 counter-vairy（饰有对置松鼠皮纹的）；vair lining（松鼠皮衬里）是名词短语，并非派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, vair is an unanalysed loanword and normally a mass noun. Related heraldic forms include vairy, 'patterned with vair', counter-vair, a variant arrangement of the pattern, and counter-vairy, 'patterned with counter-vair'; vair lining is a noun phrase, not a derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: squirrel fur（松鼠毛皮）范围更广，不限定灰白相间的拼接方式；miniver（白色毛皮，常指白色松鼠腹皮）强调白色，与 vair 的灰白交替有别；heraldic fur（纹章毛皮纹）是上位词，还包括其他毛皮纹样。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Squirrel fur is broader and does not specify alternating grey and white sections; miniver denotes white fur, often squirrel belly fur, rather than the grey-and-white combination; heraldic fur is a broader category that includes vair and other fur patterns.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住与 various 同源的“杂色”线索：灰白松鼠皮，变成蓝银纹章纹。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect vair with its relative various: varied grey-and-white fur becomes a blue-and-silver heraldic pattern.

etymology_story.en: English borrowed Italian zabaglione as the name of the dessert made with egg yolks, sugar, and wine. The Italian word's earlier origin is uncertain, so stories attributing it to a particular cook or saint should not be treated as established etymology.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 zabaglione 是整体借入词，不能可靠地拆成英语词根与词缀；通常不可数，表示多份或多种成品时可用复数 zabagliones。zabaione 是相关异体名称；法语同源对应词 sabayon 也用于英语，但不是由英语 zabaglione 加词缀派生而来；无常用英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, zabaglione is a whole-word borrowing without a productive English root-and-affix analysis. It is usually uncountable, with zabagliones possible for individual servings or varieties; zabaione is a variant name, and sabayon is a related French term also used in English, not an English suffixal derivative. There are no common English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sabayon（萨巴雍酱）是最接近的法语对应词，烹饪中也可指咸味或其他酒液制成的类似泡沫酱；custard（蛋奶甜酱）通常含奶或奶油，范围更广；wine custard（葡萄酒蛋黄甜酱）是描述性近义表达，不专指意大利传统做法。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sabayon is the closest French equivalent, though culinary usage also includes savoury versions and foams made with other liquids; custard is broader and usually contains milk or cream; wine custard is a descriptive near-equivalent that does not specifically identify the Italian preparation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整词连画面：蛋黄＋糖＋酒，隔水打成轻盈泡沫。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor the whole word to the recipe: yolks plus sugar plus wine, whisked over gentle heat into foam.

usage_note: 普通植物名称小写 abutilon；拉丁属名写作 Abutilon。具体花色依种类而异。

senses.sentence_zh: 园丁在向阳的墙边用一个大花盆种了一株观赏苘麻。

etymology_story.zh: 英语名称来自植物学拉丁语属名 Abutilon，后者沿用一个经中世纪拉丁语传入的阿拉伯语植物名称。它在英语中成为植物名，园艺用法也保留在部分后来被重新分类的观赏植物上。
etymology_story.en: The English name comes from the botanical Latin genus name Abutilon, based on an Arabic plant name transmitted through medieval Latin. It became a plant name in English, and horticultural usage has persisted for some ornamental plants subsequently reclassified.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 abutilon 是整体借入的植物名，无可用于学习性拆分的英语前后缀；可数复数为 abutilons。Abutilon 是首字母大写的科学属名；abutilon flower（苘麻花）和 hybrid abutilon（杂交观赏苘麻）是短语，不是派生词；无常用英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, abutilon is a borrowed plant name with no useful English prefix-and-suffix breakdown; its countable plural is abutilons. Capitalized Abutilon is the scientific genus name, while abutilon flower and hybrid abutilon are phrases rather than derivatives. There are no common English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: flowering maple（花枫）和 parlour maple（室内花枫）常用于观赏苘麻，名称源于其似枫叶的叶片，并不表示它属于槭树属；Indian mallow（印度苘麻）用于某些苘麻类植物，具体所指依语境而定，不能替代所有 abutilon。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Flowering maple and parlour maple commonly name ornamental abutilons, referring to maple-like leaves rather than membership in the maple genus; Indian mallow names certain abutilons, with its precise reference depending on context, and is not interchangeable with every use of abutilon.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整词记植物画面：叶似枫，花像垂下的小铃；名称本身不含“枫”或“铃”的词根。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the whole name through a garden image: maple-like leaves and little hanging bells; these are visual cues, not meanings of its word parts.

family: 复合词组 asphodel flower（花）、asphodel meadow（日光兰草地）。

etymology.text: 经拉丁语 asphodelus 追溯到希腊语 asphodelos，都是这种植物的名称。可以把它和高直花序上的一簇簇花连起来记。

usage_note: 可数植物名，可指日光兰等近缘草本；不等同于日常所说的水仙。

senses.meaning_zh: 日光兰；尤指地中海地区开白色或黄色花、具有高大花序的日光兰类植物
senses.meaning_en: a plant, especially a Mediterranean species, with tall stems bearing white or yellow flowers

etymology_story.zh: 英语 asphodel 经拉丁语 asphodelus 追溯至希腊语 asphodelos，原本就是植物名称，更早的来源不明。古希腊诗歌将日光兰草甸与亡者的世界联系起来，因此该词也带有相关文学意象。
etymology_story.en: English asphodel goes back through Latin asphodelus to Greek asphodelos, a plant name of uncertain earlier origin. Ancient Greek poetry associated asphodel meadows with the world of the dead, giving the word a lasting literary association.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 asphodel 是整体借入的单纯词，不应拆作具有现代英语意义的 aspho- 与 -del；复数为 asphodels。asphodel meadow（日光兰草甸）是名词组合，asphodel-like（像日光兰的）是可自由构造的比较形式；无常用英语派生词。daffodil 与它有历史词源联系，但不是现代英语中由它规则派生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, asphodel is an unanalysed loanword, not a combination of meaningful English elements aspho- and -del; its plural is asphodels. Asphodel meadow is a noun combination, and asphodel-like is a freely formed comparison; there are no common English derivatives. Daffodil is historically related but is not a regular modern derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: king's spear（王矛花）常指黄花的相关植物，范围较窄；bog asphodel（沼泽日光兰）虽名称相似，却属于不同植物属；daffodil（黄水仙）仅有历史词源联系，现代所指植物不同，不能当作同义词互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: King's spear commonly names a particular yellow-flowered relative and is narrower in reference; bog asphodel shares the name but belongs to a different genus; daffodil is historically related as a word but names a different plant and is not an interchangeable synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 日光兰高花茎，连到希腊冥界的花草甸；这是植物与文学联想，不是词根直译。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture tall asphodel stems across a meadow in the Greek underworld: a botanical and literary association, not a literal root translation.

etymology.text: 借自印地语 bābū，原与父亲这一亲昵称呼有关，后来用于尊称男性或绅士。可从“亲近或尊敬的男性称呼”来记。

usage_note: 历史和地域性称谓；也曾用于文员，某些旧文本带贬义，现代称呼须尊重当事人习惯。

senses.meaning_en: a government official or bureaucrat in South Asian English, often referred to critically

etymology_story.zh: 英语借入印地语、孟加拉语等南亚语言中的 bābū，原为对男性表示尊敬或亲近的称呼。在殖民时期英语中，它又被用于受过英语教育的印度文书，常带贬义；南亚英语后来也用它指政府官员。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed bābū from South Asian languages including Hindi and Bengali, where it served as a respectful or affectionate address for a man. Colonial English also applied it, often disparagingly, to English-educated Indian clerks, and South Asian English subsequently extended it to government officials.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 babu 是整体借入词，复数为 babus，异体拼写为 baboo，复数 baboos。相关派生词包括 babudom（官僚阶层或官僚作风）和 babuism（官僚习气等，通常带贬义）；Babuji 是源语言称呼 babu 加敬称成分 -ji 的形式，不是英语后缀派生。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, babu is a whole-word borrowing with the plural babus; the variant baboo has the plural baboos. Related derivatives include babudom, denoting officialdom or bureaucratic culture, and babuism, usually a disparaging term for associated practices; Babuji combines babu with the South Asian honorific -ji rather than an English suffix.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sir（先生）可近似表达尊称义，但不具 babu 的南亚文化背景；clerk（文书、职员）强调工作职责，本身没有殖民语境中的贬义；bureaucrat（官僚、行政官员）对应现代官员义，常突出繁文缛节或行政体系。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sir approximately matches the respectful address but lacks babu's South Asian cultural setting; clerk describes an occupation without inherently carrying the colonial disparagement; bureaucrat matches the modern official sense and often emphasizes administrative systems or excessive procedure.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 沿用法串联：尊称男性的“先生”→旧时文书→现代官僚；语气必须随时代与语境判断。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the usage chain: a respectful male address, then a historical clerk, then a modern bureaucrat; context determines the tone.

etymology_story.zh: 借自爱尔兰语 bóithrín，是 bóthar（道路）的指小形式，字面意思是“小路”。进入英语后，主要保留了爱尔兰乡间狭窄道路这一地域性含义。
etymology_story.en: Boreen comes from Irish bóithrín, a diminutive of bóthar, meaning 'road', and therefore literally means 'little road'. In English, it retains its particular association with narrow lanes in rural Ireland.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再按常用词根、词缀拆分的借词：boreen；复数为 boreens。爱尔兰语原词含指小后缀 -ín，但它不是本词中可自由使用的英语后缀；本词没有常用的派生形容词或动词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, boreen is an unanalyzed loanword: boreen; plural boreens. Its Irish source contains the diminutive suffix -ín, but this is not a productive English suffix within the word; there are no established common adjective or verb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: lane（小路、巷道）适用范围更广，不限于爱尔兰；country lane（乡间小路）是最接近的中性表达；track（小道、车辙路）更强调简陋、通常未铺面的通行路线。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Lane is broader and is not specifically Irish; country lane is the closest neutral equivalent; track suggests a rougher route, usually without a paved surface.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住原义“小路”：boreen 是爱尔兰田野间的一条小路。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the original idea of a 'little road': a boreen threads through the Irish countryside.

usage_note: 航海历史用语，可数；另有大船附属艇的用法，本卡只教轻型帆船。

etymology_story.zh: 经法语 pinace 或 pinasse 借入，通常追溯至西班牙语 pinaza，并与表示“松树”的 pino 及拉丁语 pinus 相联系，反映了造船所用的松木。英语中的含义从轻型帆船扩展到大船配用的交通艇，包括后来的蒸汽艇。
etymology_story.en: Pinnace entered English through French pinace or pinasse and is generally traced to Spanish pinaza, associated with pino and Latin pinus, meaning 'pine', a boatbuilding timber. Its English meanings extended from a light sailing vessel to a larger ship's service boat, including later steam-powered examples.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整借词处理：pinnace；复数为 pinnaces。不可按 pin + 后缀拆解；steam pinnace（蒸汽交通艇）是复合名词，本词没有常用的派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat pinnace as a whole loanword in modern English; its plural is pinnaces. It is not formed from English pin plus a suffix; steam pinnace is a compound noun, and the word has no established common verb or adjective derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: boat（船、小艇）是宽泛上位词；tender（交通艇、供应船）强调为大船提供运输或补给的功能；launch（大艇、交通艇）通常指较大的敞口艇，现代用法中常有动力装置，与 pinnace 的交通艇义部分重合。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Boat is the broad general term; tender emphasizes transport or supply duties for another vessel; launch usually denotes a relatively large open boat, often motor-powered today, and overlaps with the service-boat sense of pinnace.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“松木造船”的词源联想轻巧小船，再记住它也可为大船接送人员。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a light boat built from pine, then imagine it ferrying people to and from a larger ship.

etymology_story.zh: 借自日语 shika（鹿），原词泛指鹿。英语把这一借词用作特定鹿种的名称，即梅花鹿，而不是所有鹿的统称。
etymology_story.en: Sika was borrowed from Japanese shika, meaning 'deer'. English narrowed this general animal name to a particular species, the sika deer.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再拆分的借词：sika；复数可用 sika 或 sikas。常见复合名词为 sika deer，复数仍为 sika deer；没有常用的派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: Sika is an unanalyzed loanword in modern English; its plural may be sika or sikas. The usual compound is sika deer, whose plural is also sika deer; there are no established common verb or adjective derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sika deer（梅花鹿）是完整、明确的同义名称；Japanese deer（日本鹿）是另一名称，但容易让人误以为其原产地仅限日本；deer（鹿）是上位词，范围包括许多其他鹿种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sika deer is the explicit equivalent; Japanese deer is an alternative name but may misleadingly suggest an exclusively Japanese native range; deer is the broader category containing many other species.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 日语 shika 泛指“鹿”，英语 sika 专指“梅花鹿”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Japanese shika means 'deer'; English sika names one particular deer.

etymology_story.zh: 借自泰卢固语 pandikokku，由表示“猪”和“鼠”的成分构成，最初指亚洲的大型鼠类。后来，英语使用者把这个名称移用于澳大利亚外形略似鼠的有袋动物，但两类动物并非近亲。
etymology_story.en: Bandicoot comes from Telugu pandikokku, a compound of elements meaning 'pig' and 'rat', originally naming a large Asian rat. English speakers later transferred the name to somewhat ratlike Australian marsupials, although the animals are not close relatives.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整借词处理：bandicoot；复数为 bandicoots。不能按 band + coot 理解；常见复合名词包括 bandicoot rat（板齿鼠）和 long-nosed bandicoot（长鼻袋狸），没有常用的派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, bandicoot is a whole loanword; its plural is bandicoots. It is not an English compound of band and coot; established compounds include bandicoot rat and long-nosed bandicoot, with no common derived verb or adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 在鼠类义中，bandicoot rat（板齿鼠）是明确的同义表达，rat（鼠）则是更宽泛的上位词；在袋狸义中，marsupial（有袋动物）也是上位词。袋狸与板齿鼠共享英文名称，但不能在动物分类上互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the rodent sense, bandicoot rat is the explicit equivalent, while rat is broader; for the Australian sense, marsupial is a broader category. The marsupial and the rat share an English name but are not interchangeable zoological terms.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一个名称，两类动物：亚洲“大鼠”在先，澳洲“袋狸”借名在后。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One name, two animals: first an Asian 'pig-rat', later an Australian marsupial.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是完整的借入名词：borzoi；复数可用 borzois 或 borzoi。俄语来源中的形容词形式不构成英语后缀分析；borzoi puppy（俄罗斯猎狼犬幼犬）中的 borzoi 是名词作定语，没有常用的派生动词或形容词。

The adjectival form in its Russian source does not provide an English suffix analysis; in borzoi puppy, borzoi is a noun modifier, and there are no established common verb or adjective derivatives.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：capelin，作为不可进一步分析的借入词基；不存在可独立解释词义的 cap- + -elin 结构。复数可用 capelin 或 capelins；caplin 是异体拼写。没有常用的派生动词、形容词或副词；capelin roe（毛鳞鱼卵）、capelin fishery（毛鳞鱼渔业）是名词组合，其中 capelin 作名词定语。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: capelin is an unanalyzable borrowed base, rather than cap- plus -elin. Its plural is capelin or capelins, and caplin is a spelling variant. There are no common derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs; capelin roe and capelin fishery are noun combinations in which capelin functions attributively.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: caplin（毛鳞鱼）是同一种鱼的异体名称；smelt（胡瓜鱼类）范围更广，不能在精确物种名称中直接替换；forage fish（饵料鱼）表示生态功能类别，也包括许多其他鱼类。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Caplin is an alternative name for the same fish. Smelt is broader and is not an exact substitute in species identification. Forage fish describes an ecological category that includes many other small fish.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整词绑定画面：寒冷海岸，一群小银鱼前来产卵——capelin，毛鳞鱼。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Attach the whole word to one scene: small silvery fish spawning along a cold coast—capelin.

etymology_story.zh: 历史称呼 Gentoo 在十七世纪借自葡萄牙语 gentio（异教徒、非犹太人），其源头是拉丁语 gentilis；欧洲人曾用它称呼印度教徒。现代英语另有表示巴布亚企鹅的 gentoo，而该鸟名与旧人群称呼之间的具体联系不宜臆断。[词源与义项依据：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/gentoo)
etymology_story.en: The historical term Gentoo entered English in the seventeenth century from Portuguese gentio, meaning heathen or gentile, ultimately from Latin gentilis, and was applied by Europeans to Hindus. Modern English also uses gentoo for a penguin, but the precise connection between the bird name and the historical human designation should not be assumed. [Etymological and lexical source: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/gentoo)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：Gentoo 是整体借入的词基，不拆为 gent + -oo。历史人群名词的复数为 Gentoos，同形形容词仍为 Gentoo；鸟名通常写作 gentoo，复数 gentoos。gentoo penguin（巴布亚企鹅）是名词组合；没有常用的派生动词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: Gentoo is a borrowed base, not gent plus -oo. The historical human noun has the plural Gentoos, while its adjective remains Gentoo; the bird name is normally gentoo, plural gentoos. Gentoo penguin is a noun combination, and there are no common derived verbs or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Hindu（印度教徒；印度教的）是历史人群义对应的现代标准词；gentoo penguin（巴布亚企鹅）是鸟类义的完整名称；penguin（企鹅）范围更广。Gentoo 的历史人群义与现代鸟类义不可互换。[用法依据：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/gentoo)
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hindu is the standard modern equivalent of the historical human designation and its adjective. Gentoo penguin is the full name of the bird, whereas penguin is broader. The historical human meaning and the modern bird meaning are not interchangeable. [Usage source: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/gentoo)

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用语境分流：旧印度文献中的 Gentoo 指印度教徒；极地动物语境中的 gentoo 指巴布亚企鹅。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let context choose the meaning: Gentoo in older writing about India refers to Hindus; gentoo in polar wildlife writing refers to the penguin.

senses.meaning_zh: 少许；一点点；一丝，常带文雅或诙谐色彩
senses.meaning_en: a very small amount or slight trace, often in literary or playful usage
senses.english_definition: A soupcon of something is a very small amount of it, or a slight trace of a quality or feeling.
senses.collocation_en: a soupcon of irony; a soupcon of garlic
senses.collocation_zh: 一丝讽刺；少许蒜

senses.sentence_zh: 她面带微笑地回答，语气中带着一丝讽刺。

etymology_story.zh: soupcon 是 soupçon 省略软音符的拼写，借自法语 soupçon；该法语词既有“怀疑”义，也有“一点点”义，经古法语 sospeçon 追溯到拉丁语 suspectio。英语借入时已经有“少许”的意思，并非进入英语后才从“怀疑”发展出这个义项。[词源依据：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/soup%C3%A7on)
etymology_story.en: Soupcon is the spelling of soupçon without the cedilla, borrowed from French soupçon, which means both suspicion and a small amount, through Old French sospeçon from Latin suspectio. The small-amount meaning already existed in French when English borrowed the word. [Etymological source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/soup%C3%A7on)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：soupcon 是整体借入的词基，不能拆成 soup（汤）+ con；较常见的保留法语符号拼写为 soupçon。复数为 soupcons 或 soupçons；没有常用的英语派生动词、形容词或副词。suspect（怀疑）和 suspicion（怀疑）是历史同源词，不是由 soupcon 派生的现代词族成员。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: soupcon is a borrowed base, not soup plus con; soupçon retains the French cedilla. The plurals are soupcons and soupçons, and there are no common English derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs. Suspect and suspicion are historical relatives rather than modern derivatives of soupcon.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hint（一丝）强调隐约可察觉的味道、情绪或特征；trace（微量、痕迹）强调极少的残留或存在；dash（少许）常指为调味或增添效果而加入的一点东西。soupcon 与这些词相比更显文雅，也常带轻松诙谐的语气。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hint emphasizes a faintly perceptible flavor, feeling, or quality; trace emphasizes a very small presence or remainder; dash often suggests a small addition for flavor or effect. Soupcon sounds more literary and can be playfully sophisticated.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“一丝怀疑”连到“一丝味道”：soupcon 的核心是少到若有若无。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect a mere suspicion with a mere hint of flavor: a soupcon is barely there.

etymology_story.zh: 现代口语中表示“小胡子”的 tache 是 moustache 的截短形式，与表示“污点”的 tache 并非同一词源。后者经中古英语借自中古法语 tache（斑点、污迹），具有更早的日耳曼语背景。[小胡子义词源：Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/tache)；[污点义词源：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/tache)
etymology_story.en: The modern informal tache meaning moustache is a clipping of moustache and has a different origin from tache meaning stain. The latter entered Middle English from Middle French tache, meaning a spot or stain, and has earlier Germanic ancestry. [Moustache etymology: Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/tache); [stain etymology: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/tache)

morphology_enriched.zh: 小胡子义的现代构词为 moustache → tache，属于截短，不是词根加后缀；异体为 'tache，复数 taches。污点义作为整体词基使用，复数同为 taches；另有罕见或方言动词 tache（玷污），屈折形式为 taches、tached、taching，但不属于常用现代动词。没有常用的派生副词。
morphology_enriched.en: For the moustache sense, the modern formation is moustache → tache, a clipping rather than a root-plus-suffix construction; an alternative spelling is 'tache, and the plural is taches. The stain sense is a separate base with the same plural; a rare or dialectal verb tache, meaning stain or tarnish, has the forms taches, tached, and taching, but is not a common modern verb. There is no common derived adverb.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: moustache／mustache（小胡子）是中性标准词，tache 更口语化。污点义可对应 stain（污渍）或 blemish（瑕疵）；stain 强调污染或变色，blemish 强调破坏外观或完美性的缺点。后两词不能替换小胡子义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Moustache, also spelled mustache, is the neutral standard term, while tache is informal. For the stain sense, stain emphasizes soiling or discoloration, whereas blemish emphasizes a flaw that spoils appearance or perfection. Neither substitutes for the moustache sense.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: moustache 截去前半段，留下 tache：上唇的一小撮胡子；“污点”另按独立词义记忆。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 adat 借自马来语，其词源可追溯到阿拉伯语中表示“习惯、惯例”的词。该词在马来文化地区既涉及传统习俗，也用于具有社会规范效力的地方习惯法。[词源与释义依据：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/adat)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed adat from Malay, with an ultimate Arabic source meaning custom or usage. In the Malay world, the term concerns inherited practices as well as local customary rules with social authority. [Etymological and lexical source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/adat)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：adat 是整体借入的词基，不拆成 ad- + -at。通常作为不可数名词表示一套习俗或习惯法；比较不同地方制度时偶见复数 adats。没有常用的英语派生动词、形容词或副词；adat law（阿达特习惯法）、adat community（遵循阿达特习俗的社群）是名词组合，其中 adat 作名词定语。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: adat is a borrowed base, not ad- plus -at. It is normally uncountable when referring to a body of custom or customary law; adats occasionally distinguishes separate local systems. There are no common English derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs; adat law and adat community are noun combinations with attributive adat.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: customary law（习惯法）是最接近的通用法律术语，但缺少 adat 的地域文化内涵；custom（习俗）范围更广，不一定具有法律效力；tradition（传统）强调代际传承，也不一定具有规范约束力。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Customary law is the closest general legal equivalent but lacks adat's regional and cultural specificity. Custom is broader and need not have legal force. Tradition emphasizes transmission across generations and need not impose binding rules.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 代代沿袭的习惯，成为社群遵循的规则：习俗 → 习惯法 → adat。
mnemonic_anchor.en: An inherited practice becomes a rule the community follows: custom → customary law → adat.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 arbutus 借自拉丁语 arbutus，原指地中海地区的草莓树；这一名称后来也用于植物属名 Arbutus。在北美，名称还扩展用于同属杜鹃花科、但属于另一属的蔓生岩梅。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed arbutus from Latin arbutus, the name of the Mediterranean strawberry tree; the name was also adopted for the botanical genus Arbutus. In North America, it additionally came to denote trailing arbutus, a plant in the same family but a different genus.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再作有效词缀分析的借词：arbutus；复数为 arbutuses。相关名称有 arbutus tree（草莓树属树木）和 trailing arbutus（蔓生岩梅）；没有常用的规则派生词族，词尾 -us 在这里不是能产的英语后缀。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, arbutus is an unanalyzed loanword; its plural is arbutuses. Related names include arbutus tree and trailing arbutus; there is no common productive derivational family, and its ending -us is not a productive English suffix here.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: strawberry tree（草莓树）通常特指 Arbutus unedo；madrone（北美草莓树）主要指北美的若干草莓树属树种；trailing arbutus（蔓生岩梅）对应本词的北美区域义，植物分类上不属于 Arbutus 属。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Strawberry tree usually denotes Arbutus unedo; madrone mainly names certain North American Arbutus species; trailing arbutus corresponds to the regional North American sense and belongs to a different botanical genus.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 树上结着草莓模样的果实：记住“草莓树”，再单独记住北美的 trailing arbutus。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture strawberry-like fruits on an evergreen tree; learn trailing arbutus separately as the North American plant name.

etymology.text: 借自波斯语 bakhshīsh，来自 bakhshīdan（给予）。从“给一点钱”记住打赏或打点的意思。

etymology_story.zh: 该词源自波斯语 bakhshīsh，意为“赠予、礼物”，与动词 bakhshīdan“给予、赐予”相关，并通过多个地区的语言传播。英语保留了其金钱赠予的含义，可依语境表示小费、施舍或贿赂。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Persian bakhshīsh, meaning a gift or giving, related to bakhshīdan, 'to give or bestow,' and circulated through several regional languages. In English, its monetary meanings include tips, charitable gifts, and bribes, depending on context.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中按整体借词分析：baksheesh，不拆成英语词根和词缀；通常作不可数名词。常见异体拼写包括 bakshish 和 backsheesh；没有常用的现代英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats baksheesh as a whole loanword, without English root-and-affix segmentation; it is normally uncountable. Variant spellings include bakshish and backsheesh; it has no common modern English derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tip（小费）侧重对服务的酬谢；bribe（贿赂）明确表示为影响行为而提供的不正当利益；alms（施舍）专指给穷人的救济。baksheesh 的具体性质取决于付款目的和语境。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A tip rewards service; a bribe is an improper payment intended to influence behavior; alms are charitable gifts to poor people. Which meaning baksheesh carries depends on the purpose and context of the payment.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住源义“给一点钱”：谢服务是小费，济贫是施舍，买通人是贿赂。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with 'giving money': for service, a tip; for need, alms; for improper influence, a bribe.

etymology_story.zh: 该词借自法语 bibelot，意为小饰物或小古玩，英语沿用了它表示精巧陈设品的含义。其更早的词源并不确定，不宜根据现代拼写臆造词根解释。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed bibelot from French bibelot, meaning a trinket or small curio, retaining its association with decorative collectibles. Its earlier origin is uncertain, so a root explanation based merely on its modern spelling would be unreliable.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再作有效拆分的法语借词：bibelot；复数为 bibelots。词尾 t 按常见的法语式英语读法不发音；没有常用的能产派生词族，bibelot collection（小摆件收藏）属于短语组合。
morphology_enriched.en: Bibelot is an unanalyzed French loanword in modern English; its plural is bibelots. The final t is silent in the usual French-style English pronunciation; there is no common productive derivational family, and bibelot collection is a phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: trinket（小饰物）常暗示体积小、价值不高，也可指佩戴的饰品；knick-knack（小摆设）更口语化，常指家中零星陈设；curio（小古玩、珍奇物）强调稀奇和收藏趣味。bibelot 带有较文雅的收藏或装饰语感。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Trinket often suggests a small object of little value and can include jewelry; knick-knack is more informal and commonly refers to household ornaments; curio emphasizes unusualness and collectible interest. Bibelot has a more literary or connoisseurial tone.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a finely made ornament small enough to sit in your palm or on a mantelpiece.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆；bosque + habitat → bosque habitat（小树林栖息地）。

etymology.text: 这个用法是英语 bosk 的异体，沿用“小树林”的意义与读音。先把 bosque 和 bosk 两种写法连在一起，记住一小片树木的整体画面。

senses.meaning_zh: 林地；尤指美国西南部河流沿岸的林带
senses.meaning_en: Woodland, especially a riverside forest in the southwestern United States.
senses.english_definition: A bosque is an area of woodland, especially one growing along a river in the southwestern United States.
senses.collocation_en: riparian bosque; cottonwood bosque
senses.collocation_zh: 河岸林地；棉白杨河岸林
senses.sentence_en: The trail follows the river through a bosque of cottonwoods and willows.
senses.sentence_zh: 这条小径沿河延伸，穿过一片由棉白杨和柳树组成的河岸林。

etymology_story.zh: 英语这一地区性用词借自西班牙语 bosque，意为“森林、林地”。它在美国西南部尤其用于河岸林，因为这些林带在周围较干旱的景观中十分突出。
etymology_story.en: This regional English word was borrowed from Spanish bosque, meaning 'forest' or 'woodland.' In the southwestern United States, it became particularly associated with riverside forests that stand out within otherwise dry landscapes.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中按整体西班牙语借词处理：bosque；复数为 bosques。常见组合有 bosque habitat（河岸林栖息地）和 bosque restoration（河岸林恢复）；没有常用派生词族。这里的现代区域用法应与 bosk（小树林）区别学习。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats bosque as a whole Spanish loanword; its plural is bosques. Common combinations include bosque habitat and bosque restoration; there is no common derivational family. This modern regional use should be learned separately from bosk, meaning a small wood or thicket.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: woodland（林地）是广义名称，不限定地理位置；grove（小树林）通常强调面积较小的一群树；riparian forest（河岸林）准确强调沿河生长的森林，但不限定美国西南部。bosque 通常兼有地区和生态语境。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Woodland is a broad term without a geographical restriction; grove usually suggests a relatively small group of trees; riparian forest specifically identifies riverside forest without restricting it to the American Southwest. Bosque typically carries both regional and ecological associations.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 在干旱的美国西南部，沿河出现的一条绿色林带，就是典型的 bosque。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a green ribbon of trees following a river through the dry American Southwest: a typical bosque.

usage_note: 罕见学术名词，通常不可数；本词释义不意味着仅凭面部表情就能可靠判断真实情绪。不要与疾病诊断词 pathognomonic 混用。

senses.meaning_zh: 情态学；通过表情、动作等外在表现研究或辨识情绪
senses.meaning_en: The study or interpretation of emotions through their outward expression.
senses.english_definition: Pathognomy is the study of how emotions are expressed through a person's face, gestures, and other outward signs.
senses.collocation_en: the study of pathognomy; physiognomy and pathognomy
senses.collocation_zh: 情态学研究；相貌学与情态学
senses.sentence_en: The treatise distinguishes physiognomy, concerned with lasting character, from pathognomy, concerned with the outward signs of emotion.
senses.sentence_zh: 这部论著区分了研究持久性格特征的相貌学与研究情绪外在表现的情态学。

etymology_story.zh: 这个学术词结合了源自希腊语 pathos“感受、情绪”的构词成分，以及与“判断、辨识”有关的 -gnomy，构词形式与 physiognomy（相貌学）相呼应。它在历史论述中用于研究情绪的外在表现，常与通过固定相貌推断性格的做法相区分。
etymology_story.en: This learned term combines an element from Greek pathos, 'feeling or emotion,' with -gnomy, associated with judging or interpreting, on the pattern of physiognomy. Historically, it concerned the outward expression of emotions and was often distinguished from attempts to infer lasting character from fixed physical features.

morphology_enriched.zh: 学术构词分析为 patho-（感受、情绪）+ -gnomy（判断、辨识）→ pathognomy。相关派生形式有 pathognomic、pathognomical（情态学的；表现情绪的）及 pathognomically（以情态表现的方式）；这些形式均较罕见。应与医学术语 pathognomonic（具有特征性诊断意义的）区别。
morphology_enriched.en: The learned formation is patho- ('feeling or emotion') + -gnomy ('judging or interpreting') → pathognomy. Related derivatives include pathognomic, pathognomical, and pathognomically; all are uncommon. They should be distinguished from the medical term pathognomonic, meaning specifically diagnostic of a disease.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: emotion recognition（情绪识别）侧重识别情绪这一过程，也可涉及声音等线索；facial-expression analysis（面部表情分析）只聚焦面部表现；physiognomy（相貌学）是历史上的相关概念，侧重以相貌推断性格，并非严格近义词。pathognomy 是研究情绪外在表达的罕见历史性术语。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Emotion recognition emphasizes identifying emotions and can include cues such as voice; facial-expression analysis focuses specifically on the face; physiognomy is a historically related concept concerned with inferring character from appearance, rather than a strict synonym. Pathognomy is a rare historical term for studying outward emotional expression.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: patho- 抓住“情绪”，-gnomy 抓住“辨识”：从表情动作读出情绪。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect patho- with emotion and -gnomy with interpretation: read emotion through its visible expression.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆；ondansetron + tablet → ondansetron tablet（昂丹司琼片）。

usage_note: 通用药名，通常小写；本卡练习识别词义，不涉及剂量、适用人群或治疗选择。

etymology_story.zh: Ondansetron 是现代创制的药物通用名，其命名词干 -setron 表示作用于血清素系统的特定受体拮抗剂。词首部分不宜凭日常英语词根推断含义。
etymology_story.en: Ondansetron is a coined modern generic drug name containing the naming stem -setron, used for a particular group of serotonin-receptor antagonists. Its opening elements should not be interpreted as ordinary English roots.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 ondansetron 作为完整药名识记；-setron 是药物命名词干，不是普通英语中可自由使用的后缀。没有常用的动词、形容词或副词派生形式；ondansetron hydrochloride（盐酸昂丹司琼）和 ondansetron tablet（昂丹司琼片）是术语组合，并非派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, ondansetron is learned as a complete drug name; -setron is a pharmaceutical naming stem rather than a freely productive English suffix. There are no common derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs; ondansetron hydrochloride and ondansetron tablet are technical combinations, not derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Zofran（枢复宁）是昂丹司琼的商品名；antiemetic（止吐药）是范围更广的药物类别名称；granisetron（格拉司琼）是同类中的另一种药物，并非昂丹司琼的同义名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Zofran is a brand name for ondansetron; antiemetic names the broader drug category; granisetron is another medicine in the same general class, not a synonym for ondansetron.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看到 -setron，联想到血清素受体拮抗剂这一药名家族；ondansetron 整体对应“昂丹司琼”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let -setron cue the serotonin-receptor antagonist naming family, and learn ondansetron as one complete medicine name.

etymology.text: 源于非洲语言，在加勒比地区的英语中用于这一民间信仰。词源还联系到伊博语 díbìà（民间治疗者）；用“非洲传统随人群进入加勒比”的背景来记忆。

usage_note: 通常不可数；用于历史或文化描述时应保持尊重，不能据词义把信仰者简单等同于作恶者。

senses.meaning_zh: 奥比术；加勒比地区源于非洲传统的灵性、治疗及仪式实践
senses.meaning_en: African-derived spiritual, healing, and ritual practices in the Caribbean
senses.english_definition: Obeah is a name used in parts of the Caribbean for spiritual and ritual practices that draw on African traditions and may involve healing or protection.
senses.collocation_en: practise obeah; an obeah practitioner
senses.collocation_zh: 从事奥比术；奥比术实践者
