etymology_story.zh: Legco 由 Legislative Council 两个词的开头部分缩合而成，是英语机构名称的简称，并非外来借词。香港立法会的官方英文通常采用 LegCo 这一大小写形式。[词典释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/legco)；[官方用法](https://www.legco.gov.hk/en/index.html)。
etymology_story.en: Legco combines the opening portions of Legislative and Council, making it a shortened English institutional name rather than a foreign borrowing. Hong Kong's Legislative Council normally uses the capitalization LegCo in official English. [Dictionary entry](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/legco); [official usage](https://www.legco.gov.hk/en/index.html).

morphology_enriched.zh: Legislative 的 Leg- + Council 的 Co- → LegCo，属于截短成分组合，不是英语前缀加词根。Legco、LegCo 是大小写变体；常见组合包括 LegCo member（立法会议员）、LegCo election（立法会选举）和 LegCo Secretariat（立法会秘书处）；作为特定机构名称通常不用复数，没有常用派生动词、形容词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: Leg- from Legislative + Co- from Council → LegCo combines clipped word parts rather than a prefix and root. Legco and LegCo are capitalization variants. Common combinations include LegCo member, LegCo election, and LegCo Secretariat; the name normally has no plural when referring to this institution and has no common derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Legislative Council（立法会）是对应的完整名称；Hong Kong legislature（香港立法机关）是描述性近义表达；council（议会；委员会）范围很广，只有上下文清楚时才能代指该机构。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Legislative Council is the corresponding full name; Hong Kong legislature is a descriptive equivalent. Council is much broader and identifies this particular institution only when the context makes the reference clear.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Take Leg from Legislative and Co from Council: LegCo.

senses.meaning_en: An informal contextual shortening of Geiger counter.

etymology_story.zh: Geiger 在英语中首先是来自德语的姓氏；仪器名称 Geiger counter 使用的是物理学家汉斯·盖革的姓。单独用 Geiger 指仪器依赖省略和上下文，标准、明确的名称仍是 Geiger counter。[人名词条](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/geiger)；[仪器词条](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/geiger-counter)。
etymology_story.en: In English, Geiger is primarily a surname of German origin; Geiger counter incorporates the surname of the physicist Hans Geiger. Using Geiger alone for the instrument depends on contextual ellipsis, while Geiger counter is the standard explicit term. [Name entry](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/geiger); [instrument entry](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/geiger-counter).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Geiger 是不可按英语词缀拆解的姓氏。Geiger + counter → Geiger counter（盖革计数器），复数为 Geiger counters；相关人名术语有 Geiger–Müller counter（盖革—米勒计数器）和 Geiger–Müller tube（盖革—米勒计数管），属于纪念人名的组合术语，没有常用的派生动词、形容词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Geiger is a surname that cannot be analyzed into English affixes. Geiger + counter → Geiger counter, with the plural Geiger counters. Related eponymous terms include Geiger–Müller counter and Geiger–Müller tube; these are combinations commemorating people, with no common derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 人名 Geiger 没有同义词。仪器义中，Geiger counter（盖革计数器）是标准完整表达，Geiger–Müller counter（盖革—米勒计数器）是更完整的技术名称；radiation detector（辐射探测器）是上位词，还包括采用其他探测原理的设备。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The surname Geiger has no synonym. For the instrument, Geiger counter is the standard full expression, and Geiger–Müller counter is the fuller technical name; radiation detector is broader and includes devices using other detection principles.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 人名 Geiger + 计数器 counter：用盖革的名字记住探测辐射的仪器。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Geiger names the physicist; counter names the instrument that counts radiation events.

senses.meaning_zh: 国家；政权（见于 coup d'état 等短语）
senses.meaning_en: The state or government, as in the borrowed expression coup d'état.
senses.english_definition: In the expression coup d'état, état means the state whose government is suddenly taken over.

etymology_story.zh: 法语 état 经古法语 estat 源自拉丁语 status，原有“站立方式、地位、状态”等含义，后来也发展出“国家”的意思。英语主要借入包含该词的完整法语表达，而不是把 etat 广泛用作独立名词。
etymology_story.en: French état developed through Old French estat from Latin status, meaning a standing, position, or condition, and later also acquired the meaning 'state' as a political entity. English chiefly borrowed complete French expressions containing the word rather than adopting etat as a widely used independent noun.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中不宜拆分为词根和词缀；规范法语拼写为 état，etat 是省略重音符号的写法。法语复数为 états；英语借入表达包括 coup d'état（政变）和 raison d'état（国家利益至上的理由）；state、status、estate 是历史相关词，并非由现代 etat 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: There is no productive root-and-affix breakdown in modern English; état is the standard French spelling, while etat omits the accent. The French plural is états; borrowed expressions include coup d'état and raison d'état. State, status, and estate are historical relatives, not modern derivatives of etat.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: state（状态；国家）意义最接近，但须依语境判断；condition（状况）侧重身体、事物或环境的实际情况；status（身份、地位）侧重社会或法律上的位置。普通英语中通常应使用这些词，而非独立使用 etat。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: State is the closest equivalent but may describe either a condition or a political entity; condition emphasizes how someone or something actually is; status emphasizes social or legal standing. These are the usual choices in ordinary English instead of standalone etat.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 état 与 state 联系起来：一个是“所处状态”，另一个也可以是“国家”；政变就是对国家政权的一击。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect état with state: it can describe a condition or a political state; a coup d'état is a sudden blow against state power.

usage_note: 带古旧、文学色彩，日常更常说 noise、commotion 或 hurly-burly；不等于 hurry 所表达的匆忙。

senses.pos: n. 名词（古旧或文学用法）
senses.meaning_zh: 喧嚣；骚动；忙乱
senses.meaning_en: Noisy confusion, commotion, or bustle.
senses.english_definition: A hurly is a situation in which there is a lot of confused noise and activity.
senses.collocation_en: hurly-burly; the hurly-burly of daily life (the usual surviving compound)
senses.collocation_zh: 喧闹忙乱；日常生活的纷扰（通常见于保留下来的复合词 hurly-burly）

senses.sentence_zh: 他们想找一处安静的地方，避开城镇的喧嚣。

etymology_story.zh: hurly 来自中古英语中表示骚动、纷扰的词形，通常认为与 hurl（猛掷、猛烈移动）有关，但具体来源并不完全确定。它后来主要保留在押韵复合词 hurly-burly 中；burly 在这里是押韵成分，不表示“魁梧的”。
etymology_story.en: Hurly comes from Middle English forms referring to commotion and is generally connected with hurl, although its precise origin is uncertain. It survives chiefly in the rhyming compound hurly-burly, whose second element is an echoing formation rather than burly meaning 'strongly built.'

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 hurly 作为整体词干理解，不宜机械拆成 hurl + 副词后缀 -ly；它在这里是名词。hurly + 押韵成分 burly → hurly-burly（喧闹、纷扰）；历史相关词有 hurl（猛掷）、hurled、hurling 和 hurler（投掷者），但这些不是由 hurly 派生的。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat hurly as a whole stem in modern English, not mechanically as hurl plus the adverb suffix -ly; it functions here as a noun. Hurly + the rhyming element burly gives hurly-burly. Historical relatives include hurl, hurled, hurling, and hurler, but these are not derivatives of hurly.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: commotion（骚动）侧重突然引人注意的混乱活动；bustle（忙碌喧闹）侧重人群活跃往来的场面；uproar（喧嚣、哗然）侧重强烈噪声或公众愤怒。hurly 带明显古旧或文学色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Commotion emphasizes disruptive or conspicuous activity; bustle emphasizes lively movement and busyness; uproar emphasizes loud noise or public outrage. Hurly has a distinctly archaic or literary tone.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 联想 hurl“猛掷”：人声和脚步仿佛被抛来抛去，形成一片喧嚣；这是记忆联想，不是确定的构词公式。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture sounds and footsteps being hurled about into noisy confusion; this is a memory association, not a certain morphological derivation.

senses.meaning_zh: 山间盆状谷地；冰斗
senses.meaning_en: A bowl-shaped mountain hollow or valley, often formed by glacial erosion.
senses.english_definition: A cwm is a rounded hollow among mountains, often one that was formed by a glacier.
senses.collocation_en: a glacial cwm; the floor of a cwm
senses.collocation_zh: 冰川形成的冰斗；冰斗底部

etymology_story.zh: cwm 直接借自威尔士语，原意为“山谷”，也常见于威尔士地名。进入英语地理用语后，它尤其用于指山间盆状谷地或冰川侵蚀形成的冰斗。
etymology_story.en: Cwm was borrowed directly from Welsh, where it means 'valley' and occurs frequently in place names. In English geographical usage, it particularly denotes a mountain hollow or a cirque formed by glacial erosion.

morphology_enriched.zh: 整体借词，无可用于现代英语分析的词根加词缀结构；复数为 cwms。cwm + floor → cwm floor（冰斗底部）属于名词组合，不是派生词；没有常用的英语派生词族，w 在这个词中表示元音 /uː/。
morphology_enriched.en: This is an unanalyzed loanword with no productive English root-and-affix structure; its plural is cwms. Cwm + floor gives the noun combination cwm floor, not a derivative. There is no established common English derivative family, and w represents the vowel /uː/.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cirque（冰斗）是明确强调冰川成因的地貌术语；corrie（冰斗）尤用于苏格兰地理语境；valley（山谷）范围更广，不限定盆状形态或冰川成因。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cirque is a technical term that specifically identifies a glacial hollow; corrie is especially associated with Scottish geographical usage; valley is broader and does not imply either a bowl shape or a glacial origin.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住“w 在这里读长 /uː/”，再把 cwm 想成山里的一只大碗。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let w supply the long /uː/ sound, and picture a cwm as a great bowl among mountains.

senses.pos: n. 可数名词（地貌学术语）
senses.meaning_zh: 石灰岩地表经溶蚀扩大的裂隙；溶沟
senses.meaning_en: A fissure in a limestone pavement enlarged by dissolution.
senses.english_definition: A gryke is a deep crack between blocks of limestone that has been widened as water dissolves the rock.

senses.collocation_zh: 深的石灰岩溶蚀裂隙；石灰岩块及其间的溶蚀裂隙

senses.sentence_zh: 蕨类植物生长在石灰岩块之间潮湿的溶蚀裂隙中。

etymology_story.zh: gryke 是 grike 的变体拼写，源于英格兰北部表示裂缝或裂隙的方言词，其更早来源不确定。地貌学沿用该词，专指石灰岩地表被水溶蚀扩大的裂隙。
etymology_story.en: Gryke is a variant spelling of grike, a northern English dialect word for a crack or fissure whose earlier origin is uncertain. Geomorphology adopted it specifically for fissures enlarged by dissolution in limestone pavements.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为整体词干，不宜拆分，也不应直接判作外来借词；复数为 grykes。变体 grike 的复数为 grikes；gryke + depth → gryke depth（溶蚀裂隙深度）是名词组合，没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, gryke is a whole stem with no useful internal breakdown and should not simply be classified as a foreign loanword; its plural is grykes. The variant grike has the plural grikes. Gryke + depth gives the noun combination gryke depth; there is no established common derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fissure（裂隙）是适用于多种材料和地貌的广义词；crevice（狭缝）强调狭窄的开口；joint（节理）指岩石中的天然断裂，本身不一定已经受溶蚀扩大。gryke 则特指石灰岩地表的这类溶蚀裂隙。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fissure is a broad term for a split in many materials or landforms; crevice emphasizes a narrow opening; joint is a natural fracture in rock that need not have been enlarged by dissolution. Gryke specifically identifies such an enlarged fissure in a limestone pavement.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住形成过程：岩石先裂，雨水再溶，裂缝逐渐变成深槽。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the process: rock cracks, water dissolves its sides, and the crack becomes a deep slot.

etymology_story.zh: 这座城市的名称是为了纪念法国军人 François-Gaston de Lévis（弗朗索瓦－加斯东·德·莱维），他曾在新法兰西作战。规范地名拼写为 Lévis，Levis 是省略尖音符号的写法。
etymology_story.en: The city was named in honor of François-Gaston de Lévis, a French military officer who served in New France. Lévis is the standard spelling of the place name; Levis is a rendering without the acute accent.

morphology_enriched.zh: 作为整体专名处理，没有现代英语词根加词缀的构词结构；末尾 s 是名称的一部分，不是复数标记。Lévis + ferry → Lévis ferry（莱维渡轮）是专名作定语的组合；法语居民称谓为 Lévisien（男性）和 Lévisienne（女性），英语通常用 resident of Lévis（莱维居民）。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat this as an indivisible proper name, with no modern English root-and-affix structure; the final s belongs to the name and is not a plural ending. Lévis + ferry gives a combination in which the proper name modifies a noun. French resident terms are Lévisien for a man and Lévisienne for a woman; English commonly uses resident of Lévis.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 该专名没有真正的近义词。Lévis 是规范拼写，Levis 是省略重音符号的形式；the city of Lévis（莱维市）是展开表述，均指同一城市，不应与牛仔裤品牌 Levi's 混淆。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: This proper name has no true synonyms. Lévis is the standard spelling, Levis omits the accent, and the city of Lévis is an expanded reference to the same place; none should be confused with the jeans brand Levi's.

etymology_story.zh: 这一鸡种名称是 Cochin China 的缩略形式，保留了十九世纪使用的历史地名标签。该品种实际源于中国，因此名称不能直接作为其来自交趾支那的证据。
etymology_story.en: The breed name is shortened from Cochin China, preserving a geographical label used in the nineteenth century. The breed actually originated in China, so its name should not be taken as evidence of an origin in Cochinchina.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Cochin 是不可继续分析的品种名称，没有可拆分的英语词根和词缀。常用词形：Cochin → Cochins（复数）；相关词组：Cochin chicken（柯钦鸡）、bantam Cochin（矮脚柯钦鸡）。它修饰 chicken 时属于名词作定语，不必另立形容词词性；没有常用的派生动词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Cochin is an unanalyzed breed name with no separable English root or affixes. The regular plural is Cochins; related phrases include Cochin chicken and bantam Cochin. Its use before chicken is attributive noun use and does not require a separate adjective entry; there are no established common verb or adverb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chicken（鸡）是上位词，不限定品种；fowl（家禽、鸡）范围较宽，语体也较传统；Brahma（婆罗门鸡）是另一种腿脚有羽毛的大型鸡，不能与 Cochin 当作同一品种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chicken is the general term and does not identify a breed; fowl is broader and somewhat more traditional in register; Brahma names a different large, feather-legged breed and is not an exact synonym of Cochin.

mnemonic_anchor.en: An old geographical label became a breed name: picture a large chicken wearing feather boots.

etymology_story.zh: 借自法语 plage，意为“海滩、岸边”，通常追溯到后期拉丁语 plagia，并进一步联系到希腊语中表示“侧面”的词。英语后来又把它用于太阳表面观测中的明亮区域，形成天文学义。
etymology_story.en: Plage was borrowed from French, meaning 'beach' or 'shore,' usually traced through Late Latin plagia to a Greek word meaning 'side.' English later also applied the word to bright regions observed on the Sun.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：plage（完整借词词干）+ -s → plages（复数），不能把词尾 -age 当作此词中的英语派生后缀。相关词组有 solar plage（太阳谱斑）、plage region（谱斑区）；没有常用的英语派生词族。海滩义在英语中较少见，通常用 beach；天文学义属于专业用语。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: plage, a complete borrowed stem, + -s → plages. The ending -age is not an English derivational suffix within this word. Related phrases include solar plage and plage region; there is no established common English derivative family. The beach sense is uncommon in English, where beach is usual, while the astronomical sense is technical.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: beach（海滩）是最普通的对应词；shore（岸边）范围更广，也可指湖岸或其他水域边缘；seaside resort（海滨度假地）指整个度假地点，而非其中的一片海滩。这些词都不能替代天文学义的 plage。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Beach is the ordinary equivalent of the coastal sense; shore is broader and can refer to the edge of a lake or another body of water; seaside resort means the whole holiday destination rather than its beach. None of these replaces plage in astronomy.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with the French beach meaning, then picture a solar bright patch as a sunlit beach; the second connection is a memory image.

etymology_story.zh: skelter 通常被视为从押韵表达 helter-skelter 中分离出来的动词，保留了“匆忙、混乱地移动”的意思。helter-skelter 属于表现动作和节奏的押韵构词，其更深层来源并不完全确定。
etymology_story.en: Skelter is generally treated as a verb extracted from the rhyming expression helter-skelter, retaining its idea of hurried, disorderly movement. Helter-skelter is an expressive rhyming formation whose deeper origin is not fully certain.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 skelter 是不可再拆的动词词干，并非外来借词，也不含表示施事者的后缀 -er。词形：skelter → skelters → skeltered → skeltering；相关表达 helter-skelter 可作副词或形容词，英式英语中还可作名词表示螺旋滑梯，但这些词性不自动属于独立词 skelter。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, skelter is an unanalyzed verb stem, not a foreign loanword, and its ending is not the agent suffix -er. Its forms are skelter, skelters, skeltered, and skeltering. The related expression helter-skelter can function as an adverb or adjective and, in British English, as a noun for a spiral slide; those uses do not automatically belong to standalone skelter.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: scurry（急匆匆地小步跑）强调快速的小步移动；scramble（争先恐后或手忙脚乱地移动）强调困难、费力或混乱；dash（猛冲）强调突然和速度。skelter 特别突出慌乱无序，而且比这些词少见。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Scurry suggests quick movement with short steps; scramble suggests awkward, effortful, or confused movement; dash emphasizes sudden speed. Skelter particularly suggests disorder and is much less common than these alternatives.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 由 helter-skelter 的急促押韵，记住 skelter 的“慌乱急奔”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use the tumbling rhythm of helter-skelter to remember skelter: hurry along in confusion.

etymology_story.zh: 栗子义借自法语 marron，法语词通常追溯到意大利语 marrone，英语尤其在烹饪和甜点语境中使用。澳大利亚螯虾义则来自澳大利亚西南部的原住民语言 Noongar，与法语栗子词属于不同来源的同形词。
etymology_story.en: The chestnut sense comes from French marron, usually traced to Italian marrone, and is used especially in culinary contexts in English. The Australian crayfish sense comes from Noongar, an Aboriginal language of southwestern Australia, and is a separate word with the same spelling.

morphology_enriched.zh: 两个来源的 marron 在现代英语中都作为完整词干使用，不能按英语词缀硬拆。栗子义通常用复数 marrons；螯虾义的复数可用 marron 或 marrons，表示食材时可作不可数名词。相关烹饪表达：marron glacé → marrons glacés（糖渍栗子，保留法语复数形式）、marron purée（栗子泥）；这些是词组，不是英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Both historically separate words function as complete stems in modern English and should not be divided into English affixes. The chestnut sense normally has the plural marrons; the crayfish sense allows marron or marrons, and the food use can be uncountable. Culinary expressions include marron glacé, plural marrons glacés with French plural marking, and marron purée; these are phrases rather than English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chestnut（栗子）范围较广，marron 通常突出较大的食用甜栗；marron glacé（糖渍栗子）特指加工后的甜食。螯虾义对应 crayfish（螯虾），但 crayfish 是上位词，并不专指澳大利亚的 marron。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chestnut is broader, while marron usually denotes a large edible sweet chestnut; marron glacé specifically means the prepared candied sweet. For the Australian sense, crayfish is the broader term and does not specifically identify marron.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 分开记两个来源：法式甜点盘里的栗子，澳大利亚河水里的螯虾。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep two origins apart: a chestnut on a French dessert plate, and a crayfish in an Australian river.

etymology_story.zh: 来自梵语 kāma，意为“欲望、爱、愉悦”；同一个词既可表示人生追求中的欲乐，也被人格化为爱神的名字。英语通常用大写 Kama 表示神名，用小写 kama 表示这一概念。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Sanskrit kāma, meaning 'desire,' 'love,' or 'pleasure'; the same word denotes an aim of human life and, when personified, the god of love. English generally uses capitalized Kama for the deity and lowercase kama for the concept.

morphology_enriched.zh: Kama／kama 在现代英语中是完整借词，没有可拆分的英语前后缀；神名和抽象概念通常都不使用普通复数。相关名称 Kamadeva 来自梵语 kāma（爱、欲望）+ deva（神），意为“爱神”；Kama Sutra 来自 kāma + sūtra（格言、论典），是相关梵语复合名称，不是英语词缀派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Kama/kama is a complete loanword in modern English, with no separable English prefixes or suffixes; neither the deity's name nor the abstract concept normally takes an ordinary plural. The related name Kamadeva combines Sanskrit kāma, 'love or desire,' with deva, 'god.' Kama Sutra combines kāma with sūtra, 'aphorism or treatise'; these are Sanskrit compound names rather than English affix derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: desire（欲望）最接近 kama 的抽象核心义，但缺少其印度思想背景；sensual pleasure（感官享受）突出愉悦体验，未涵盖全部爱欲含义；Cupid（丘比特）是可供比较的罗马爱神，并非 Kama 的另一名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Desire comes closest to the abstract core of kama but lacks its Hindu philosophical setting; sensual pleasure emphasizes enjoyable experience without covering every aspect of love and desire; Cupid is a comparable Roman love god, not another name for Kama.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: kama 是“爱欲”，把爱欲人格化，就成为爱神 Kama。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Kama is desire personified: lowercase kama names the concept, and capitalized Kama names the god.

etymology_story.zh: Plantago 沿用拉丁语 plantāgō（车前草），其名称与 planta（脚掌）有关，通常解释为指某些种类宽阔、贴地、形似脚掌的叶片。该词后来成为现代植物分类中的属名。
etymology_story.en: Plantago preserves Latin plantāgō, meaning plantain, a name connected with planta, the sole of the foot, usually explained as referring to the broad, ground-level leaves of some species. The word subsequently became a genus name in modern botanical classification.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整的拉丁属名使用，不宜拆成英语 plant + 后缀。规范写法为首字母大写并用斜体：Plantago；Plantago + 种加词构成双名，如 Plantago major（大车前）。英语俗名 plantain 与其有历史联系，但不是现代英语直接加后缀形成的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, this is an intact Latin genus name, not English plant plus a suffix. It conventionally takes an initial capital and italics: Plantago; adding a specific epithet produces a binomial such as Plantago major. The common name plantain is historically related, rather than a direct modern English suffixal derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: plantain（车前草）是俗名，也可指烹调用的大蕉，需依语境区分；ribwort plantain（长叶车前）专指其中一种，范围小于 Plantago。两者都不能在所有语境中替代正式属名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Plantain is the common plant name, but it can also denote a cooking banana; context distinguishes them. Ribwort plantain names one particular species and is narrower than Plantago. Neither expression universally replaces the formal genus name.

etymology_story.zh: 表示“混合”的动词可追溯至中古英语及古法语 mesler（混合），并发展出“掺和、干预”的意思。方言中表示“大槌”的名词属于另一个词源，不能解释为“混合”义的自然延伸。
etymology_story.en: The verb meaning mix goes back through Middle English to Old French mesler, with meanings extending to involvement and interference. The regional noun meaning a large hammer has a separate origin and should not be treated as a semantic development of mixing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式视为不可再拆的词干 mell。动词变化为 mell + -s → mells，mell + -ed → melled，mell + -ing → melling；名词复数为 mells。meddle 和 medley 与“混合”义动词有历史联系，但不是在现代 mell 上直接加后缀形成的词。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat mell as an unanalyzed modern stem. Its verb forms are mells, melled, and melling; the noun plural is mells. Meddle and medley are historically connected with the mixing verb, but they are not formed by directly adding modern suffixes to mell.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: mix（混合）是现代中性常用词；meddle（干预、瞎掺和）通常含不受欢迎的干涉意味；mallet（木槌、槌子）对应方言名词义，不涉及混合。mell 本身带明显的古语或地域色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mix is the ordinary neutral verb; meddle usually suggests unwelcome interference. Mallet corresponds to the regional noun and has nothing to do with mixing. Mell itself is distinctly archaic or regional.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 动词义记“混进去 → 掺和进去”；名词“大槌”另记，属于不同词源。
mnemonic_anchor.en: For the verb, remember mixing in, then getting involved; store the hammer noun separately because its origin is different.

etymology_story.zh: 该服饰名称来自法语 barbe（胡须），最终源自拉丁语 barba。布饰位于下颏、颈部，或从头饰向下垂落，因此借用了“胡须”的名称。
etymology_story.en: The clothing term comes from French barbe, meaning beard, ultimately from Latin barba. Its position around the chin and neck, or its downward-hanging form, explains the transfer from beard to fabric.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中把 barbe 作为完整借词处理，末尾 -e 不是可独立分析的英语后缀。barbe + -s → barbes（复数）；没有常用的现代派生词族。barber（理发师）与其共享“胡须”的历史词源，但不是由英语 barbe 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat barbe as a complete borrowing; its final -e is not a separable English suffix. Adding -s gives the plural barbes, and there is no established productive modern derivative family. Barber shares the historical beard root but is not directly derived from English barbe.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: wimple（包住头部、颈部和下颏的头巾）通常覆盖范围更大；lappet（头饰等的垂片或垂带）强调悬垂部分；veil（面纱、头纱）是更宽泛的遮盖物名称。它们与 barbe 有重叠，但并非完全等义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A wimple generally covers more of the head, neck, and chin; a lappet is specifically a hanging flap or strip. Veil is a broader term for a covering. These overlap with barbe without being exact equivalents.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: barbe 原义“胡须”→ 记住垂在下颏附近、像布制胡须的旧式服饰。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Barbe originally means beard: picture a historical fabric covering hanging where a beard would be.

etymology_story.zh: phut 是模仿低闷噗响的拟声词。表示“失灵、告吹”的 go phut 将这种声响与机器突然停转联系起来，随后也用于计划等事物的失败。
etymology_story.en: Phut is an imitative word representing a dull popping sound. The expression go phut associates that sound with a machine suddenly stopping and extends the idea to the failure of plans and other undertakings.

morphology_enriched.zh: phut 是拟声词干，不是可拆分的外来词根加后缀。名词复数为 phuts；动词变化为 phuts、phutted、phutting，添加 -ed 或 -ing 时双写 t。go phut 是固定表达，通常不把其中的 phut 另算作独立形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: Phut is an imitative stem, not a foreign root combined with an English suffix. The noun plural is phuts; verb forms are phuts, phutted, and phutting, with t doubled before -ed and -ing. Go phut is a fixed expression, and its phut need not be counted again as a separate adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pop（啪声、砰声）通常更清脆；puff（噗声、喷气）强调气流喷出；conk out（机器突然停转）接近 go phut 的故障义，但不直接描摹声音。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pop usually suggests a sharper sound; puff emphasizes a small burst of air. Conk out is close to go phut in meaning mechanical failure, but it does not directly represent a sound.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 听见“噗”一声 → 机器没动静了 → go phut，失灵。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hear a little phut, then silence: the machine has gone phut and stopped working.

etymology_story.zh: 该词来自希腊神话中的海神 Prōteus，借其能变化形体的特征，产生了“善变的人”这一比喻义。这个名字还被用于不同的科学属名；细菌属 Proteus 的命名与其培养时呈现的多变形态有关。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Prōteus, the shape-changing sea god of Greek mythology, whose abilities inspired the figurative sense of a changeable person. His name was also adopted for separate scientific genera; its use for the bacterial genus refers to the organisms' variable forms in culture.

morphology_enriched.zh: proteus／Proteus 是完整的希腊来源名称，不能按现代英语拆成 pro- + 其他部分。属名首字母大写并用斜体；表示单个细菌宜用 a Proteus bacterium，复数用 Proteus bacteria。相关词 protean（多变的、变化多端的）来自同一神话名称，并不专指变形杆菌；与 protein（蛋白质）不是同一个现代词干。
morphology_enriched.en: Proteus is an intact name of Greek origin, not modern English pro- plus another element. Genus names take an initial capital and italics; use a Proteus bacterium for one bacterial organism and Proteus bacteria for several. Protean, meaning highly changeable or versatile, comes from the same mythological name and is not specifically a bacterial adjective; protein is a different modern stem.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: olm（洞螈）是动物义的常用名称；shapeshifter（变形者）强调形体变化；chameleon（变色龙、善于随环境改变自己的人）在比喻义上强调适应或迎合。细菌属名 Proteus 没有可随意替换的普通近义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Olm is the usual common name for the salamander. Shapeshifter emphasizes changes of physical form, while figurative chameleon emphasizes adapting to circumstances or other people. The bacterial genus name Proteus has no freely interchangeable everyday synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 普罗透斯会变形 → protean“多变的”；科学名称 Proteus 也借用了这个名字，但细菌与洞螈属于不同生物类群。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Proteus changes shape, so protean means changeable; the scientific names borrow the same name, although the bacteria and salamander belong to different biological groups.

etymology_story.zh: 该词可追溯到中古英语表示树桩或木桩的 stob，与 stub 属于关系密切的日耳曼语词汇。它在苏格兰及其他地区用语中保留下来，并形成了“打桩”和“刺、戳”等动词义。
etymology_story.en: The word goes back to Middle English stob, meaning a stump or stake, and belongs to Germanic vocabulary closely related to stub. It survived in Scottish and other regional usage and developed verbal meanings involving stakes and piercing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 stob 是不可再作常规词缀分析的词根：stob + -s → stobs（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）；stob + -ed → stobbed；stob + -ing → stobbing，后两者需双写 b。名词转动词属于零派生；fence stob 是词组，不是词缀派生词，现代通用英语中没有广泛使用的进一步派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, stob is a simple base: stob + -s → stobs, the plural noun or third-person singular verb; stob + -ed → stobbed; stob + -ing → stobbing, with b doubled in the last two forms. The verb represents conversion from the noun; fence stob is a phrase, and there is no widely used further derivational family in general English.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: stake 通常指打入地面的尖头桩；post 通常指较牢固、承担支撑作用的柱子；stab 对应动词“刺”，是通用英语词。stob 则具有明显的地区色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Stake usually suggests a pointed piece driven into the ground; post usually suggests a substantial upright support; stab corresponds to the piercing verb and is standard English. Stob has a distinctly regional character.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“一截竖起的短木头”：它是木桩，也能引出打桩和尖物刺入的动作。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a short upright piece of wood: the stake connects naturally with staking ground and pushing a point into something.

etymology.text: 来自中古英语 abien、abiggen 等形式，早先指付钱购买，也指用劳苦或痛苦付出代价，后来有为某事受罚的意思。把“付钱”转为“付出代价”来记。

usage_note: 古语，多在旧文学中遇到；现代通常说 pay for 或 suffer for。可直接接所受罚的行为，如 aby a mistake；另有拼写 abye。

etymology_story.zh: aby 经中古英语相关形式源自古英语 ābycgan，基本意思是“买下、付钱取得”，其中 bycgan 也是 buy 的来源。“付钱购买”后来引申为“以痛苦为代价”以及“为某事受罚”。
etymology_story.en: Through Middle English forms, aby descends from Old English ābycgan, meaning to buy or pay for; bycgan also underlies buy. Paying for something developed into paying through suffering and consequently suffering a penalty.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语应将 aby 作为整体古语词干处理，不宜把它解释为仍能自由组合的 a- + buy。相关形式包括异体 abye、现在分词 abying，以及历史上的过去式和过去分词 abought；buy 是历史同源词，不是由现代 aby 派生的词，现代英语中没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, aby is best treated as a whole archaic stem rather than a productive combination of a- and buy. Related forms include the variant abye, the present participle abying, and the historical past tense and past participle abought; buy is a historical relative, not a modern derivative, and there is no commonly used derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pay for 强调承担行为的后果，最接近日常表达；atone for 强调通过行动赎过；expiate 是正式词，强调赎罪或消除罪责。aby 更突出受苦、受罚，并带有古语色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pay for emphasizes experiencing consequences and is the most ordinary equivalent; atone for emphasizes making amends; expiate is formal and emphasizes dealing with guilt through atonement. Aby particularly suggests suffering a penalty and is archaic.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用历史上的 buy 联系来记：从“花钱买下”转到“为行为买单”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use its historical connection with buy: paying a purchase price becomes paying the price for an action.

etymology_story.zh: toft 借自古诺尔斯语 topt，意为住宅用地或宅址，反映了斯堪的纳维亚语言对英格兰部分地区的影响。它后来主要保留在地名、历史土地记录和聚落考古术语中。
etymology_story.en: Toft was borrowed from Old Norse topt, meaning a house site or homestead plot, reflecting Scandinavian influence in parts of England. It subsequently survived mainly in place names, historical land records, and the terminology of settlement archaeology.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词分析为整体词根 toft；toft + -s → tofts（复数）。toft and croft 是传统并列词组，分别指宅基地和附属小块农地；地名中的 -toft 是同源地名成分，不应当作现代英语中能自由构词的后缀，现代通用英语中没有常用的进一步派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern morphological base is the whole word toft; toft + -s → tofts forms the plural. Toft and croft is a traditional coordinated phrase referring to the house plot and its associated small field; place-name -toft is a historically related element rather than a freely productive modern suffix, and there is no commonly used further derivational family in general English.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: house plot 是较透明的普通描述，指建房或已有房屋的地块；homestead 通常连同住宅、附属建筑及相关土地一起指称；croft 指小块农地或小农场，并不专指住宅基址。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: House plot is a transparent general description of land for or containing a house; homestead usually includes the dwelling, associated buildings, and land; croft denotes a small agricultural holding or field rather than specifically the house site.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借用了植物学拉丁语属名 Aquilegia。该名称常被解释为与拉丁语 aquila（鹰）有关，可能因为花距像鹰爪，但其具体词源和命名动机存在争议。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the botanical Latin genus name Aquilegia. The name is often connected with Latin aquila, meaning eagle, possibly because the flower spurs resemble an eagle's claws, although its precise derivation and naming motivation are disputed.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语把 aquilegia 作为整体借词处理，不宜硬拆成 aqua- 等看似熟悉的成分；aquilegia + -s → aquilegias（复数）。小写 aquilegia 是普通植物名称，大写 Aquilegia 是属名；aquilegia seeds 等是名词修饰名词的组合，并不构成独立形容词词性，现代通用英语中没有常用的进一步派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats aquilegia as a whole borrowed base, rather than dividing it into apparently familiar elements such as aqua-; aquilegia + -s → aquilegias forms the plural. Lowercase aquilegia is a common plant name, while capitalized Aquilegia names the genus; combinations such as aquilegia seeds use a noun attributively and do not establish a separate adjective, and there is no commonly used further derivational family in general English.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: columbine 是对应的常用英语植物名称；granny's bonnet 是带有英国民间色彩的俗称，常使人联想到普通园艺耧斗菜。aquilegia 在园艺语境中更接近学名式称呼。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Columbine is the corresponding everyday English plant name; granny's bonnet is a British folk name often associated with familiar garden forms. Aquilegia has a more botanical character in gardening contexts.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看花后弯曲的长距，联想“鹰爪”；这是依托一种传统词源解释的记忆画面。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the curved flower spurs as eagle claws; this memory image follows a traditional, though disputed, etymological explanation.

etymology_story.zh: paseo 借自西班牙语 paseo，既可指散步这一活动，也可指散步的场所，与动词 pasear（散步、漫步）相联系。英语保留了这两种相互关联的含义，并常用于西班牙语文化背景的描写。
etymology_story.en: Paseo comes from Spanish paseo, which can name both a stroll and a place for strolling, and is associated with the verb pasear, meaning to walk or stroll. English retained both related meanings, often in descriptions of Spanish-speaking settings.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 paseo 是整体借入的名词：paseo + -s → paseos（复数）。西班牙语 pasear 是来源语言中的相关动词，不是英语 paseo 的派生词；evening paseo 是形容性修饰语与名词组成的词组，现代通用英语中没有常用的进一步派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, paseo is a borrowed noun treated as a whole base: paseo + -s → paseos forms the plural. Spanish pasear is a related verb in the source language, not an English derivative of paseo; evening paseo is a modifier–noun phrase, and there is no commonly used further derivational family in general English.

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Stroll emphasizes the leisurely activity; promenade can name either the walk or the public walking place and is the closest overall equivalent; esplanade usually denotes an open walking area, often beside water. Paseo additionally evokes a Spanish-speaking cultural setting.

etymology_story.zh: 该词最终源自梵语 vīṇā，原指弦乐器；英语借入时也受到印地语相关形式的影响。这个古老名称曾涵盖不同形制的印度弦乐器，现代英语主要用它指维纳琴。
etymology_story.en: The word ultimately comes from Sanskrit vīṇā, meaning a stringed instrument, with related Hindi forms also involved in its transmission into English. Historically, the name covered several Indian string instruments; modern English chiefly uses it for the vina.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，vina 是不可再作常用词缀分析的借入词：vina + -s → vinas（复数）。veena 是另一拼写；vina + player → vina player（维纳琴演奏者）属于名词组合。没有常用的独立动词、形容词或副词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, vina is a borrowed base without a productive internal affix breakdown: vina + -s → vinas, the plural. Veena is an alternative spelling; vina + player → vina player is a noun combination. There are no commonly used derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: veena（维纳琴）是同词异拼，意义相同；lute（鲁特琴；琉特类乐器）是相关乐器名称，可描述部分维纳琴的形制；sitar（西塔琴）是另一种印度拨弦乐器，不能作为 vina 的准确同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Veena is an alternative spelling with the same meaning. Lute names a related instrument type and can describe the structure of some vinas. Sitar names a different Indian plucked instrument and is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Link vina with veena: two spellings of the same Indian string-instrument name.

etymology_story.zh: durn 是 darn 的美国地域变体，而表示咒骂的 darn 是 damn 的委婉变形。它通过改变语音减轻咒骂力度，后来也用于一般性的强调。
etymology_story.en: Durn is a regional American variant of darn, which is itself a softened alteration of damn. Changing the sound made the curse milder, and the expression also developed uses as a general intensifier.

morphology_enriched.zh: durn 是英语内部的语音变体，不是外来借词，也不能拆成前缀和词根。动词变化为 durn + -s → durns、durn + -ed → durned、durn + -ing → durning；durned 也可作加强语气的形容词。相关形式包括 darn、darned、damn、damned；表示缝补的 darn 是另一个词。
morphology_enriched.en: Durn is an English sound variant, not a foreign borrowing or a prefix-plus-root formation. Verb forms are durn + -s → durns, durn + -ed → durned, and durn + -ing → durning; durned can also function as an emphatic adjective. Related forms include darn, darned, damn, and damned. Darn meaning to mend fabric is a separate word.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: darn（该死的；非常）同样委婉，但地域色彩较弱；dang（该死；真是）也是委婉咒骂，常带美国口语色彩；damn（该死；咒骂）通常语气更强，也更容易显得冒犯。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Darn is similarly mild but less strongly regional. Dang is another softened curse associated with informal American speech. Damn is generally stronger and more potentially offensive.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: damn → darn → durn：咒骂换个音，既能抱怨，也能加强语气。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Damn → darn → durn: a softened sound carries annoyance and emphasis.

etymology_story.zh: aurum 直接借自拉丁语，意思是“金”。化学元素符号 Au 也取自这个拉丁语名称，因此该词与现代化学符号之间保留着清楚的联系。
etymology_story.en: Aurum was borrowed directly from Latin, where it means gold. The chemical symbol Au also comes from this Latin name, preserving a clear connection between the old word and modern chemical notation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，aurum 作为完整借词使用，不应把 -um 当作能自由造词的英语后缀。相关拉丁词干 aur- 出现在 auric（金的；三价金的）、aurous（一价金的）、aurate（金酸盐）和 auriferous（含金的）中；这些属于相关词干构词，不是简单在完整 aurum 后加后缀。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, aurum functions as a whole borrowed word; -um is not a freely productive English suffix here. The related Latin stem aur- appears in auric, relating to gold or gold(III); aurous, relating to gold(I); aurate, a salt containing a gold-bearing anion; and auriferous, gold-bearing. These use a related stem rather than simply adding suffixes to the complete word aurum.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: gold（金）是现代英语中的标准对应词；Au（金元素符号）是符号，不是普通词汇同义词；bullion（金银条块）强调贵金属的交易形态，而且也可指银，不能与 aurum 全面互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Gold is the standard modern English equivalent. Au is the element's symbol rather than an ordinary lexical synonym. Bullion emphasizes precious metal in bulk trading form and can also refer to silver, so it is not interchangeable with aurum.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Au 是 aurum 的开头：看到 Au，就想到金。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Au begins aurum: connect the chemical symbol directly with gold.

etymology_story.zh: Hib 由 Haemophilus 的 H、influenzae 的 i 和血清型标记 b 组合而成，通常作为一个音节读出。它先指这种细菌，也通过转喻指这种细菌造成的疾病。
etymology_story.en: Hib combines H from Haemophilus, i from influenzae, and b for the bacterial serotype, and is normally pronounced as one syllable. The bacterial name also came to denote the illnesses caused by the organism.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构成公式为 H(aemophilus) + i(nfluenzae) + b（b 型）→ Hib，属于首字母与类型标记组成的缩略词，不是外来借词。Hib + vaccine → Hib vaccine（疫苗）、Hib + infection → Hib infection（感染）；这些结构中的 Hib 是名词前置修饰语，不必另立形容词词性。没有常用的屈折变化或派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation is H(aemophilus) + i(nfluenzae) + b, the type designation, → Hib: an acronym combining initials and a serotype label. Hib + vaccine → Hib vaccine and Hib + infection → Hib infection are noun combinations; attributive use does not require a separate adjective entry. There are no commonly used inflected or derived forms.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Haemophilus influenzae type b（b 型流感嗜血杆菌）是完整名称，与细菌义准确对应；H. influenzae type b 是同一名称的规范缩写；Hib disease（b 型流感嗜血杆菌病）指感染性疾病，而不是细菌本身。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Haemophilus influenzae type b is the full equivalent of the bacterial sense. H. influenzae type b is an abbreviated form of the same name. Hib disease refers to illness caused by the organism rather than to the bacterium itself.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Hi 是细菌名称的首字母，b 是血清型：Hi + b = Hib。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hi identifies the bacterium; b identifies its serotype: Hi + b = Hib.

etymology_story.zh: 该词来自新拉丁语属名 Senecio，承接拉丁语 senecio，意为“老人”，也用作植物名称，与 senex（老的；老人）相关。这个名称通常被解释为联想到种子上如老人白发般的白色冠毛。
etymology_story.en: The word comes through the New Latin genus name Senecio from Latin senecio, meaning an old man and also used as a plant name, related to senex, old or an old man. The name is traditionally explained by the whitish seed hairs resembling an old man's hair.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，senecio 是完整借入的植物名，不宜硬拆成英语词缀；senecio + -s → senecios（复数）。Senecio 是首字母大写的正式属名，senecio 是普通名词用法。senecionine（千里光碱）和 senecion- 这一植物化学构词词干相关；senescent（衰老的）、senescence（衰老）是同源词，不是由完整 senecio 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, senecio is a borrowed plant name without a productive English affix breakdown: senecio + -s → senecios, the plural. Capitalized Senecio is the formal genus name; lowercase senecio is the common noun. Senecionine, an alkaloid name, uses the related botanical stem senecion-. Senescent and senescence are etymological relatives, not direct derivatives of the complete English word senecio.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: groundsel（千里光类植物，尤指欧洲千里光）与 senecio 部分重叠，但不是所有千里光属植物的统一名称；ragwort（千里光类植物）是相关俗名，其中一些植物现归入其他属；daisy-family plant（菊科植物）范围更广，只能作上位描述。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Groundsel overlaps with senecio but commonly refers to particular plants, especially common groundsel. Ragwort is a related common name, with some plants bearing that name now placed in other genera. Daisy-family plant is a broader description rather than an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect sen- with age: the seeds wear white hairs like an old man's hair.

etymology.text: 动词源自晚期拉丁语 dementare（使发狂），由拉丁语 demens（失去理智的）而来；其中 mens 表示心智。联想心智被扰乱，而不是把它误认成普通的 -ment 名词。

usage_note: 古旧及物动词，现代多用 drive someone mad 等表达。demented 可带贬损色彩，描述真实患者时宜采用准确、尊重的表述。

etymology_story.zh: 源自晚期拉丁语 dementare，意为“使发狂”，与拉丁语 demens“失去理智的”有关，其历史构成包含表示离失的 de- 和表示心智的 mens。英语动词如今罕用，但形容词 demented 仍在使用。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Late Latin dementare, meaning 'to drive mad', related to Latin demens, 'out of one's mind', historically containing de-, expressing removal, and mens, 'mind'. The English verb is now rare, although the adjective demented remains in use.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语通常把 dement 作为整体动词词干处理，不应拆成 de- 加名词后缀 -ment。屈折形式：dements、demented、dementing；demented 也可独立用作形容词，并可派生 dementedly（精神错乱般地）和 dementedness（精神错乱状态）；dementia（痴呆）属于同源词，并非在英语中直接由 dement 加后缀形成。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, dement is normally treated as a whole verb stem, not as de- plus the noun suffix -ment. Its inflected forms are dements, demented, and dementing; demented also functions as an adjective and supports dementedly and dementedness. Dementia is an etymological relative, rather than a direct English suffix formation from dement.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: drive mad（使发狂）是更自然的表达，也常用于夸张；derange（使精神失常）强调心智或正常运作受到严重扰乱；unhinge（使精神失衡）常强调冲击造成的情绪失控。dement 本身带明显的旧式或文学色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Drive mad is more natural and is also common in exaggeration; derange emphasizes serious disruption of the mind or normal functioning; unhinge often emphasizes emotional instability caused by a shock. Dement itself has a distinctly dated or literary flavor.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史词根 mens 表示“心智”：心智脱离正常状态，就是 dement；用较熟悉的 demented 帮助回忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: The historical root mens means 'mind': a mind driven out of its normal state is demented. Use the more familiar demented to recall dement.

senses.english_definition: Sard is a brownish-red stone belonging to the chalcedony family, used for ornaments and engraved objects.
senses.collocation_en: sard intaglio; sard bead
senses.collocation_zh: 褐红玉髓阴刻宝石；褐红玉髓珠
senses.sentence_en: The ancient seal was carved from sard.
senses.sentence_zh: 这枚古代印章由褐红玉髓雕成。

etymology_story.zh: 经法语形式传入英语，最终可追溯至希腊语 sardios，并与拉丁语 sarda 有关，历来指这种红褐色宝石。其名称传统上被联系到古城萨迪斯，但这一地名来源并不确定。
etymology_story.en: The word entered English through French forms and ultimately goes back to Greek sardios, with related Latin sarda, naming the reddish-brown gemstone. Its name has traditionally been associated with the ancient city of Sardis, although that geographical derivation is uncertain.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 sard 是不可进一步分析的简单名词，没有常用的派生词系列。sard bead（褐红玉髓珠）和 sard intaglio（褐红玉髓阴刻宝石）是名词组合；相关矿物名 sardonyx（缠丝玛瑙，尤指含褐红玉髓层与白色层者）在历史上结合了 sard 与 onyx 的对应成分。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, sard is a simple, unanalyzable noun without a common series of derivatives. Sard bead and sard intaglio are noun combinations; the related mineral name sardonyx, especially referring to material with sard and white layers, historically combines elements corresponding to sard and onyx.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chalcedony（玉髓）是上位名称，范围更广；carnelian（红玉髓）与 sard 关系密切，通常颜色较浅、较偏橙红；sardonyx（缠丝玛瑙）强调不同颜色形成的条带结构，并非 sard 的严格同义词。这些名称的传统使用边界并不完全一致。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chalcedony is the broader category; carnelian is closely related but is usually lighter and more orange-red; sardonyx denotes a banded material and is not an exact synonym of sard. Traditional usage does not draw completely consistent boundaries between these names.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 sard 固定联想到古印章上一块温润的红褐色玉髓。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor sard to the warm reddish-brown chalcedony of an ancient engraved seal.

etymology.text: 借自阿拉伯语 hamza，原义与压、挤有关，后来用作喉塞音符号的名称。可以联想发音时声门短暂闭合的动作。

senses.pos: n. 可数名词（阿拉伯语语言学）
senses.meaning_zh: 阿拉伯文中表示喉塞音的符号 ء；亦指该喉塞音
senses.meaning_en: the Arabic sign ء representing a glottal stop, or the sound it represents
senses.english_definition: A hamza is an Arabic written sign that represents a glottal stop, a sound made by briefly closing and releasing the vocal cords.
senses.collocation_en: initial hamza; medial hamza
senses.collocation_zh: 词首 hamza 符号；词中 hamza 符号
senses.sentence_en: The teacher explained why the hamza is written above the alif in this word.
senses.sentence_zh: 老师解释了这个词中的 hamza 为什么写在 alif 字母上方。

etymology_story.zh: 借自阿拉伯语 hamzah，与表示“刺、挤压”等动作的词根有关。这个名称用于指喉塞音及其书写符号，可联系发音时声门短暂闭合的动作来理解。
etymology_story.en: Hamza is borrowed from Arabic hamzah, associated with a root expressing actions such as pricking or pressing. The name denotes the glottal stop and its written sign, which can be understood through the brief closure of the glottis during pronunciation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 在英语中 hamza 是整体借入的简单名词，不能把结尾 -a 当作英语后缀。常规复数为 hamzas，hamzah 是另一种转写拼法；initial hamza（词首 hamza）和 medial hamza（词中 hamza）是术语组合，没有常用英语派生词系列。
morphology_enriched.en: In English, hamza is a simple borrowed noun; its final -a is not an English suffix. The regular plural is hamzas, and hamzah is an alternative transliteration. Initial hamza and medial hamza are terminological combinations; there is no common series of English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hamzah 是同一名称的另一种拼法；glottal stop（喉塞音）指语音本身，不限于阿拉伯语；glottal-stop sign（喉塞音符号）是描述性名称，强调书写功能。hamza 可根据语境指符号或其代表的音。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hamzah is an alternative spelling of the same name; glottal stop denotes the speech sound and is not restricted to Arabic; glottal-stop sign is a descriptive expression emphasizing the written function. Hamza can refer to either the sign or its sound, depending on context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 声门短暂“关一下”，纸上用 ء 标出来：把动作、声音和符号连在一起记。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Briefly close the glottis, then mark that interruption with ء: connect the action, the sound, and the sign.

etymology.text: 由英语女性人名 Nancy 缩短而来，后来被用作针对男性气质或性取向的贬称。了解这条来源是为了识别旧文本中的偏见。

usage_note: 过时且有侮辱性，不应用来称呼他人。本课仅为辨认歧视性语言；这个标签不能说明一个人的真实气质或性取向。

senses.sentence_zh: 在那部旧小说中，另一个人物用“nance”这个侮辱性称呼嘲笑他的举止。

senses.pos: n. 名词（植物及食品名称；树木、单个果实可数，水果统称可不可数）

senses.english_definition: A nance is a tropical American tree that produces small yellow edible fruits, and nance also refers to its fruit.

senses.collocation_zh: 南美金虎尾果；南美金虎尾树

senses.sentence_zh: 摊贩出售用于制作饮料和甜点的南美金虎尾果。

etymology_story.zh: 侮辱性用法来自女性人名 Nancy 的缩略形式，后来被用于贬低男性的性别表现或性取向。植物名称则是另一个来源独立的同形词，借自美洲西班牙语 nance，与 Nahuatl（纳瓦特尔语）来源的名称有关。
etymology_story.en: The insulting term comes from a shortened form of the female name Nancy and developed into a slur targeting men's gender expression or sexuality. The plant name is an independently derived homonym, borrowed from American Spanish nance and associated with a name of Nahuatl origin.

morphology_enriched.zh: 侮辱语在历史构词上属于 Nancy 的截短形式，不是外来借词；植物名称则是整体借入。两义均可构成复数 nances；nance tree（南美金虎尾树）和 nance fruit（南美金虎尾果）是植物义的名词组合，两义都没有常用的英语派生词系列。
morphology_enriched.en: The insult is historically a clipping of Nancy, rather than a foreign borrowing; the plant name is borrowed as a whole. Both senses can take the plural nances. Nance tree and nance fruit are noun combinations belonging to the botanical sense, and neither sense has a common series of English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 侮辱义可与 sissy（带贬义，侧重所谓柔弱或不够阳刚）比较；effeminate man（被认为女性化的男子）是描述性表达，但不等于男同性恋者。植物义另有区域名称 nanche，指同一种植物或果实，与上述人物称呼无关。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the insulting sense, sissy is also derogatory and emphasizes supposed weakness or insufficient masculinity; effeminate man is descriptive but does not mean gay man. For the botanical sense, nanche is a regional alternative name for the same plant or fruit and is unrelated to the personal insult.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 两条来源分开记：Nancy 的缩略形式形成旧式侮辱语；美洲植物 nance 则结黄色小果。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the two origins separate: a shortening of Nancy became a dated insult, while the American plant called nance bears small yellow fruits.

etymology_story.zh: 来自中古英语 dawe，属于与日耳曼语鸟名有关的旧词，其更早来源并不完全确定。后来 jack 与 daw 结合形成 jackdaw，后者成为现代英语中通常使用的名称。
etymology_story.en: Daw comes from Middle English dawe, an old bird name with Germanic connections whose earlier origin is not fully certain. Jack was later combined with daw to form jackdaw, which became the usual name in modern English.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 daw 是简单名词，不宜当作外来借词或继续拆分；复数为 daws。jack + daw → jackdaw（寒鸦），复数为 jackdaws；这是复合构词，daw 本身没有常用的派生词系列。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, daw is a simple noun and should not be treated as a foreign borrowing or divided further; its plural is daws. Jack + daw forms the compound jackdaw, with the plural jackdaws. Daw itself has no common series of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: jackdaw（寒鸦）是现代通常使用的对应词；crow（乌鸦）是相关鸟类名称，日常使用范围较宽，并非精确同义词；rook（秃鼻乌鸦）是另一种鸦科鸟，比寒鸦大，不能互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Jackdaw is the usual modern equivalent; crow is a related bird name with broader everyday use and is not an exact synonym; rook names a different, larger member of the crow family and is not interchangeable with daw.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从 jackdaw 中认出 daw：较长的常用鸟名，帮助记住较短的旧称。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Spot daw inside jackdaw: the longer, familiar bird name helps you remember the shorter, older one.

etymology_story.zh: 该词经中古英语借自中古荷兰语，源词是表示“四分之一”的词的小称形式。它最初指大桶约四分之一容量的小桶，后来也成为特定的容量单位。
etymology_story.en: The word entered Middle English from Middle Dutch, from a diminutive of a word meaning 'fourth'. It originally denoted a cask holding roughly a quarter of a larger barrel and subsequently also became a capacity measure.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 firkin 视为不可再作实用拆分的借词，不宜拆成 fir（冷杉）和 -kin。复数为 firkins；没有常用的派生词，firkin lid（小桶盖）只是名词组合。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, firkin is an effectively unanalyzable loanword; it should not be interpreted as fir plus -kin. Its plural is firkins; it has no common derivatives, and firkin lid is simply a noun combination.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cask（木桶）是盛酒等液体的桶的通称；barrel（桶）也可表示容量单位，但容量依商品和制度而异；keg（小型酒桶）常指现代盛装、分配啤酒的容器，不能直接替代 firkin 的九英制加仑容量义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cask is a general term for a vessel holding liquids such as beer; barrel can also name a measure whose size depends on the commodity and system; keg commonly denotes a modern beer container and does not necessarily imply the nine-imperial-gallon capacity of a firkin.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住历史上的“四分之一”：大桶的四分之一，形成小桶概念。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the historical 'fourth': a quarter of a larger barrel becomes a small cask.

senses.meaning_zh: 毫，越南历史上的辅助货币单位，等于十分之一盾
senses.meaning_en: A historical Vietnamese monetary unit equal to one tenth of a dong.
senses.english_definition: A hao is a historical Vietnamese monetary unit worth one tenth of a dong.

etymology_story.zh: 英语直接借用越南语 hào，保留了其货币单位意义。越南语这一名称与汉字“毫”有关，体现了以十分之一为单位的货币细分。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Vietnamese hào directly as the name of a monetary unit. The Vietnamese term is associated with the Chinese character 毫 and denotes a decimal subdivision of the currency.

morphology_enriched.zh: hao 是整体借入的单纯词，现代英语中没有可分析的词根和词缀；复数通常仍为 hao。没有常用的英语派生词；hao coin（毫币）是名词组合。
morphology_enriched.en: Hao is a simple loanword with no analyzable English root-and-affix structure; its plural is normally unchanged. It has no common English derivatives; hao coin is a noun combination.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有严格的同义词。dong（盾）是其上一级货币单位，1盾等于10毫；xu（枢，越南旧辅币单位）是更小的单位，10枢等于1毫；coin（硬币）指实体货币，不能表示 hao 这一特定计价单位。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact synonym. Dong names the larger unit, with ten hao to one dong; xu names a smaller unit, with ten xu to one hao; coin denotes a physical piece of money rather than this particular unit of value.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 十毫一盾：hao 是 dong 的十分之一。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Ten hao make one dong: hao is the tenth-sized unit.

family: stet + -ing → stetting（正在标注保留；末尾 t 双写）。；stet (17)

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。stet + -ing → stetting（正在标注保留；末尾 t 双写）。

etymology.text: 直接取自拉丁语 stet，意思是“让它保留”，来自动词 stare（站立）。想象给被划掉的字一句“让它站住”。

senses.sentence_zh: 删除处旁边手写的保留原文指示表明，该短语应当留下。

etymology_story.zh: stet 直接取自拉丁语，字面意思是“让它保留”或“让它站住”，是 stāre（站立）的虚拟式形式。它成为印刷校对指令后，又在英语中发展出动词和名词用法。
etymology_story.en: Stet comes directly from Latin and means 'let it stand', using a subjunctive form of stāre, 'to stand'. After becoming a proofreading instruction, it developed English uses as both a verb and a noun.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 stet 作为整体词干使用，不再按拉丁语词形变化拆分。动词形式为 stets、stetted、stetting，过去式和现在分词均双写末尾 t；名词复数为 stets，没有常用的其他派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats stet as a whole stem rather than analyzing its Latin inflection. Verb forms are stets, stetted, and stetting, with the final t doubled before -ed and -ing; the noun plural is stets, and there are no other common derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: retain（保留）仅表示留下内容；restore（恢复）强调把删改后的内容恢复回来；let stand（保留原状）最接近原义，而 stet 特指通过编辑或校对指示撤销拟议改动。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Retain simply means to keep something; restore emphasizes bringing deleted or altered material back; let stand is closest to the literal meaning, while stet specifically uses an editorial or proofreading instruction to cancel a proposed change.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 让被划掉的文字“站住”：stet，就是恢复保留。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let the crossed-out words 'stand': stet tells the editor to keep them.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆。Arg- + -y → Argy（对阿根廷人的俗称）。这是英语内部缩略称呼，Argentine 截短为 Arg-，加昵称尾缀 -y；并非从外语直接借入。

etymology_story.zh: Argy 是 Argie 的异体拼写，由 Argentine 等表示阿根廷国籍的词截短后，加上非正式称呼中常见的词尾形成。它是英语内部形成的俗称，在某些语境中带有敌意或贬损意味。
etymology_story.en: Argy is a variant spelling of Argie, formed by shortening a nationality word such as Argentine and adding a familiar informal ending. It developed within English as a slang label and can convey hostility or disparagement.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式为 Argentine 等国籍词的截短词干 Arg- + 非正式称呼后缀 -y；异体为 Argie，复数为 Argies。Argentina（阿根廷）、Argentine 和 Argentinian（阿根廷的；阿根廷人）是相关名称，并非从 Argy 派生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation is the clipped stem Arg-, from a nationality word such as Argentine, plus the informal personal suffix -y; Argie is a spelling variant, and the plural is Argies. Argentina, Argentine, and Argentinian are related names, not derivatives of Argy.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Argentine 和 Argentinian 都是中性的国籍名词或形容词；Argie 与 Argy 是同一个俚语称呼的不同拼写，具有相同的潜在冒犯色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Argentine and Argentinian are neutral nationality nouns or adjectives; Argie and Argy are spelling variants of the same slang label and share its potentially offensive tone.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Argentine 截短再加昵称尾缀：形式像昵称，语气可能带贬意。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Shorten Argentine and add a nickname ending: the familiar-looking label may carry contempt.

meaning: 捶揉加工皮革（方言或旧用法）

etymology.text: 由中古英语 tewen 演变而来，带有揉制、劳作的意思；把反复捶揉皮革的动作作为记忆画面。

senses.meaning_zh: 捶打、揉制皮革，使其柔软，方言或旧用法

etymology_story.zh: tew 延续了中古英语 tewen，与表示加工、制备皮革的 taw 有历史联系，并非现代英语新近借入的外来词。其相关意义涵盖费力加工、辛苦劳作以及劳累烦扰，主要保留在方言或历史语境中。
etymology_story.en: Tew continues Middle English tewen and is historically connected with taw, meaning to prepare or dress leather; it is not a recent English loanword. Its related meanings cover laborious working, toil, and wearisome trouble, chiefly surviving in dialectal or historical contexts.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 tew 是单纯词干，没有可实用拆分的词缀；动词形式为 tews、tewed、tewing，添加 -ed 和 -ing 时不双写 w。名词 tew 与动词同形；taw 是历史相关词，不是现代派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, tew is a simple stem with no useful affixal breakdown; its verb forms are tews, tewed, and tewing, without doubling w before -ed or -ing. The noun has the same form as the verb; taw is historically related rather than a modern derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: taw（鞣制）特指皮革加工，通常涉及明矾等材料；toil（辛苦劳作）对应 tew 的费力干活义；fret（烦躁、担忧）对应其烦心义。这些词分别对应不同义项，不能在所有语境中互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Taw specifically concerns leather preparation, typically using materials such as alum; toil matches the sense of laborious work; fret matches the sense of anxious worrying. Each corresponds to a different sense of tew and is not interchangeable across all its uses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用“反复揉制皮革，费力又劳神”的画面串起加工、劳作和烦扰三个意思。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture laboriously working a hide: the effort links leather preparation, hard work, and wearisome worry.

etymology_story.zh: 借自意大利语 campagna，意为“乡野、开阔的田野”，源自拉丁语 campania，与 campus“田野、平地”有关。英语将其用作罗马周围乡野地区的名称，常见完整形式为 Roman Campagna 或 Campagna di Roma。
etymology_story.en: Borrowed from Italian campagna, meaning 'countryside' or 'open country,' from Latin campania, related to campus, 'field' or 'level ground.' In English, it became a geographical name for the countryside around Rome, often called the Roman Campagna or Campagna di Roma.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整的借入地名使用，没有可自由分析的英语前缀或后缀，也没有常用的派生词族。Roman Campagna（罗马郊野平原）和 Campagna landscape（坎帕尼亚平原景观）是名称组合或名词短语；Campania（意大利坎帕尼亚大区）是相关但不同的地名。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Campagna is a borrowed place name with no productive English prefix or suffix and no established common derivative family. Roman Campagna and Campagna landscape are name combinations or noun phrases; Campania, the Italian region, is a related but distinct geographical name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Roman Campagna 是明确指向同一地区的名称；countryside（乡村地区）是泛称，plain（平原）强调地势平坦，二者都不能单独准确替代这个专名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Roman Campagna explicitly names the same area. Countryside is a general term for rural land, while plain emphasizes flat terrain; neither alone identifies this particular region.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: campus 的词源义是“田野”：把 Campagna 记成“罗马周围的一大片田野”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect its historical relative campus, 'field,' with a broad stretch of countryside around Rome.

senses.meaning_zh: 圜；韩国于1953年至1962年使用的货币单位
senses.meaning_en: the monetary unit of South Korea from 1953 to 1962
senses.english_definition: The hwan was the unit of money used in South Korea between 1953 and 1962.
senses.collocation_en: a 100-hwan note; hwan banknotes
senses.collocation_zh: 一张面额为100圜的纸币；圜纸币
senses.sentence_en: The museum displayed a 100-hwan note issued in South Korea.
senses.sentence_zh: 博物馆展出了一张韩国发行的100圜纸币。

etymology_story.zh: 借自韩语 환（hwan），对应汉字“圜”，原有圆形之义。这个名称用于韩国1953年引入的货币单位，1962年该单位被重新引入的 won（韩元）取代。
etymology_story.en: Borrowed from Korean hwan, written with the character 圜, historically associated with roundness. The name designated the currency unit introduced in South Korea in 1953 and replaced by the reintroduced won in 1962.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语构词分析：hwan 是不可再拆分的借词，无英语词缀，也没有常用派生词族；表示数额时复数通常仍为 hwan。100-hwan note（100圜纸币）中的 hwan 作前置名词修饰语，不构成独立的形容词词性；won（韩元）是相关货币名称，并非其派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English analysis: hwan is an indivisible borrowing with no English affixes or common derivative family; its plural in amounts is normally hwan. In 100-hwan note, it functions as a noun modifier rather than a separate adjective. Won is a related currency name, not a derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: South Korean hwan（韩国圜）是明确的同指名称；currency unit（货币单位）和 denomination（面额单位）是上位表达。won（韩元）指另一货币单位，不能作为 hwan 的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: South Korean hwan is an explicit equivalent name. Currency unit and denomination are broader descriptions. Won names a different monetary unit and is not a synonym for hwan.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 圜与“圆”相连：想象一枚韩国旧圆币，再记住它属于韩元之前的一段货币史。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link 圜 with roundness: picture an old round Korean coin and place the hwan before the modern won.

senses.meaning_zh: 大麻制品；尤指北非传统使用的大麻，或与烟草混合的大麻
senses.meaning_en: a cannabis preparation, especially North African cannabis sometimes mixed with tobacco

senses.meaning_zh: 大麻腺毛粉；从大麻花上分离出的富含树脂的细小颗粒，通常拼作 kief
senses.meaning_en: the loose, resin-rich trichomes separated from cannabis flowers, usually spelled kief
senses.english_definition: Keef is the fine, resin-rich material made up of tiny glandular structures separated from cannabis flowers.
senses.collocation_en: collect keef; a keef catcher

senses.sentence_zh: 研磨器的下层收集格里积起了细细的大麻腺毛粉。

etymology_story.zh: keef 属于 kif、kef、kief 这一组相关拼写，最终源自阿拉伯语 kayf，表示状态、心境，并引申出愉悦或舒适之意。这个词后来用于称呼大麻制品；现代通常拼作 kief 的用法进一步专指分离出来的大麻树脂腺毛。
etymology_story.en: Keef belongs to a group of related spellings including kif, kef, and kief, ultimately from Arabic kayf, referring to a condition or mood and, by extension, pleasure or well-being. The word came to denote cannabis preparations; modern usage, usually spelled kief, also specifically denotes separated resin-bearing trichomes.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 keef 是不可再拆分的借词，通常为不可数名词，无常用的规则派生词族。kif、kef、kief 是相关拼写形式，各自的常见义项有所不同；keef pipe（大麻烟斗）和 keef catcher（腺毛粉收集格）是名词组合，不是后缀派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, keef is an indivisible borrowing, normally a mass noun, with no common regular derivative family. Kif, kef, and kief are related spelling forms whose usual senses differ somewhat. Keef pipe and keef catcher are noun combinations, not suffix-derived words.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: kief 通常是“大麻腺毛粉”义更常见的拼写；cannabis（大麻）范围更广，可指植物或其制品；hashish（大麻脂）通常指加工、常经压制的富树脂制品，与松散的腺毛粉并不完全相同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Kief is usually the more common spelling for the separated-trichome sense. Cannabis is broader, covering the plant or its preparations. Hashish usually denotes a processed, often compressed resin-rich product, rather than loose trichome powder.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 词源线索是“舒适的心境”，现代词义则指大麻制品；见到粉末语境时，联想到更常见的拼写 kief。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use the historical idea of a pleasant mood to recall the cannabis connection; in powder-related contexts, connect keef with the usual spelling kief.

senses.meaning_zh: 拉普拉塔河口；阿根廷与乌拉圭之间的宽阔河口水域
senses.meaning_en: the Río de la Plata estuary between Argentina and Uruguay
senses.english_definition: The Plata is the broad estuary between Argentina and Uruguay that opens into the Atlantic Ocean.

senses.sentence_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯和蒙得维的亚分别位于拉普拉塔河口的两侧。

etymology_story.zh: 来自西班牙语地名 Río de la Plata，字面意为“白银之河”，其中 plata 意为“银”。这一名称与早期欧洲探险者对通往内陆白银产地之水路的期待有关，英语中也使用译名 River Plate。
etymology_story.en: From the Spanish name Río de la Plata, literally 'River of Silver,' with plata meaning 'silver.' The name reflects early European explorers' hopes of finding a water route to inland silver sources; English also uses the name River Plate.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Plata 是完整地名的缩略用法，无可分析的英语词缀，也没有由该形式直接构成的常用派生词族。Río de la Plata 是完整西班牙语名称，River Plate 是传统英语名称；相关形容词 Rioplatense（拉普拉塔河地区的）来自完整名称，La Plata 也可指阿根廷的一座城市，须依语境区分。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Plata is a shortened geographical name with no English affixes or common derivative family formed directly from it. Río de la Plata is the full Spanish name, and River Plate is the traditional English name. The related adjective Rioplatense derives from the full name; La Plata can also name a city in Argentina and must be distinguished by context.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Río de la Plata 是完整且明确的名称；River Plate 是传统英语对应名称；La Plata 在河口语境中可指同一水域，但也可能指阿根廷的拉普拉塔市。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Río de la Plata is the full, explicit name. River Plate is its traditional English equivalent. La Plata can refer to the same waterway in context, but it can also refer to the Argentine city.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: plata 在西班牙语中意为“银”：把地图上阿根廷与乌拉圭之间的宽阔河口想成一条银色水带。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Plata means 'silver' in Spanish: picture a broad silver ribbon of water between Argentina and Uruguay.

etymology.text: 英语借自希腊语 rhyton，与 rhytos（流动的）相连；想象酒从兽首形器皿的流口流出。

senses.meaning_zh: 来通杯；古代用于饮酒或奠酒、通常带流口且常呈角形或兽形的容器
senses.meaning_en: an ancient drinking or libation vessel, typically with a pouring opening and often shaped like a horn or animal
senses.english_definition: A rhyton is an ancient vessel used for drinking or pouring offerings, often shaped like a horn or an animal and fitted with an opening through which liquid flows.
senses.collocation_en: a silver rhyton; a bull-headed rhyton
senses.collocation_zh: 银制来通杯；牛首形来通杯
senses.sentence_en: The silver rhyton has a small opening beneath the animal's head.
senses.sentence_zh: 这件银制来通杯在兽首下方有一个小流口。

etymology_story.zh: 源自古希腊语 rhyton，是形容词 rhytos“流动的”的中性形式名词化，与 rhein“流动”有关。这个名称突出其功能：液体能够通过器身上的流口流出，用于饮用或奠酒。
etymology_story.en: From ancient Greek rhyton, the substantivized neuter form of rhytos, 'flowing,' related to rhein, 'to flow.' The name highlights the vessel's function: liquid flows through an opening for drinking or making libations.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 rhyton 是完整借入的词干，不宜拆成英语词根与后缀。词形变化：单数 rhyton，复数 rhyta 或 rhytons；没有常用派生词族。bull-headed rhyton（牛首形来通杯）是描述性名词短语。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, rhyton is a borrowed stem and should not be divided into an English root and suffix. Its inflectional forms are singular rhyton and plural rhyta or rhytons; it has no common derivative family. Bull-headed rhyton is a descriptive noun phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: drinking horn（饮酒角杯）强调角形，未必带有来通杯式流口；libation vessel（奠酒器）强调祭祀用途，范围更广；drinking vessel（饮酒器）是更宽泛的上位词，三者均不是严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Drinking horn emphasizes a horn shape and need not have a rhyton's outlet. Libation vessel emphasizes ritual use and covers a wider range of objects. Drinking vessel is a broader category; none is an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住词源中的“流”：酒从兽首的小流口流出，就是 rhyton 的典型形象。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to 'flow': picture wine flowing from a small opening in an animal-headed vessel.

meaning: 河边肥沃的低地（苏格兰用语）

senses.meaning_zh: 河流沿岸肥沃的低平土地，尤指苏格兰的冲积平原。
senses.meaning_en: An area of low, fertile land beside a river, especially in Scotland.
senses.english_definition: A carse is an area of low, flat, fertile land beside a river in Scotland.

etymology_story.zh: carse 是苏格兰地貌用语，中古时期已有 cars、kers 等拼写，较早的含义与低湿地有关。其更早来源尚不确定，现代通常指河流沿岸肥沃的低平土地。
etymology_story.en: Carse is a Scottish landscape term recorded in medieval spellings such as cars and kers, with earlier associations with low, wet ground. Its deeper origin is uncertain; its modern meaning usually concerns fertile, low-lying land beside a river.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再分析的名词词干 carse；复数为 carse + -s → carses。没有常用的派生词；carse land 是名词修饰名词的组合，不是后缀派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, carse is an unanalyzable noun stem; its plural is carse + -s → carses. It has no common derivatives; carse land is a noun-modifying-noun combination, not a suffixal derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: floodplain（洪泛平原）强调河流泛滥形成或淹没的平地；haugh（苏格兰河岸低地）常指沿河的冲积草地。carse 则是带有苏格兰地域色彩的肥沃低平土地名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Floodplain emphasizes flat land formed or flooded by a river; haugh is a Scottish term often used for an alluvial riverside meadow. Carse is a distinctly Scottish name for fertile, low-lying ground.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 carse 固定在一幅画面里：苏格兰河边，低而平、土肥沃。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor carse to one landscape: a Scottish riverside, low and flat, with fertile soil.

senses.meaning_en: The name of the letter ð, uppercase Ð, also used as the IPA symbol for the voiced dental fricative.

etymology_story.zh: 英语字母名 eth（也拼作 edh）源自冰岛语字母名 eð。字母 ð 曾用于古英语，如今仍用于冰岛语等语言，并被国际音标采用来表示浊齿擦音。
etymology_story.en: The English letter name eth, also spelled edh, comes from Icelandic eð. The letter ð was used in Old English, survives in languages including Icelandic, and was adopted into the International Phonetic Alphabet for the voiced dental fricative.

morphology_enriched.zh: eth 是不可再分析的字母名称，不含现代英语前缀或后缀；复数为 eth + -s → eths。edh 是异体拼写，复数为 edhs；没有常用派生词。字母名 eth 与古英语动词词尾 -eth 不同。
morphology_enriched.en: Eth is an unanalyzable letter name with no modern English prefix or suffix; its plural is eth + -s → eths. Edh is a spelling variant, with the plural edhs; there are no common derivatives. The letter name eth is distinct from the archaic verb ending -eth.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: edh 是完全同义的异体拼写；the letter ð 是明确指称该字母的表达。voiced dental fricative symbol（浊齿擦音符号）只对应其音标用途，不涵盖该字母的全部历史用途。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Edh is an alternative spelling with the same meaning; the letter ð explicitly identifies the character. Voiced dental fricative symbol describes its IPA function specifically, rather than all its historical uses as a letter.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 字母名直接绑定符号：eth → ð → this 开头的浊 th 音。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link name, shape, and sound: eth → ð → the voiced th at the start of this.

senses.meaning_en: A temple or sacred building, in poetic or archaic language.
senses.english_definition: A fane is a temple or another sacred building, especially when it is described in poetry or old-fashioned language.

etymology_story.zh: fane 源自拉丁语 fanum，意为“神庙、圣所”，中古英语时期已有使用。它保留了宗教建筑这一核心含义，但如今主要出现在诗歌和仿古文体中。
etymology_story.en: Fane comes from Latin fanum, meaning a temple or sacred place, and was used in Middle English. It retains its core meaning of a religious building but now occurs mainly in poetry and deliberately archaic writing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 fane 是不可再分析的名词词干；复数为 fane + -s → fanes，没有常用派生词。profane 与它在历史上同源，但并不是现代英语通过给 fane 添加前缀而构成的词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, fane is an unanalyzable noun stem; its plural is fane + -s → fanes, and it has no common derivatives. Profane is historically related, but it is not a modern English formation made by adding a prefix to fane.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: temple（神庙、寺庙）是中性的常用建筑名称；shrine（圣祠、神龛）强调供奉或纪念的神圣地点，规模可很小；sanctuary（圣所）强调场所的神圣性。fane 的突出特点是诗意和古雅色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Temple is the ordinary, neutral term for the building; shrine emphasizes a sacred place of devotion or commemoration and may be very small; sanctuary emphasizes sacred status. Fane is distinguished chiefly by its poetic, archaic tone.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住拉丁语 fanum 的核心：圣地里的神庙；fane 是诗中的“神庙”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the Latin fanum idea of a sacred temple: fane is the poet's word for that temple.

meaning: 因接受更高报价而毁弃与原买家的房屋交易约定

pronunciation.note: 保留完整的非重读起始音节，重音在后；不要省略开头音节。

forms: gazumps；过去式、过去分词 gazumped；现在分词 gazumping。
family: gazump + -ing → gazumping（房产交易中接受更高报价而毁约）。；gazump (1), gazumped (6), gazumping (7), gazumps (0)

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。gazump + -ing → gazumping（房产交易中接受更高报价而毁约）。

etymology.text: Oxford 将这个20世纪英语词追溯到意第绪语 gezumph（多收钱）；后来用于房屋买卖中接受更高报价、让原买家落空的情形。

usage_note: 英式房产用语，常见被动 be gazumped；可由更高报价的买家或接受该报价的卖家造成。也有多收费、欺骗的旧义，见第二条搭配，本课理解题只考购房约定落空。

senses.english_definition: If a property seller gazumps you, they accept a higher offer from someone else after they have already accepted yours.

senses.meaning_en: To secure a property by outbidding someone whose offer has already been accepted, chiefly in British English.
senses.english_definition: If another buyer gazumps you, they offer more money for a property after the seller has already accepted your offer and obtain it instead.
senses.collocation_en: gazump another buyer; be gazumped by a rival bidder

senses.sentence_zh: 另一位买家比我们多出了一万英镑，抢走了我们已经谈妥购买的房产。

etymology_story.zh: gazump 在20世纪初的英语俚语中有“欺骗、敲竹杠”的意思，通常被认为与意第绪语中表示欺骗或多收费的词形有关，但具体来源并不完全确定。后来它专门用于房产交易中更高报价使原买家落空的情形。
etymology_story.en: Gazump appeared in early twentieth-century English slang with meanings such as cheat or overcharge, and is usually linked to Yiddish forms with similar meanings, although the precise origin is uncertain. It later developed its specialized property-market meaning involving a higher offer that displaces an earlier buyer.

morphology_enriched.zh: gazump 在现代英语中是不可再分析的动词词干，不应拆成 ga- 和 zump。词形为 gazumps、gazumped、gazumping；gazump + -er → gazumper（实施这种行为的人）。gazumping 也用作名词，表示这种交易行为。
morphology_enriched.en: Gazump is an unanalyzable verb stem in modern English and should not be divided into ga- and zump. Its inflected forms are gazumps, gazumped, and gazumping; gazump + -er → gazumper, a person who does this. Gazumping also functions as a noun naming the practice.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: outbid（出价高于）只说明报价更高，不要求先前已有被接受的报价；outmaneuver（以策略胜过）强调竞争手段，不限于价格或房产；renege on an agreement（背弃约定）强调卖方反悔，不必涉及更高报价。gazump 特指更高报价挤掉原买家的交易情形。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Outbid merely means offering more and does not require an earlier accepted offer; outmaneuver emphasizes gaining an advantage through strategy, beyond prices or property; renege on an agreement emphasizes the seller's reversal without necessarily involving a higher offer. Gazump specifically concerns a higher offer displacing the original buyer.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 核心场景：已经谈妥，却被后来更高的报价“截走”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture an accepted offer being displaced when a higher offer arrives.

senses.meaning_zh: 凤头麦鸡，因其鸣声得名；主要用于英国英语。

etymology_story.zh: peewit 是模仿凤头麦鸡鸣声形成的拟声词，英语中也有 pewit 这一拼写。鸟鸣的声音直接变成了这种鸟的名称。
etymology_story.en: Peewit is an imitative name based on the northern lapwing's call, with pewit as an alternative spelling. The sound of the bird's cry became a name for the bird itself.

morphology_enriched.zh: peewit 是整体拟声形成的名词，不是由具有独立词义的 pee 和 wit 组合而成。复数为 peewit + -s → peewits；异体拼写为 pewit，复数为 pewits；没有常用派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Peewit is a noun formed by sound imitation, not a semantic compound of the independent words pee and wit. Its plural is peewit + -s → peewits; the variant spelling is pewit, with the plural pewits. It has no common derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: northern lapwing（凤头麦鸡）是明确指称该物种的标准英文名；lapwing（麦鸡）在英国日常语境中通常指同一种鸟，也可泛指相关鸟类；green plover（绿鸻）是该鸟的传统俗名。peewit 则突出模仿鸣声的命名方式。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Northern lapwing is the precise standard English species name; lapwing usually means this bird in everyday British usage but can also refer more broadly to related birds; green plover is a traditional common name for the same species. Peewit specifically reflects its call.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 听见“pee-wit”，就想到发出这声鸣叫的凤头麦鸡。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hear pee-wit and picture the crested lapwing making that call.

senses.meaning_en: A Muslim title of respect, especially for a male descendant of the Prophet Muhammad
senses.english_definition: A sayyid is a Muslim man who is given a title of respect, especially because he is believed to be descended from the Prophet Muhammad.
senses.collocation_en: the title of sayyid; a sayyid family

senses.sentence_zh: 他出身于一个将自身世系追溯至先知穆罕默德的赛义德家族。

etymology_story.zh: 借自阿拉伯语 sayyid，意为“主人、先生、领主”。这个尊称在穆斯林社会中尤其用于先知穆罕默德的后裔，并不单指宗教领袖。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Arabic sayyid, meaning “master,” “sir,” or “lord.” In Muslim societies, the title became especially associated with descendants of the Prophet Muhammad; it does not simply mean a religious leader.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步拆分的借入名词，没有可分析的英语前后缀；复数为 sayyids。相关转写形式包括 seyyid、syed；sayyida／sayyidah 是相关的阿拉伯语女性尊称，并非英语后缀派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, sayyid is an unsegmented borrowed noun with no English prefix or suffix; its regular plural is sayyids. Related transliterations include seyyid and syed; sayyida/sayyidah is a related Arabic feminine title, not a derivative formed with an English suffix.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sharif（谢里夫）也是用于先知穆罕默德后裔的尊称，但与 sayyid 的具体区别因地区和传统而异；descendant of the Prophet（先知的后裔）是血统描述，本身不是尊称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sharif is another honorific associated with descendants of the Prophet Muhammad, although its relationship to sayyid varies by region and tradition. Descendant of the Prophet describes ancestry without itself functioning as an honorific.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从阿拉伯语“先生、主人”记到“受尊敬的称号”，再联系先知后裔。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect Arabic “sir/master” with an honorific, then associate that title with descent from the Prophet.

senses.meaning_zh: 斯皮茨型犬；尖嘴、竖耳、厚毛且通常卷尾的一类犬
senses.meaning_en: A dog of a type with a pointed muzzle, upright ears, thick fur, and usually a curled tail
senses.english_definition: A spitz is a dog with a pointed muzzle, upright ears, thick fur, and a tail that usually curls over its back.
senses.collocation_en: a German spitz; spitz breeds
senses.collocation_zh: 一只德国斯皮茨犬；斯皮茨型犬种

senses.sentence_zh: 他们的斯皮茨犬有一身浓密的白毛，尾巴卷在背上。

etymology_story.zh: 借自德语 Spitz，是 Spitzhund 这一犬类名称的缩略形式；德语 spitz 意为“尖的”。名称与这类犬尖突的口鼻部和竖起的尖耳相呼应。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed German Spitz, a shortened form of Spitzhund; German spitz means “pointed.” The name reflects the pointed muzzle and upright, pointed ears characteristic of these dogs.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 spitz 是整体借入的名词，不能拆成英语词根和后缀；复数可用 spitz 或 spitzes。复合形式 spitz-type 表示“斯皮茨型的”，没有常用的独立派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, spitz is a borrowed noun rather than a combination of an English root and suffix; its plural can be spitz or spitzes. The compound spitz-type means “of the spitz type”; there is no common independent family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: spitz-type dog（斯皮茨型犬）是直接的释义表达；Pomeranian（博美犬）和 Samoyed（萨摩耶犬）是这一类型中的具体犬种，并非 spitz 的完全同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Spitz-type dog is a direct explanatory equivalent. Pomeranian and Samoyed name particular breeds within the spitz type, so neither is an exact synonym for the broader term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 德语 spitz＝“尖的”：尖嘴、尖耳，认出斯皮茨型犬。
mnemonic_anchor.en: German spitz means “pointed”: picture a pointed muzzle and pointed ears.

etymology.text: 借自印地语 dekho，原本是“看！”这一指令；进入英语后，可放在 have a dekko 里表示“瞧一眼”。

senses.meaning_zh: 看一眼；瞧瞧（英式非正式用语）
senses.meaning_en: A look, especially a quick look; informal British English
senses.english_definition: If you have a dekko at something, you look at it, usually briefly.
senses.collocation_en: have a dekko at something; take a dekko
senses.collocation_zh: 瞧一瞧某物；看一眼
senses.sentence_en: Let me have a dekko at the map before we leave.
senses.sentence_zh: 出发前让我瞧一眼地图。

etymology_story.zh: 源自印地语 dekho，意为“看！”，是表示“看”的动词 dekhnā 的命令式形式。它经英印接触进入英语后，变成了表示“一看”的非正式名词。
etymology_story.en: Dekko comes from Hindi dekho, meaning “look!”, an imperative form of dekhnā, “to see.” Through British contact with India, the command entered English as an informal noun meaning “a look.”

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 dekko 是不可进一步拆分的借入名词；复数可为 dekkos，但通常用于 have a dekko 等单数结构。没有常用派生词族，不应据此虚构常用动词或 dekkoing 形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, dekko is an unsegmented borrowed noun; its plural can be dekkos, although it usually occurs in singular expressions such as have a dekko. It has no common derivative family, and a common verb or dekkoing form should not be assumed.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: look（看）最中性，未必短暂；glance（一瞥）明确强调时间短；peep（窥看、瞧一眼）常暗示从小孔、遮挡处或偷偷地看，而 dekko 主要带随意的英式口语色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Look is neutral and need not be brief; glance specifically emphasizes brevity; peep often suggests looking through a small opening or looking secretly. Dekko mainly adds an informal British tone.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 印地语“看！”进入英语，变成 have a dekko：“瞧一眼”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: The Hindi command “Look!” becomes the English noun in have a dekko: “have a look.”

senses.meaning_zh: 渔船上收拉钓线或网具的绞车、卷扬装置
senses.meaning_en: A fishing-boat winch used to haul in lines or nets
senses.english_definition: A gurdy is a winch on a fishing boat that winds in fishing lines or nets.
senses.collocation_en: a fishing gurdy; a hydraulic gurdy
