etymology_story.zh: 英语 enoki 来自日语 enokitake（榎茸）的缩略形式：enoki 指榎树，即一种朴树，take 指蘑菇。名称源于这种菌菇可生长在榎树等树木的枯木上，进入英语后主要用作食材名称。
etymology_story.en: English enoki is a shortened borrowing of Japanese enokitake, combining enoki, a hackberry tree, with take, meaning mushroom. The name reflects the mushroom's growth on dead wood, including hackberry, and entered English chiefly as a culinary term.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 enoki 作为整体借词使用，不含英语词缀；其日语来源 enokitake 可分析为 enoki（榎树）+ take（蘑菇）。常见相关形式为 enokitake（金针菇的较完整借词形式）和 enoki mushroom（金针菇）；表示多朵时常仍用 enoki，无常用的英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, enoki functions as a borrowed stem without English affixes; its Japanese source enokitake consists of enoki, hackberry, + take, mushroom. Related forms include the fuller borrowing enokitake and the compound enoki mushroom. Enoki commonly remains unchanged when referring to multiple mushrooms and has no common English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: enokitake（金针菇）是较完整的日语借词，所指相同；golden needle mushroom（金针菇）突出细长如针的形态；winter mushroom（冬菇类菌菇）强调其在凉冷季节生长的特点，具体所指需结合菌种与语境判断。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Enokitake is the fuller Japanese borrowing for the same mushroom. Golden needle mushroom highlights its slender, needle-like shape. Winter mushroom emphasizes growth in cool seasons, but its precise reference depends on the species and context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“树上的菇”记到餐桌上的一簇细白针：enoki 是食材名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Move from a mushroom on a tree to a cluster of fine white needles on the plate: enoki.

senses.meaning_en: A traditional Hawaiian temple or place of religious worship
senses.english_definition: A heiau is a traditional Hawaiian temple or sacred place where religious ceremonies were performed.
senses.collocation_en: an ancient heiau; heiau ruins
senses.collocation_zh: 一座古老的夏威夷神庙；夏威夷传统神庙遗址

senses.sentence_zh: 导游讲解了这座夏威夷传统神庙及其石筑平台的历史。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 heiau 直接借自夏威夷语 heiau，指传统宗教中的神庙或祭祀场所。英语沿用其特定文化含义，既可指场所本身，也可指今天保存下来的相关遗址。
etymology_story.en: English heiau was borrowed directly from Hawaiian heiau, meaning a temple or place of worship in the traditional religion. English preserves this culturally specific meaning, referring both to the sacred sites themselves and to their surviving remains.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借入、不可再分析的词干，不宜按英语词根强行拆分。复数可用 heiau，也可见英语规则形式 heiaus；相关组合有 heiau site（传统神庙遗址）和 heiau complex（传统神庙建筑群）；无常用英语派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, heiau is an unanalyzable borrowed stem and should not be artificially divided into English roots. The plural may remain heiau, while the regular English form heiaus also occurs. Related combinations include heiau site and heiau complex; there are no common English derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: temple（神庙）是最接近的通称，但不体现夏威夷文化背景；shrine（神龛、圣所）常侧重供奉某位神灵或神圣对象的地点；sacred site（圣地）范围更广，不一定有建筑物。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Temple is the closest general equivalent but does not convey the Hawaiian cultural setting. Shrine often emphasizes a place dedicated to a particular deity or sacred object. Sacred site is broader and does not necessarily imply a building.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把夏威夷语地名感与石筑祭祀平台相连：heiau 就是当地传统神庙。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the Hawaiian name with a sacred stone platform: a heiau is a traditional Hawaiian temple.

senses.meaning_zh: （美式口语，常带诙谐或儿童用语色彩）屁股

etymology_story.zh: 表示“屁股”的 heinie 见于20世纪30年代，可能由名词 hinder（臀部、后部）变形并带上小称词尾 -ie，也有观点认为它来自 hind end（身体后部）的缩略，具体来源尚不确定。它与由德国人名 Heinrich 的昵称产生、用于贬称德国人的同形词通常分开处理。[词源参考](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Heinie)
etymology_story.en: The buttocks sense is recorded from the 1930s and may be an alteration of the noun hinder with diminutive -ie, or a shortening of hind end; its precise origin is uncertain. It is generally treated separately from the derogatory homograph for a German person, which comes from a familiar form of Heinrich. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Heinie)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代分析：heinie 是整体词干，不宜机械拆分为能自由组合的现代词根和词缀；历史上可能含小称词尾 -ie。屈折形式：heinie → heinies（复数）；常见异体拼写：hiney、heiney；没有常用的动词、形容词或副词派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: heinie functions as a whole stem rather than a transparently productive root-and-affix combination; historically, it may contain diminutive -ie. Inflection: heinie → heinies, the plural; spelling variants include hiney and heiney. It has no commonly used verb, adjective, or adverb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: bottom（屁股）较温和，尤其适合日常或儿童语境；butt（屁股）是更直接的美式口语；buttocks（臀部）较中性、正式，常见于解剖或医学表达。heinie 通常比这些词更俏皮。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Bottom is mild and suitable for everyday or child-directed speech; butt is more direct and distinctly informal American English; buttocks is neutral or formal, especially in anatomical contexts. Heinie usually sounds more playful.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 hind end（身体后部）当作联想桥梁：身体后面、坐下着地的部位就是 heinie；这是记忆提示，并非确定的构词公式。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use hind end as a memory bridge: the rear part you land on when sitting is your heinie. This is a mnemonic, not a certain derivation.

etymology_story.zh: hinky 通常被解释为俚语 hincty 或 hinkty 的变体，后两种形式见于非裔美国人的语言使用，具有“警惕、多疑”等含义，但更早的来源不明。现代 hinky 的意义包括心里不安、事情可疑，以及设备不可靠。[词源参考](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hinky)；[义项参考](https://arnoldzwicky.org/2016/09/16/hinky/)
etymology_story.en: Hinky is usually explained as a variant of slang hincty or hinkty, forms associated with African American usage and meanings such as wary or suspicious, although their deeper origin is uncertain. Modern hinky covers personal uneasiness, suspicious circumstances, and unreliable equipment. [Etymological reference](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hinky); [sense reference](https://arnoldzwicky.org/2016/09/16/hinky/)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代分析：hinky 是整体形容词词干，没有可据此解释词义的常用独立词根 hink；不能仅凭词尾 -y 编造词源。屈折形式：hinky → hinkier（比较级）→ hinkiest（最高级）；名词派生：hinkiness（可疑、不对劲或不安的状态，较少见）；异体拼写：hinkey。hincty、hinkty 是相关历史形式，不是现代派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: hinky is a whole adjective stem, with no common independent root hink that transparently explains its meaning; its final -y alone does not establish an etymology. Inflections: hinky → hinkier → hinkiest. The less common noun hinkiness denotes suspiciousness, oddness, or uneasiness; hinkey is a spelling variant. Hincty and hinkty are related historical forms, not modern derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: suspicious（可疑的）直接突出可能存在欺骗或违法；jittery（紧张不安的）突出人的焦躁和神经紧绷；wonky（不正常的、不可靠的）更适合设备或系统。hinky 可随语境覆盖这三类“不对劲”。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Suspicious directly suggests possible deception or wrongdoing; jittery emphasizes a person's nervous agitation; wonky especially suits malfunctioning equipment or unreliable systems. Hinky can express any of these kinds of unease or irregularity, depending on context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“不对劲”这个核心：人觉得不对劲→不安；事情看着不对劲→可疑；机器用着不对劲→不可靠。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to “something feels off”: a person feels uneasy, a situation seems suspicious, or a machine behaves unreliably.

etymology_story.zh: 酒义的 hootch 是 hooch 的异体，后者由 hoochinoo 缩短而来，与阿拉斯加特林吉特人的 Hutsnuwu 群体及其酿制的烈酒有关，后来泛指酒，尤其是私酿或劣质烈酒。“小屋、住处”义属于另一词源，通常追溯到日语 uchi（家、房屋）的变形。[词源与义项参考](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/hooch)
etymology_story.en: The liquor word hootch is a variant of hooch, shortened from hoochinoo and associated with the Hutsnuwu Tlingit community in Alaska and its distilled liquor; it later broadened to liquor, especially illicit or inferior spirits. The hut or dwelling sense has a separate origin, usually traced to an alteration of Japanese uchi, meaning home or house. [Etymology and sense reference](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/hooch)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代分析：hootch 是整体词干；hooch → hootch 是拼写变体关系，新增的 t 不是词缀，也不单独发音。酒义通常不可数；小屋义的复数为 hootches。相关形式：hooch（较常见拼写）、hoochinoo（酒义的历史长形式）；没有常用的形容词或副词派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: hootch is a whole stem; hooch → hootch represents a spelling variation, and the added t is neither an affix nor a separately pronounced sound. The liquor sense is normally uncountable; the dwelling sense has the plural hootches. Related forms are hooch, the more usual spelling, and hoochinoo, the historical longer liquor word. There are no commonly used adjective or adverb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 酒义：booze（酒）泛指酒类，属口语；moonshine（私酿烈酒）更明确强调非法蒸馏，hootch 也可仅指劣质酒。小屋义：shack（简陋小屋）强调建筑简陋，而 hootch 常带军队生活语境。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For liquor, booze is a broad informal term for alcoholic drink, while moonshine more specifically suggests illegally distilled spirits; hootch can also mean merely inferior liquor. For the dwelling sense, shack emphasizes poor construction, whereas hootch often carries a military association.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 分两条线记：Hoochinoo 缩短→私酿酒；另一来源→士兵住的小屋。相同拼写下的“酒”和“屋”无需强行串成同一词源。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep two tracks: shortened Hoochinoo gives the liquor word; a separate origin gives the soldier's hut. The shared spelling does not imply a shared history.

etymology_story.zh: 建筑和院落义借自索托语 lelapa，先指家庭宅院的前院，英语中也用于休憩、聚餐的凉棚。[名词词源参考](https://dsae.co.za/entry/lapa/e04236)；表示“那边”的副词及指示性形容词用法来源不同，经 Fanakalo 联系到祖鲁语等语言的 lapha（这里）。[副词及形容词词源参考](https://dsae.co.za/entry/lapa/e04237)
etymology_story.en: The architectural noun comes from Sotho lelapa, referring to a homestead forecourt, and English also uses it for a shelter for relaxing or dining. [Noun etymology reference](https://dsae.co.za/entry/lapa/e04236) The adverb and demonstrative adjective have a separate origin through Fanakalo, connected with lapha, meaning here, in Zulu and related languages. [Adverb and adjective etymology reference](https://dsae.co.za/entry/lapa/e04237)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代分析：各词源下的 lapa 在英语中均作为整体借入词干，不拆成英语词根和词缀。名词复数：lapas；名词异体：lappa，相关借入形式：lelapa；副词及形容词异体：lapha。lapa roof（凉棚屋顶）、lapa wall（院墙）中的 lapa 是名词作定语；这与独立来源的 lapa side 指示用法不同。没有常用的英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: each lapa is a whole borrowed stem, without an English root-and-affix breakdown. The noun plural is lapas; lappa is a noun spelling variant, and lelapa is a related borrowed form. Lapha is a variant of the adverb and adjective. In lapa roof and lapa wall, lapa is an attributive noun; this differs from the separately derived demonstrative use in lapa side. There is no commonly used English derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: gazebo（庭园凉亭）与凉棚义接近，但不限定茅顶或南非背景；courtyard（院落）对应前院义，不表示有顶凉棚；there（那里）对应局部口语中的副词义，是更通用的标准英语表达。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Gazebo overlaps with the shelter sense but does not specify thatch or a southern African setting; courtyard matches the enclosed outdoor-space sense rather than the roofed shelter; there is the general standard-English equivalent of the localized adverb.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 名词记“一家人在户外相聚的地方”：可以是前院，也可以是茅顶凉棚；另把 lapa side 整体记成“那一边”，不要混同两条词源。
mnemonic_anchor.en: For the noun, picture a family's outdoor gathering place: a forecourt or a thatched shelter. Learn lapa side separately as “that side,” keeping the two origins distinct.

etymology_story.zh: lehua 在19世纪后期由夏威夷语同形词借入英语，沿用了当地对这种树及其花的称呼。英语词典还记录了以树名指其坚硬木材的用法。[词源与义项参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/lehua)
etymology_story.en: Lehua entered English from Hawaiian in the late nineteenth century, retaining the local name for the tree and its flowers. English dictionaries also record the tree name being used for its hard wood. [Etymology and sense reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/lehua)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代分析：lehua 是整体借入的简单词干，没有可用于英语构词分析的前缀或后缀。树和花的可数复数为 lehuas；木材义通常不可数。相关复合表达：ʻōhiʻa lehua（多形铁心木）、lehua blossom（该树的花）、lehua wood（该树的木材）；这些是复合名称或名词短语，不是词缀派生词。没有常用的动词、形容词或副词派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: lehua is a whole borrowed simple stem, without English prefixes or suffixes. The countable tree and flower senses have the plural lehuas; the wood sense is normally uncountable. Related expressions include ʻōhiʻa lehua, lehua blossom, and lehua wood; these are compound names or noun phrases rather than affixal derivatives. There are no commonly used verb, adjective, or adverb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ʻōhiʻa lehua（多形铁心木）是更完整的夏威夷树名；Metrosideros polymorpha（多形铁心木）是该树的科学名称，指称更精确；lehua blossom（多形铁心木花）明确只指花。lehua 单独使用时须根据语境区分树、花或木材，这些表达不能在所有语境中互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: ʻŌhiʻa lehua is the fuller Hawaiian tree name; Metrosideros polymorpha is the precise scientific name for the tree; lehua blossom explicitly identifies the flower. Lehua alone may denote the tree, flower, or wood, so these expressions are not interchangeable in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一树三指：夏威夷红花树→树本身、树上的花、树的硬木；lehua 是当地名称，不必硬拆英语词根。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture one Hawaiian flowering tree with three referents: the tree itself, its blossoms, and its hard wood. Lehua is a local name, not an English root puzzle.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借用美洲西班牙语 malanga，沿用当地对食用芋类及其球茎的称呼。该词更早的来源并无一致定论，而且不同地区所指的植物可能不同。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed malanga from American Spanish as a name for edible tropical aroids and their corms. Its earlier origin is not firmly established, and the particular plant denoted varies by region.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作常规词缀分析的借词：malanga。食材义通常作不可数名词，指多株植物或多个球茎时可用复数 malangas；无常用派生词，常见复合表达有 malanga soup（芋汤）和 malanga flour（芋粉）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, malanga is an unanalyzed loanword with no productive prefix or suffix. It is usually uncountable as a food name; malangas can refer to individual plants or corms. There are no common derivatives; compounds include malanga soup and malanga flour.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: yautia（千年芋）和 tannia（千年芋）常与指千年芋属植物的 malanga 对应；taro（芋）通常指芋属植物，只在部分地区的命名习惯中与 malanga 重合。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Yautia and tannia often name the same Xanthosoma crops as malanga. Taro usually denotes Colocasia, so it overlaps with malanga only in some regional naming systems.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 malanga 整词连到“热带市场里买来煮汤的芋头”；它没有可用的英语词根拆分。

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为整体借入的动物名称处理：pinche；复数为 pinches。无常用英语派生词；pinche monkey（绒顶狨）是名词组合。该词在当代英语中较罕见，通常使用 cotton-top tamarin。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat pinche as a borrowed animal name without a productive English affix; its plural is pinches. It has no common English derivatives, and pinche monkey is a noun combination. The word is uncommon in contemporary English, where cotton-top tamarin is usual.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cotton-top tamarin（绒顶狨）是通常使用的名称；cotton-headed tamarin（棉头狨）是同一动物的另一名称；tamarin（狨猴）范围更广，不能单独准确限定这个物种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cotton-top tamarin is the usual name, and cotton-headed tamarin is an alternative name for the same animal. Tamarin is broader and does not identify this particular species.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自日语 reishi，即“霊芝”，对应汉语“灵芝”。名称中的两个汉字分别与“灵异、神圣”和“芝类真菌”有关，英语沿用这一名称来称呼真菌及其制品。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Japanese reishi, written 霊芝 and corresponding to Chinese lingzhi. The characters convey associations with the spiritual or numinous and with a fungus, and English extended the borrowed name to preparations made from it.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借词：reishi，无可独立使用的英语前后缀。日语来源可分析为 rei（灵、神圣）＋ shi（芝）；英语通常用作不可数名词，无常用派生词，常见组合有 reishi mushroom（灵芝）、reishi extract（灵芝提取物）和 reishi powder（灵芝粉）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, reishi is a whole loanword with no independently functioning English affixes. Its Japanese source contains rei, associated with the spiritual or numinous, and shi, meaning a fungus. English usually treats it as uncountable; it has no common derivatives, but forms combinations such as reishi mushroom, reishi extract, and reishi powder.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: lingzhi（灵芝）是对应的汉语借词；Ganoderma（灵芝属）是范围更大的属名，不能与 reishi 完全互换；mushroom（蘑菇、菌菇）只是宽泛的日常类别名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Lingzhi is the corresponding Chinese-derived name. Ganoderma denotes the broader genus and is not fully interchangeable with reishi, while mushroom is only a general everyday category.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect Japanese rei + shi with the characters for lingzhi, then picture a shiny, fan-shaped fungus growing on wood.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自德语 Rille，意思是“沟槽、细沟”，其更早来源与低地德语有关。天文学把这个描述细长凹槽的词用于月面地形，并不意味着沟槽一定由流水形成。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed German Rille, meaning a groove or narrow channel, with an earlier connection to Low German. Astronomers applied the shape-based name to lunar features without implying that flowing water formed them.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为单纯借词：rille；复数为 rilles，无常用派生词。rill 是相关的拼写形式，但日常英语中的 rill 还可表示“小溪”；lunar rille（月溪）和 sinuous rille（蜿蜒月溪）是修饰语加名词的组合。
morphology_enriched.en: Rille is a simple loanword in modern English; its plural is rilles, and it has no common derivatives. Rill is a related spelling, but ordinary English rill can also mean a small stream. Lunar rille and sinuous rille combine a modifier with the noun.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: rima（月溪，复数 rimae）是月面地貌命名中的对应术语；groove（沟槽）只描述一般形状；channel（通道、沟道）更宽泛，在月面语境中可能指熔岩流形成的沟道。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Rima, plural rimae, is the corresponding term used in lunar feature nomenclature. Groove describes the general shape, while channel is broader and may refer to a passage formed by flowing lava in a lunar context.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the original idea of a narrow groove: a rille is a long groove across the Moon.

senses.english_definition: A saros is a period of about eighteen years after which the Sun, Earth, and Moon return to a similar arrangement and a similar eclipse can occur.

senses.collocation_zh: 沙罗周期；沙罗食系
senses.sentence_en: Eclipses in the same saros series occur about eighteen years apart.
senses.sentence_zh: 同一沙罗食系中的各次食大约相隔十八年。

etymology_story.zh: 该词经希腊语 sáros 追溯至阿卡德语中表示“三千六百”的数词，古代相关用法并不是今天的十八年食周期。哈雷于1691年把这个名称用于日月食的重复周期，这一现代用法随后沿用下来。
etymology_story.en: The word comes through Greek sáros from an Akkadian numeral meaning 3,600; the associated ancient usage did not denote today's eighteen-year eclipse period. Halley applied the name to eclipse recurrence in 1691, and that modern usage persisted.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为整体天文学术语处理：saros；末尾 s 属于词干，不是复数标记，英语规则复数为 saroses。无常用英语派生词；saros cycle（沙罗周期）与 saros series（沙罗食系）是名词组合，exeligmos（三倍沙罗周期）是相关的独立术语。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat saros as a whole astronomical term: its final s belongs to the stem and is not a plural ending; the regular English plural is saroses. It has no common English derivatives. Saros cycle and saros series are noun combinations, while exeligmos is a separate related term for three saros periods.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: eclipse cycle（食周期）是上位概念，不一定专指沙罗周期；saros cycle（沙罗周期）与 saros 基本同义；exeligmos（三倍沙罗周期）约含三个沙罗周期，不能视为同长度的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Eclipse cycle is a broader category and need not mean a saros specifically. Saros cycle is essentially equivalent to saros. An exeligmos comprises approximately three saros periods, so it is related rather than synonymous.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住“223个朔望月，食的几何关系近似重来”；不要把古代词源中的“三千六百”当作现代周期长度。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember 223 new-moon-to-new-moon intervals, then similar eclipse geometry returns; the ancient 3,600 is part of the word's history, not its modern duration.

etymology_story.zh: 该词得名于美国北卡罗来纳州的 Scuppernong 河，河名源自当地美洲原住民语言。这一地名先成为当地一种青铜色圆叶葡萄的名称，随后也用来指其葡萄藤和所酿的酒。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from the Scuppernong River in North Carolina, whose name has an Indigenous American origin. The place name became the name of a local bronze-colored muscadine grape and was extended to its vine and wine.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步分析的地名转用词，不能拆成有意义的英语词根和词缀。复数为 scuppernongs；常见复合词有 scuppernong grape（斯卡珀农葡萄）、scuppernong vine（斯卡珀农葡萄藤）和 scuppernong wine（斯卡珀农葡萄酒），无常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, this is an unanalyzable word transferred from a place name, with no productive English root-and-affix breakdown. The plural is scuppernongs; common compounds include scuppernong grape, scuppernong vine, and scuppernong wine, but there is no established common derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: muscadine（圆叶葡萄）是上位词，包含斯卡珀农等品种；bronze muscadine（青铜色圆叶葡萄）的范围较宽，并不一定专指斯卡珀农；grape（葡萄）是最宽泛的名称。三者都不能在所有语境中与 scuppernong 完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Muscadine is the broader category that includes scuppernong; bronze muscadine describes bronze-colored muscadines more generally; grape is the broadest everyday term. None is an exact substitute for scuppernong in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 河名变葡萄名：Scuppernong 河 → 当地青铜色葡萄 → 葡萄藤与葡萄酒。
mnemonic_anchor.en: River name → local bronze grape → its vine and wine.

etymology_story.zh: 该词借自法语 socle，经意大利语 zoccolo 追溯到拉丁语 socculus，后者是表示轻便鞋的 soccus 的小称形式。“脚下承托物”的形象发展为建筑底座的含义，后来又被借用于代数。
etymology_story.en: The word was borrowed from French socle and goes back through Italian zoccolo to Latin socculus, a diminutive of soccus, meaning a light shoe. The image of something supporting a structure from below developed into the architectural meaning and was later adopted in algebra.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 socle 是完整借入的单一词素，不能按英语词根和词缀拆分。复数为 socles；常见专业组合有 socle series（底座列）和 socle filtration（底座滤过），无常用的一般英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, socle is a single borrowed morpheme with no English root-and-affix breakdown. Its plural is socles; technical combinations include socle series and socle filtration, but it has no common general-English derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 建筑义中，plinth（柱脚、台基）与其最接近，常指承托柱子或雕像的块状底座；pedestal（台座）通常更高、更独立；base（底部、底座）适用范围最广。这些词不能直接替代其代数术语义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In architecture, plinth is the closest term and often denotes a block supporting a column or statue; pedestal usually suggests a taller, more distinct support; base is the broadest term. These words do not directly replace socle in its algebraic sense.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史上的“小鞋”托住脚，建筑中的 socle 托住上部结构。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A little shoe supports a foot; a socle supports a structure.

etymology_story.zh: 该词借自印地语 thālī，原指盘子或托盘。英语沿用了容器名称指代其中整份餐食的用法，因此既可指餐盘，也可指套餐。
etymology_story.en: The word was borrowed from Hindi thālī, meaning a plate or tray. English also adopted the use of the container's name for the complete meal served on it, so thali can denote either the plate or the meal.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 thali 是单一借入词素，没有可独立分析的英语词根和词缀。复数为 thalis；常见组合有 vegetarian thali（素食塔利套餐）和 thali meal（塔利套餐），无常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, thali is a single borrowed morpheme without an English root-and-affix breakdown. Its plural is thalis; common combinations include vegetarian thali and thali meal, but it has no established common derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 餐具义中，plate（盘子）强调盛食物的盘，tray（托盘）强调承托和端送；餐食义中，set meal（套餐）强调预先搭配好的餐食，但不限定使用一个大餐盘。这些词都只与 thali 的部分含义接近。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the utensil, plate emphasizes the dish holding food, while tray emphasizes a surface used to hold or carry items. For the food, set meal emphasizes a predetermined combination of dishes without requiring a single serving plate. Each overlaps with only part of thali's meaning.

mnemonic_anchor.en: One plate, many dishes: remember the tray first, then the complete meal on it.

etymology_story.zh: 名称取自这首颂歌拉丁文的首词 magnificat，意为“赞颂、尊为大”，是 magnificare 的第三人称单数现在时形式。首词成为整篇颂歌的名称，后来也用来命名依据其经文创作的乐曲。
etymology_story.en: The title comes from the opening Latin word magnificat, meaning 'magnifies' or 'extols,' the third-person singular present form of magnificare. That first word became the name of the entire canticle and later of musical works based on its text.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Magnificat 是完整借入的颂歌名称，通常首字母大写，不能按英语词缀拆分；指不同谱曲作品时可用复数 Magnificats。历史上的拉丁语形式可分析为 magnific- 加第三人称单数现在时词尾 -at；magnify（赞颂；放大）、magnification（放大）和 magnificent（壮丽的）与之词源相关，但不是由英语 Magnificat 派生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Magnificat is a borrowed canticle title, normally capitalized, with no productive English affix breakdown; Magnificats can refer to multiple musical settings. Historically, the Latin form contains magnific- and the third-person singular present ending -at; magnify, magnification, and magnificent are etymologically related, rather than derivatives of the English title.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Song of Mary（玛利亚之歌）和 Canticle of Mary（玛利亚颂歌）是同一经文的替代名称；canticle（圣经颂歌）是上位词，可指多种用于礼拜的圣经歌曲。Magnificat 还可直接指某位作曲家的具体谱曲作品。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Song of Mary and Canticle of Mary are alternative names for the same biblical text; canticle is a broader term for a biblical song used in worship. Magnificat can additionally name a particular composer's musical setting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: magnify 的古义是“尊为大、赞颂”：颂歌开头的“赞颂”成为整首歌的名字。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect it with magnify in the sense 'extol': the opening word of praise names the whole song.

etymology_story.zh: clumber 是 Clumber spaniel 的简称，名称来自英格兰诺丁汉郡的 Clumber Park 庄园。该犬种与纽卡斯尔公爵在这座庄园饲养和培育的犬群密切相关，庄园名由此成为犬种名称。
etymology_story.en: Clumber is short for Clumber spaniel, named after Clumber Park in Nottinghamshire, England. The breed became associated with dogs kept and developed there by the Dukes of Newcastle, and the estate's name became the breed name.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 clumber 是由犬种全称 Clumber spaniel 缩短而来的地名转用词，不能拆成 clumb + -er。复数为 clumbers；犬种名称中常写作 Clumber 或 Clumber Spaniel，无常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, clumber is a shortened form of Clumber spaniel and ultimately derives from a place name; it is not formed from clumb plus -er. Its plural is clumbers; breed-name usage often capitalizes Clumber or Clumber Spaniel, and there is no common derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Clumber spaniel（克伦伯猎鹬犬）是完整且准确的同义名称；spaniel（猎鹬犬）是包含多个犬种的上位词；gundog（枪猎犬）按狩猎用途分类，范围更广。后两者都不能单独确定该犬种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Clumber spaniel is the full, exact equivalent; spaniel is a broader category containing several breeds; gundog is a still broader functional term for a dog used in shooting game. The latter two do not identify this particular breed.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 庄园名就是犬种名：Clumber Park → Clumber spaniel → clumber。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Estate → breed → short name: Clumber Park → Clumber spaniel → clumber.

etymology_story.zh: 源自印地语、乌尔都语 bilāyatī、vilāyatī 一类形式，意为“外国的、欧洲的、英国的”，可进一步追溯到波斯语及阿拉伯语中表示领地或辖区的词。英国军人在印度使用这一称呼，后来使它成为对英国故乡的亲切称呼。
etymology_story.en: Blighty comes from Hindi and Urdu forms such as bilāyatī and vilāyatī, meaning foreign, European, or British, ultimately connected through Persian with an Arabic word for a territory or province. British soldiers in India adopted it, and it became an affectionate name for Britain as home.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为不可再按常用词根、词缀拆解的借词处理；结尾 -y 在这里不是英语派生后缀。通常大写，不可数；Blighty-bound（返回英国的）是可理解的复合形式，没有常用的完整派生词族。该词无公认的逐词 CEFR 等级，此处不推定考试归属。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Blighty is a borrowed base without a productive root-and-affix breakdown; its final -y is not an English derivational suffix here. It is normally capitalized and uncountable; Blighty-bound is a transparent compound, but there is no established extensive derivative family. No established individual CEFR rating or examination-list membership is asserted.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Britain（英国）是中性地名；home（家乡、祖国）强调个人归属，但不专指英国；the old country（故国）多用于移居海外者谈论原籍国。Blighty 专指英国，并带有英国式亲切感和怀旧意味。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Britain is the neutral geographical name; home emphasizes personal belonging without necessarily meaning Britain; the old country usually refers to an emigrant's country of origin. Blighty specifically means Britain and adds a distinctly British tone of affection or nostalgia.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从海外望回英国：别人眼中的“外国”，成了英国人口中的“老家”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture Britain from overseas: a borrowed word for foreign becomes an affectionate word for home.

etymology_story.zh: 由 International Telecommunications Satellite 名称中的词首片段拼合而成：国际、电信、卫星。该名称既用于相关组织和企业，也用于其通信卫星系列及其中的单颗卫星。

etymology_story.zh: 源自拉丁语 rhus，更早来自希腊语 rhous，原指盐肤木一类植物；它也作为新拉丁语属名 Rhus 传入植物学用语。传统分类中的 Rhus 范围较广，因此旧文献中的“漆树属”不一定对应现代分类中的同一属。
etymology_story.en: Rhus comes from Latin rhus, ultimately from Greek rhous, a name for sumac, and also entered botanical terminology as the New Latin genus name Rhus. The genus was historically more broadly defined, so older references do not always match its modern taxonomic boundaries.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整的古典来源词基处理，不宜拆成 r + hus 等无意义片段。普通植物名称写作 rhus，正式属名写作 Rhus；sumac 是对应通名，并非 rhus 加词缀形成的派生词，rhus 也没有常用的英语派生词族。该专业词无公认的逐词 CEFR 等级，此处不推定考试归属。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, rhus is a complete classical base and should not be divided into meaningless fragments such as r + hus. The common plant noun is rhus, while the formal genus name is Rhus; sumac is a corresponding common name, not an affixal derivative, and there is no established everyday English derivative family. No established individual CEFR rating or examination-list membership is asserted.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sumac 是最接近的常用名称；sumach 是 sumac 的另一种拼写，并无独立语义差别；Rhus 是正式属名，强调分类学身份。具体物种名不能作为整个属的完全同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sumac is the closest everyday equivalent; sumach is an alternative spelling without a separate meaning; Rhus is the formal genus name and emphasizes taxonomic identity. A particular species name is not an exact synonym for the whole genus.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 rhus 与 sumac 成对记：同一类植物的古典名称与常用名称。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pair rhus with sumac: a classical plant name beside its everyday equivalent.

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。sabin + value → sabin value（以赛宾表示的数值）；单位名称来自人名，不能拆成英语词根。

etymology.text: 以美国物理学家 Wallace C. W. Sabine 的姓命名，拼写去掉末尾 e，成为声学单位 sabin。把“人名”与“测量吸声”连在一起记。

usage_note: sabin 是声吸收量单位，decibel 是声音级别的单位。查阅表格时还要看采用平方英尺还是平方米的参照面积。

senses.meaning_zh: 赛宾，等效吸声面积单位；英制赛宾对应一平方英尺完全吸声表面，公制赛宾对应一平方米
senses.meaning_en: A unit of equivalent sound absorption area, based on one square foot for an imperial sabin or one square metre for a metric sabin
senses.english_definition: A sabin is a unit for measuring sound absorption by comparing it with the absorption of a perfectly absorbing surface of a specified area.

senses.sentence_zh: 在测试频率下，这种材料提供了十公制赛宾的等效吸声面积。

etymology_story.zh: 以美国物理学家、建筑声学先驱 Wallace Clement Sabine 的姓氏命名，单位名称省去了姓氏末尾的 e。它把 Sabine 对混响和吸声的研究与吸声量的测量联系起来。
etymology_story.en: The unit is named after Wallace Clement Sabine, the American physicist and pioneer of architectural acoustics, with the final e of his surname omitted. It connects his work on reverberation and absorption with the measurement of sound absorption.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词关系：Sabine（人名）→ sabin（单位名），属于专名转为普通名词并调整拼写，不是 sab + -in 的词根词缀组合。复数为 sabins；metric sabin（公制赛宾）和 imperial sabin（英制赛宾）是带修饰语的单位名称，没有常用的动词或形容词派生。该专业词无公认的逐词 CEFR 等级，此处不推定考试归属。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: Sabine, a personal name, → sabin, a common unit noun, through eponymic naming and a spelling adjustment rather than a sab + -in analysis. The plural is sabins; metric sabin and imperial sabin are modified unit names, and there are no established common verb or adjective derivatives. No established individual CEFR rating or examination-list membership is asserted.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: absorption unit（吸声单位）是较宽泛的描述；metric sabin（公制赛宾）明确采用平方米基准；imperial sabin（英制赛宾）明确采用平方英尺基准。两种赛宾的数值尺度不同，而 absorption coefficient（吸声系数）是无量纲比值，不能与赛宾混用。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Absorption unit is a broader descriptive expression; metric sabin explicitly uses a square-metre basis; imperial sabin explicitly uses a square-foot basis. The two sabin conventions have different numerical scales, while an absorption coefficient is a dimensionless ratio and is not interchangeable with a sabin.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Sabine 去掉 e，留下吸声单位 sabin：把吸声量想成一块“完全吸声的等效面积”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Drop the e from Sabine to get sabin: picture sound absorption as an equivalent patch of perfectly absorbing surface.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再分析的单纯词 gama，没有可辨认的常用英语前后缀。复数可作 gamas，但表示饲草时通常采用集合用法；gama + grass → gama grass，另有合写形式 gamagrass，均属植物名称形式，没有常用的派生动词、形容词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, gama is a simple, unanalyzable base with no recognizable productive English prefix or suffix. The plural can be gamas, though forage references usually use it collectively; gama + grass forms gama grass, also written gamagrass, and there are no common derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: gama grass（摩擦禾）是直接对应的名称；eastern gamagrass（东部摩擦禾）明确指 Tripsacum dactyloides；forage grass（饲草）只是用途类别，范围更广，不能作为精确的植物学同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Gama grass is a direct alternative name; eastern gamagrass specifically identifies Tripsacum dactyloides; forage grass describes a broader use category and is not an exact botanical synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 gama 与 gama grass 整体绑定：看到 gama，就想到供牲畜吃的高大牧草；不要与希腊字母 gamma 混淆。

etymology_story.zh: spean 来自中古苏格兰语 spen、speane，很可能承自重构的古英语形式，其更早的日耳曼语词基表示“乳头”。这个词把与吃奶有关的身体部位发展为“使停止吃奶”的动作名称。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/spean)
etymology_story.en: Spean comes from Middle Scots spen and speane, probably continuing reconstructed Old English forms ultimately based on a Germanic word for a teat or nipple. The historical development connects the organ used in suckling with the action of ending suckling. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/spean)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词以 spean 为不可再拆的动词词基：spean + -s → speans（第三人称单数）；spean + -ed → speaned（过去式、过去分词）；spean + -ing → speaning（现在分词，也可作表示断奶过程的动名词）。这些主要是屈折形式，没有常用的标准英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern morphology treats spean as an unanalyzable verb base: spean + -s → speans, the third-person singular; spean + -ed → speaned, the past tense and past participle; spean + -ing → speaning, the present participle and a possible gerund naming the process. These are mainly inflectional forms, with no common derivative family in standard English.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: wean（使断奶）是标准英语中的直接对应词；stop breastfeeding（停止母乳喂养）主要描述人的母乳喂养结束；transition to solid food（逐步改吃固体食物）强调饮食转换过程，未必表示已经完全断奶。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Wean is the direct standard-English equivalent; stop breastfeeding chiefly describes the end of human breastfeeding; transition to solid food emphasizes dietary change and does not necessarily imply complete weaning.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史线索是“乳头 → 停止吃奶”：把 spean 记成苏格兰语境中的 wean。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical link from teat to ending suckling: remember spean as the chiefly Scottish equivalent of wean.

etymology_story.zh: Brasil 是葡萄牙语国名，英语通常采用 Brazil；国名源于当地出产的红色染料木材，即巴西木，而不是由现代英语词根直接拼成。[柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/brasil)、[在线词源词典](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Brazil)
etymology_story.en: Brasil is the Portuguese country name, while English normally uses Brazil; the country was named after its valuable red dyewood, brazilwood, rather than through a combination of modern English roots. [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/brasil), [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Brazil)

morphology_enriched.zh: Brasil 在现代英语中作为完整的外语专有名称使用，没有可直接拆分的英语前后缀，也通常不用复数。英语相关词族采用常规拼写 Brazil：Brazil + -ian → Brazilian（巴西的；巴西人），Brazilians（巴西人，复数）；Brazilian Portuguese（巴西葡萄牙语）是短语，不是 Brasil 的单词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English uses Brasil as a complete foreign proper name, without a productive English prefix or suffix and normally without a plural. The related English family follows the usual spelling Brazil: Brazil + -ian → Brazilian, an adjective or a noun meaning a person from Brazil, with plural Brazilians; Brazilian Portuguese is a phrase rather than a derivative of Brasil.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Brazil（巴西）是常规英语名称；the Federative Republic of Brazil（巴西联邦共和国）是正式英文国名。二者与 Brasil 指向同一国家，差异主要在语言和正式程度，而非所指对象。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Brazil is the usual English name; the Federative Republic of Brazil is the formal English state name. Both refer to the same country as Brasil, with differences of language and formality rather than reference.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 葡语 Brasil 用 s，英语 Brazil 用 z：换一个字母，仍是同一个巴西。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Portuguese Brasil has s; English Brazil has z: one letter changes, but the country stays the same.

etymology_story.zh: 纺织术语 dobby 可能来自 Dobby，即 Robert 的昵称，但这一解释尚不确定。它先指织机上的装置，随后也用于指该装置织出的组织和织物。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dobby)
etymology_story.en: The textile term dobby may come from Dobby, a nickname for Robert, although this explanation is uncertain. Its meaning extended from the loom attachment to the weave and fabric produced with it. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dobby)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 dobby 是整体词基，不宜分析为 dob + -y；复数 dobby → dobbies，表示多个装置或不同种类的织物。常用复合结构包括 dobby loom（多臂织机）、dobby weave（多臂组织）和 dobby-woven（用多臂织机织成的）；dobby 在 dobby fabric 等结构中通常是名词作定语，无须另设常用形容词词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats dobby as a whole base rather than dob + -y; the plural is dobbies, referring to multiple devices or kinds of fabric. Common combinations include dobby loom, dobby weave, and dobby-woven; in phrases such as dobby fabric, dobby normally functions as a noun modifier rather than a separate common adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: dobby mechanism（多臂机构）明确指设备；dobby weave（多臂组织）指织物结构；figured fabric（花纹织物）范围更广，并不限定用多臂装置织成。jacquard（提花装置或提花织物）是相关术语，通常涉及更复杂的经纱控制，不能直接等同于 dobby。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Dobby mechanism explicitly names the equipment; dobby weave names the fabric structure; figured fabric is broader and need not be made with a dobby. Jacquard is a related term generally involving more elaborate warp control and is not an exact equivalent of dobby.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 顺着生产链记：多臂装置 → 小花纹组织 → 小提花布，一个 dobby 串起三层意思。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the production chain: pattern-making device → patterned weave → patterned cloth; dobby names all three stages.

morphology_enriched.en: Anubis is a proper name that cannot be segmented into modern English prefixes and suffixes and normally has no plural; its possessive can be Anubis's, or Anubis' under some style conventions. Anubis statue is a noun-modifier construction; the specialist relational adjective Anubian means relating to Anubis but is not common basic vocabulary.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Anpu 和 Inpu 是这一古埃及神名的其他转写形式，与 Anubis 指同一神祇；the jackal-headed god（胡狼头神）是描述性称呼，脱离语境时不如专名明确。Osiris（奥西里斯）是另一位与亡者有关的神，并非同义名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Anpu and Inpu are alternative renderings of the Egyptian name and refer to the same deity as Anubis; the jackal-headed god is a descriptive label that is less precise without context. Osiris is a different deity associated with the dead, not a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整名绑定一个画面：胡狼头的阿努比斯守护棺木、引导亡者。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Attach the whole name to one image: jackal-headed Anubis guarding a coffin and guiding the dead.

etymology_story.en: The name came through Latin from Greek Arktouros, combining arktos, meaning “bear,” with an element meaning “guardian.” Its original meaning, “bear guardian,” refers to its position in the sky relative to the Great Bear.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 Arcturus 视为不可再作常用词根与词缀拆分的专名；历史上的希腊语构成不等于现代英语构词。没有常用的屈折变化或派生词族；Arcturus's light“大角星的光”是所有格结构。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Arcturus is a proper name without a productive root-and-affix breakdown; its historical Greek components are not modern English morphemes. It has no common inflectional or derivational family; Arcturus's light is a possessive construction.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Alpha Boötis“牧夫座α星”和 α Boo 都指同一颗恒星：前者是拜耳命名，后者是其缩写；Arcturus 是传统星名。它们是同一对象的不同名称，不是意义相近的普通词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Alpha Boötis and α Boo identify the same star: the former is its Bayer designation, and the latter is the abbreviated form. Arcturus is its traditional name; these are alternative designations rather than ordinary synonyms.

etymology_story.zh: 干酪名称来自荷兰城市 Gouda，该城长期是这种干酪的重要交易中心。名称由交易地转指商品，并不意味着所有豪达干酪都在该城制造。
etymology_story.en: The cheese takes its name from the Dutch city of Gouda, historically an important trading centre for it. The trading place gave its name to the product, although Gouda cheese is not necessarily made in the city.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词关系为 Gouda“豪达市”→ Gouda“豪达干酪”，属于地名转作商品名，没有可拆分的英语前后缀。干酪义通常不可数，表示不同品种或不同块干酪时可用 Goudas；Gouda cheese“豪达干酪”和 smoked Gouda“烟熏豪达干酪”是短语，没有常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern naming relationship is Gouda, the city, → Gouda, the cheese: a place name becomes a product name, without English prefixes or suffixes. The cheese noun is usually uncountable, but Goudas can refer to varieties or individual cheeses; Gouda cheese and smoked Gouda are phrases, and there is no common derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Edam“埃丹干酪”和 Maasdam“马斯丹干酪”都是相关的荷兰干酪名称，并非 Gouda 的同义词：埃丹干酪通常脂肪较少，马斯丹干酪以明显的孔洞著称。Dutch cheese“荷兰干酪”是上位称呼；城市名 Gouda 没有常用的英语同义名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Edam and Maasdam are related Dutch cheeses rather than synonyms: Edam is typically lower in fat, while Maasdam is noted for its large holes. Dutch cheese is a broader category; the city name Gouda has no common English synonym.

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。namby + -pamby → namby-pamby（软弱、矫揉造作的）；这是还原完整叠韵词，不是历史词根拆分。

etymology.text: 由英语 namby-pamby 缩短而来。原来的叠韵说法带着讥讽、嫌人软弱的口气，缩短后的 namby 仍保留这种贬义。

usage_note: namby 带明显批评意味，意思是缺乏力度；gentle“温和的”可以是赞美，不能随意替换。

etymology_story.zh: namby 是 namby-pamby 的罕见缩略形式；完整词源于亨利·凯里讽刺诗人安布罗斯·菲利普斯时使用的戏称 Namby Pamby。这个戏称模仿幼儿式说话，后来由嘲讽诗风甜腻扩展为批评人或做法软弱、缺乏魄力。
etymology_story.en: Namby is a rare shortening of namby-pamby, which originated in Henry Carey's mocking name Namby Pamby for the poet Ambrose Philips. The name imitated childish speech, and its meaning broadened from affectedly sentimental verse to weakness or lack of firmness.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代关系为 namby-pamby → namby，属于截短，不是外来借词，也不是 namby 加上后缀 -pamby。完整形式是带押韵重复结构的词；相关形式包括形容词及名词 namby-pamby“软弱矫情的；软弱矫情的人”和名词 namby-pambiness“软弱矫情”。独立形式 namby 很少见，所列搭配是自然的示例组合，不能视为已确证的高频搭配。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern relationship is namby-pamby → namby by clipping; namby is neither a foreign borrowing nor a base combined with a suffix -pamby. The full form is a rhyming formation; related forms include the adjective and noun namby-pamby and the noun namby-pambiness. Standalone namby is rare, so the collocations supplied are illustrative combinations rather than established high-frequency expressions.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: weak“软弱的”含义最广；spineless“没骨气的”着重缺少勇气或原则；wishy-washy“优柔寡断的”着重立场不坚定。namby 还可能带有嘲笑对方过分感伤、矫情的意味。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Weak is the broadest term; spineless stresses a lack of courage or principle; wishy-washy stresses indecision or an unclear position. Namby can additionally mock excessive sentimentality or affected delicacy.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从幼儿式昵称到讥讽：说话甜软，做事也被嫌软弱。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A babyish nickname becomes a sneer: sugary expression suggests a lack of backbone.

etymology_story.zh: 经拉丁语 Phoebus 来自希腊语 Phoibos，通常解释为“光辉的”或“纯净的”，原是阿波罗的称号。随着阿波罗与太阳的联系加强，Phoebus 也成为诗歌中对太阳的称呼。
etymology_story.en: Phoebus came through Latin from Greek Phoibos, traditionally interpreted as “bright” or “pure,” and was an epithet of Apollo. As Apollo became associated with the sun, Phoebus also developed a poetic use meaning the sun.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语把 Phoebus 作为完整的古典专名使用，不应拆成英语词根与后缀。没有常用派生词族；Phoebus Apollo“福玻斯·阿波罗”是称号与神名的组合，Phoebus's 是所有格形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats Phoebus as a complete classical proper name, without an English root-and-suffix analysis. It has no common derivational family; Phoebus Apollo combines an epithet with a divine name, and Phoebus's is its possessive form.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Apollo“阿波罗”是神的通常名称，Phoebus 是其称号；sun“太阳”是诗歌义对应的普通词。Helios“赫利俄斯”是希腊神话中的太阳神，虽与相关太阳意象相连，却不能在所有神话语境中与阿波罗直接互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Apollo is the god's usual name, while Phoebus is his epithet; sun is the ordinary equivalent of the poetic sense. Helios is the Greek sun god and shares the solar imagery, but is not interchangeable with Apollo in every mythological context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“光辉”：光辉的阿波罗，也映照诗歌中的太阳。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hold on to “brightness”: radiant Apollo also evokes the poetic sun.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 albacore 很可能借自葡萄牙语鱼名 albacora，其更早来源并不确定。这个词作为鱼名进入英语，后来也自然用于表示这种鱼的食用鱼肉。
etymology_story.en: English albacore was probably borrowed from the Portuguese fish name albacora, whose earlier origin is uncertain. It entered English as a fish name and also came to denote the fish's flesh as food.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 albacore 是不可作常用英语词根与词缀拆分的借词，不能硬拆为 alba + core。鱼类义的复数可用 albacore 或 albacores，鱼肉义通常不可数；没有常用派生词，albacore tuna“长鳍金枪鱼”和 albacore fishing“长鳍金枪鱼捕捞”是名词组合。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, albacore is a borrowing without a productive English root-and-affix breakdown; it should not be divided into alba + core. The fish noun has the plurals albacore and albacores, while the food sense is normally uncountable; there are no common derivatives, and albacore tuna and albacore fishing are noun combinations.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: longfin tuna“长鳍金枪鱼”是突出长胸鳍特征的别名；white tuna“白肉金枪鱼”常用于食品语境，但该名称的使用并不总是明确。tuna“金枪鱼”是上位词，涵盖长鳍金枪鱼及其他多种金枪鱼。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Longfin tuna is an alternative name highlighting the long pectoral fins; white tuna is common in food contexts, although the label is not always unambiguous. Tuna is the broader term covering albacore and several other species.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用特征记整词：长长胸鳍的金枪鱼，就是 albacore。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the whole word through its defining feature: albacore is the tuna with long pectoral fins.

etymology.text: 经中古拉丁语借自阿拉伯语 al-dabarān，后来固定用来命名这颗亮星。把名字与金牛座“眼睛”处的红色亮星联系起来，比按英文字母拆解更好记。

usage_note: Aldebaran 是一颗恒星，Taurus 是金牛座；看到红色亮星的描写时，仍需区分恒星名称与星座名称。 专名或名称在本课保留首字母大写。

etymology_story.zh: 经中古拉丁语借自阿拉伯语 al-dabarān，传统上解释为“跟随者”，因为毕宿五及附近的毕星团在天空中跟随昴星团运行。这种解释可能是后起的，名称的更早来源仍不确定。[词源依据：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Aldebaran)
etymology_story.en: Borrowed through Medieval Latin from Arabic al-dabarān, traditionally interpreted as “the follower” because the star and nearby Hyades follow the Pleiades across the sky. This interpretation may be secondary, and the name's earlier origin remains uncertain. [Etymology: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Aldebaran)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再作常用词素拆分的借入专名：Aldebaran。al- 属于阿拉伯语原名，不是英语前缀；没有常用的英语派生词族。Aldebaran's 是所有格形式，Aldebaran observations（毕宿五观测）是名词短语，均非派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Aldebaran is a borrowed proper name without a productive root-and-affix breakdown. Its initial al- belongs to the Arabic source, rather than being an English prefix; it has no common English derivative family. Aldebaran's is a possessive form, and Aldebaran observations is a noun phrase rather than a derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Alpha Tauri（金牛座α星）和 α Tauri（金牛座α星）是同一颗恒星的拜耳命名写法，并非两个不同近义词；the Bull's Eye（公牛之眼）是形象化称呼。Aldebaran 是传统星名，Alpha Tauri 是天文学编号名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Alpha Tauri and α Tauri are two written forms of the same Bayer designation, rather than separate synonyms; the Bull's Eye is a descriptive nickname. Aldebaran is the traditional star name, while Alpha Tauri is its astronomical designation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 传统记忆锚点：“跟着昴星团走的红色牛眼”；这是名称的传统解释，不是确定无疑的最早词源。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Traditional memory hook: “the red bull's eye following the Pleiades”; this reflects the traditional explanation, rather than a certain ultimate etymology.

etymology.text: 来自拉丁语 delphinus“海豚”，更早来自希腊语 delphis。天空中的这个星座沿用了海豚的拉丁名称，记成“游进星空的海豚”。

etymology_story.en: The name comes from Latin delphinus, meaning “dolphin,” ultimately from Greek delphis, with the stem delphin-. The animal's name became the constellation's name, preserving its traditional dolphin figure. [Etymology: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Delphinus)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中整体记作借入专名 Delphinus，无能产的英语词缀拆分；-us 是拉丁语形式的一部分。天文学沿用拉丁语属格 Delphini，见 Alpha Delphini（海豚座α星），不是英语复数。dolphin（海豚）是同源相关词，并非由这个星座名派生；没有常用的英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats Delphinus as a complete borrowed proper name without productive English affixes; -us belongs to its Latin form. Astronomy retains the Latin genitive Delphini, as in Alpha Delphini, rather than using it as an English plural. Dolphin is an etymologically related word, not a derivative of the constellation name; there is no common English derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: the Dolphin（海豚座）是传统英文别称，the Dolphin constellation（海豚星座）是明确的描述性表达；小写 dolphin 通常指海豚这种动物，不能在普通语境中直接替换 Delphinus。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The Dolphin is the traditional English alternative name, and the Dolphin constellation is an explicit descriptive equivalent. Lowercase dolphin normally denotes the animal and does not freely replace Delphinus in ordinary contexts.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把与 dolphin 同源的名字连成图像：一只海豚游进北天。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the name with its relative dolphin: picture a dolphin swimming into the northern sky.

etymology_story.zh: 经拉丁语借自希腊人名 Kassiopeia，指希腊神话中的一位王后。她的名字也被用于星座，把神话人物与仙后座联系起来。[词源与义项依据：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Cassiopeia)
etymology_story.en: Borrowed through Latin from the Greek personal name Kassiopeia, it names a queen in Greek mythology. Her name was also applied to a constellation, connecting the mythological figure with Cassiopeia in the sky. [Etymology and senses: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Cassiopeia)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以完整专名 Cassiopeia 记忆，不把名称内部字母硬拆成英语词根。派生形容词 Cassiopeian（卡西奥佩娅的；仙后座的）可分析为 Cassiopeia + -n，但使用较少；天文学中的 Cassiopeiae 是拉丁语属格，见 Alpha Cassiopeiae（仙后座α星），不是英语复数。[词形依据：柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/cassiopeia)
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Cassiopeia is a complete proper name rather than a sequence of productive English roots. The uncommon adjective Cassiopeian, meaning “relating to Cassiopeia,” can be analyzed as Cassiopeia + -n; astronomical Cassiopeiae is the Latin genitive, as in Alpha Cassiopeiae, rather than an English plural. [Word forms: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/cassiopeia)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Queen Cassiopeia（卡西奥佩娅王后）明确指神话人物，the Queen（仙后座）在星座语境中是英文别称，the constellation Cassiopeia（仙后座）则明确指天区。三者依语境对应，不能把王后与星座当作同一个义项随意替换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Queen Cassiopeia explicitly identifies the mythological person, the Queen is an alternative name in constellation contexts, and the constellation Cassiopeia explicitly identifies the sky region. These expressions depend on context because the queen and the constellation are distinct senses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 王后升上星空，留下一个W形王冠：人物是卡西奥佩娅，星座是仙后座。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the queen in the sky wearing a W-shaped crown: Cassiopeia names both the queen and her constellation.

meaning: 瘦弱的；体弱的（美国方言）
aliases: 瘦弱的；体弱的（美国方言）

pronunciation.note: 依据韦氏完整重拼标音转写为 IPA，采用所列首个读法。

forms: 形容词，无动词时态变化；需要比较时可用 more / most pindling。
family: spindling 细弱的（可能的词源关联形式）。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。pindling + plant → pindling plant（瘦弱的植物）；-ling 在这里不另作现代英语后缀硬拆。

etymology.text: 韦氏词典认为它可能是英语 spindling 的变体，保留了细弱、长得不壮实的感觉。联想一株细细弱弱的幼苗即可，不把可能的来源说成确定的词根。

usage_note: pindling 的这一义项强调体弱、不壮实，不只是尺寸小；small 只说明大小，并不一定说明虚弱。 美国方言形容词；不误认作人名。

senses.meaning_zh: 瘦小体弱的；发育不良的（美国方言，现较少用）
senses.meaning_en: small, weak, or poorly developed; dialectal and now uncommon
senses.english_definition: A person, animal, or plant that is pindling is small and weak or has not grown well.
senses.collocation_en: a pindling child; a pindling plant
senses.collocation_zh: 瘦小体弱的孩子；长势瘦弱的植物

senses.sentence_zh: 农场主说那是一头瘦弱的小牛，因为它比其他小牛小得多，也弱得多。

senses.meaning_zh: 易烦躁的；爱闹脾气的（英格兰西部方言，罕用）
senses.meaning_en: peevish or fretful; a rare dialectal use associated with western England
senses.english_definition: Someone who is pindling in this dialectal sense is easily annoyed and inclined to complain.
senses.collocation_en: a pindling child
senses.collocation_zh: 爱闹脾气的孩子
senses.sentence_en: In her local dialect, she described a child who kept complaining as pindling.
senses.sentence_zh: 她用当地方言把一个不停抱怨的孩子形容为 pindling，也就是爱闹脾气。

etymology_story.zh: 词源尚不确定；韦氏词典认为它可能由 spindling“细长而瘦弱的”变形而来。这种联系可帮助理解“瘦弱”义，但不能把它当作已经确定的历史构词公式。[词源依据：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pindling)
etymology_story.en: Its origin is uncertain; Merriam-Webster suggests that it may be an alteration of spindling, meaning slender and weak. This possible connection helps explain the physical sense but does not establish a certain historical formation. [Etymology: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pindling)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜整体分析为形容词 pindling，不强拆为 pind + -ling，也不因词尾像 -ing 就判作常用动词分词。没有常用的现代派生词族；需要比较时可用 more pindling、most pindling。spindling 和 spindly（细长瘦弱的）可作词源与语义联想，但不是由 pindling 派生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, treat pindling as a whole adjective rather than forcing a pind + -ling analysis or classifying it as a common verbal participle because of its ending. It has no common modern derivative family; comparison can use more pindling and most pindling when needed. Spindling and spindly provide possible historical and semantic associations, but neither derives from pindling.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 体貌义近义词：puny（弱小的）强调个头小、力量不足，frail（体弱的）强调身体脆弱，spindly（细长瘦弱的）强调细长形态。情绪义近义词：peevish（易恼怒的）强调小事惹怒，fretful（烦躁不安的）强调持续不安或抱怨。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the physical sense, puny emphasizes small size and insufficient strength, frail emphasizes physical vulnerability, and spindly emphasizes a thin, elongated shape. For the emotional sense, peevish suggests irritation over minor matters, while fretful suggests continuing unease or complaint.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 先联想 spindly 的细弱幼苗记住主要义“瘦弱”；另把“爱闹脾气”作为独立方言义记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use a spindly seedling to remember the main meaning “small and weak”; learn “peevish” separately as a dialectal sense.

pronunciation.note: 依据韦氏完整重拼标音转写为 IPA，采用所列首个读法。

forms: 星座专名首字母大写；Centauri 为拉丁属格，用于 Alpha Centauri 等恒星名称，不是普通复数。
family: Centauri 拉丁属格形式，见 Alpha Centauri（半人马座α星）。

morphology.text: 整词作为外来借词独立词素记忆。Centaurus + constellation → Centaurus constellation（半人马座）；名称的 -us 不是现代英语后缀。

etymology.text: 沿用拉丁语名称 Centaurus，即半人马之名，后来成为南天星座名。把神话中的半人马形象放到星空里，帮助记住这个名称。

usage_note: Centaurus 指整个星座；Alpha Centauri 指其中的恒星系统，两个名称的范围不同。 专名或名称在本课保留首字母大写。

etymology_story.zh: 英语沿用拉丁语星座名 Centaurus，字面指神话中的“半人马”。这个动物形象成为南天星座的传统名称，连接了神话形象与天区名称。[词源与名称依据：韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Centaurus)
etymology_story.en: English retains the Latin constellation name Centaurus, literally referring to the mythological centaur. The creature became the traditional figure and name of a southern constellation, connecting mythology with a region of the sky. [Etymology and name: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Centaurus)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为整体借入的专名 Centaurus，-us 不是能产的英语后缀。拉丁语属格 Centauri 用于 Alpha Centauri（半人马座α星）等名称，不是英语复数。相关普通名词是 centaur（半人马），其英语复数为 centaurs；它与星座名具有共同历史来源，不是由 Centaurus 新派生而来。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats Centaurus as a complete borrowed proper name; -us is not a productive English suffix. The Latin genitive Centauri occurs in names such as Alpha Centauri and is not an English plural. The related common noun is centaur, with the English plural centaurs; it shares the name's historical source rather than being newly derived from Centaurus.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: the Centaur（半人马座）是传统英文别称，the Centaur constellation（半人马星座）是明确的描述性表达；小写 centaur 指神话生物。Alpha Centauri（半人马座α星）指该星座内的恒星系统，不是整个星座的近义名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The Centaur is the traditional English alternative name, and the Centaur constellation is an explicit descriptive equivalent; lowercase centaur denotes the mythological creature. Alpha Centauri names a star system within the constellation, rather than being another name for the entire constellation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: centaur 是半人马；把这匹半人半马的神话生物放上南天，就是 Centaurus。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect Centaurus with centaur: place the half-human, half-horse creature in the southern sky.

senses.meaning_zh: 大雨伞，尤指笨重的旧伞（英国旧式非正式用语）
senses.meaning_en: A large umbrella, especially an old, cumbersome one; dated British informal usage.
senses.english_definition: A gamp is a large umbrella, especially an old-fashioned one that is awkward to carry.
senses.collocation_en: an old gamp; a large gamp

etymology_story.zh: 源自狄更斯小说《马丁·翟述伟》中的护士萨拉·甘普（Sarah Gamp），她随身携带的大伞是其标志性物件。人物姓氏后来转指这种雨伞，属于专名普通名词化，并非一般意义上的外来借词。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Sarah Gamp, the nurse in Dickens's Martin Chuzzlewit, whose large umbrella is one of her identifying possessions. Her surname became a common noun for such an umbrella, making this an eponym rather than an ordinary foreign borrowing.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再作常规构词切分的单纯词：gamp；复数为 gamps。它由专名 Gamp 转化而来，没有常用的派生词族；gamp handle（大雨伞的伞柄）是名词组合，不是派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, gamp is a simple base without a productive internal breakdown; its plural is gamps. It developed from the proper name Gamp and has no common derivational family; gamp handle is a noun combination, not a derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: umbrella（雨伞）是中性通称；brolly（雨伞）是英国非正式说法；parasol（阳伞）主要用于遮阳。gamp 带有旧式色彩，常让人联想到笨重的大伞。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Umbrella is the neutral general term; brolly is informal British English; parasol usually means an umbrella used for shade. Gamp is dated and typically suggests a large, cumbersome umbrella.

etymology_story.zh: 词源尚不确定，可能是 grub 的变体，因而可与小动物钻蛀的形象联系起来。这个词实际指海生甲壳动物，不能因其可能的词源就把它解释成昆虫幼虫。
etymology_story.en: The origin is uncertain, but gribble may be an alteration of grub, suggesting a small boring creature. Despite that possible connection, a gribble is a marine crustacean, not an insect larva.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词分析为单纯词 gribble，复数 gribbles；没有可靠依据把它拆成某个词根与后缀 -le。没有常用派生词族；gribble damage（蛀木水虱造成的损害）和 gribble infestation（蛀木水虱侵害）属于名词组合。
morphology_enriched.en: Gribble is a simple modern base, with the plural gribbles; there is no secure basis for analyzing its ending as a separate suffix -le. It has no common derivational family; gribble damage and gribble infestation are noun combinations.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: wood-boring isopod（蛀木等足类动物）是描述性近义表达；marine wood-borer（海生蛀木动物）范围更广；shipworm（船蛆）也蛀蚀海中木材，但属于软体动物，并不是 gribble。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Wood-boring isopod is a close descriptive equivalent; marine wood-borer is broader. Shipworm names another animal that damages submerged timber, but it is a mollusc rather than a gribble.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住“小甲壳动物在海中木桩里钻隧道”；与 grub 的联系仅作辅助联想。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a tiny crustacean tunnelling through a submerged wooden pile; use the resemblance to grub only as a memory aid.

etymology_story.zh: 源自希伯来语人名 Bārūkh，意为“蒙福的”，《圣经》中的名字经希腊语和拉丁语传统传入英语。《巴录书》的名称来自与该书传统上相关联的巴录，并不意味着其历史作者身份已获证实。
etymology_story.en: The name comes from Hebrew Bārūkh, meaning 'blessed,' and entered English biblical usage through Greek and Latin traditions. The Book of Baruch takes its name from its traditional association with Baruch, rather than from an established historical authorship.

morphology_enriched.zh: 在现代英语中，Baruch 是不可再作常规词缀分析的完整专名，没有常用派生词族。希伯来语原名与表示“祝福”的词根 b-r-k 有关，但这不是英语构词拆分；Book of Baruch（《巴录书》）是书名短语。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Baruch is an unanalyzed proper name with no common derivational family. Its Hebrew source is related to the root b-r-k, associated with blessing, but that is not an English morphological breakdown; Book of Baruch is a title phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 专名没有通常意义上的近义词：Book of Baruch（《巴录书》）明确指书卷；Baruch the scribe（书记巴录）明确指人物；Bārūkh 是希伯来语原名的转写形式。这些表达不能在所有语境中互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Proper names do not have ordinary synonyms: Book of Baruch explicitly identifies the book; Baruch the scribe identifies the biblical person; Bārūkh transliterates the Hebrew name. These expressions are not interchangeable in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “蒙福的”是名字本义；先记巴录这个人，再联系以他命名的书卷。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with the name meaning 'blessed,' then connect Baruch the person with the biblical book bearing his name.

etymology_story.zh: 烹饪义经中古法语 coleïs 等形式进入中古英语，与表示“过滤”的 coler 有关，最终可追溯到拉丁语 colare。其历史意象是把烹煮所得的液体过滤，制成浓汤或烹饪用汁。
etymology_story.en: The culinary word entered Middle English through forms such as Middle French coleïs, related to coler, 'to strain,' ultimately from Latin colare. Its historical image is that of straining a cooked liquid to produce a rich broth or cooking preparation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 cullis 是整体借入的单纯词，不能分析为 cull + -is；复数为 cullises，没有常用派生词族。coulis（果蔬等制成的滤汁或酱汁）是相关的法语借词，不是由现代英语 cullis 加词缀派生而成。
morphology_enriched.en: Cullis is an unanalyzed borrowing in modern English, not cull plus -is; its plural is cullises, and it has no common derivational family. Coulis, a strained fruit or vegetable sauce or purée, is a related French borrowing rather than an English derivative of cullis.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: broth（肉汤、清汤）是较宽泛的可食用汤汁；stock（高汤）主要指烹饪底汤；gutter（檐沟、排水沟）对应建筑义。cullis 的烹饪义较旧，通常强调浓郁并经过滤的肉汤。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Broth is a broader term for a liquid food; stock usually refers to a cooking base; gutter corresponds to the architectural sense. Culinary cullis is historical and typically suggests a rich, strained meat preparation.

etymology.text: 经拉丁语传入，名称追溯到希腊地名 Kyrēnē（昔兰尼），即哲学家阿里斯提卜的家乡。用“地名成为学派名”串联记忆。

etymology_story.zh: 经拉丁语 Cyrenaicus 追溯至希腊语 Kyrēnaikos，意为“昔兰尼的”，源自地名 Kyrēnē。由于学派创始人物阿里斯提卜来自昔兰尼，这个地名形容词又成为学派及其成员的名称。
etymology_story.en: The word comes through Latin Cyrenaicus from Greek Kyrēnaikos, 'of Cyrene,' derived from the place name Kyrēnē. Because Aristippus, the school's founding figure, came from Cyrene, the geographical adjective also became a name for the philosophical school and its followers.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可作词族分析：Cyrene（昔兰尼）→ Cyrenaic（昔兰尼的；昔兰尼学派的），使用古典地名词干及形容词结尾 -aic；它不是可任意套用的现代规则变化。Cyrenaic 也可作名词，复数为 Cyrenaics；相关派生词 Cyrenaicism 指昔兰尼学派的学说。
morphology_enriched.en: The word-family relationship is Cyrene → Cyrenaic, using a classical place-name stem and the adjectival ending -aic; this is a learned formation rather than a freely productive modern pattern. Cyrenaic also functions as a noun, with the plural Cyrenaics; the related derivative Cyrenaicism names the school's doctrine.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hedonist（享乐主义者）范围更广；Epicurean（伊壁鸠鲁学派成员）属于另一学派，重视审慎选择快乐以及免除痛苦和烦扰；Cyrenean（昔兰尼的）可对应地理义，但不必包含昔兰尼学派的哲学含义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hedonist is broader than Cyrenaic. Epicurean identifies a different school that emphasizes prudent choices and freedom from pain and disturbance; Cyrenean can express the geographical meaning without necessarily referring to the philosophical school.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 昔兰尼这座城 → 来自此城的阿里斯提卜 → 重视当下快乐的昔兰尼学派。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the city of Cyrene with Aristippus, then connect his school with its emphasis on present pleasure.

senses.meaning_zh: 哇；好家伙（表示惊讶或赞叹，非正式用语）
senses.meaning_en: An informal exclamation of surprise or admiration.
senses.english_definition: You say 'zowie' when something surprises or impresses you, especially something sudden or fast.
senses.chinese_definition: 当某事使你惊讶或赞叹时，尤其是突然发生或速度很快的事情，你可以用 zowie 表达感受。
senses.collocation_en: Typical exclamatory patterns rather than fixed collocations: 'Zowie! Look at that!'; 'Zowie! That was fast!'
senses.collocation_zh: 常见感叹句式，而非固定搭配：“哇！快看那个！”；“好家伙！真快！”
senses.sentence_en: Zowie! That car went past in a flash!
senses.sentence_zh: 好家伙！那辆车一眨眼就开过去了！

etymology_story.zh: zowie 是模仿疾驶车辆声音形成的感叹词，最早见于1902年的英语记录，表达面对突如其来或令人赞叹的事物时的惊叹。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/zowie)
etymology_story.en: Zowie arose as an imitation of a speeding vehicle's sound and is recorded in English from 1902, expressing astonishment or admiration at something striking or sudden. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/zowie)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：zowie 为不可再作有效词根、词缀拆分的拟声感叹词；结尾 -ie 在这里不表示小称。无常用屈折形式，也无稳定的常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: zowie is a single imitative interjection with no productive root-and-affix analysis; its ending -ie is not a diminutive suffix here. It has no usual inflections or established common derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: wow（哇）用途最广，可表示惊讶或赞叹；gee（哎呀）通常较温和；gosh（天哪）常表示吃惊。zowie 的语气更夸张、活泼，带有漫画式或略显老派的色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Wow expresses surprise or admiration most broadly; gee is usually milder; gosh often expresses startled surprise. Zowie sounds more exuberant, comic-book-like, and somewhat old-fashioned.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 车子呼啸而过，嘴里脱口而出 zowie——“哇，真快！”
mnemonic_anchor.en: A vehicle zooms past, and out comes zowie: 'Wow, that was fast!'

senses.meaning_zh: 制帽用的光滑亮面纸草，传统上以涂虫胶的米纸制成
senses.meaning_en: Smooth, shiny artificial straw traditionally made from shellacked rice paper for hats.
senses.english_definition: Toyo is a smooth, shiny material made from paper to resemble straw and used especially for making hats.
senses.chinese_definition: toyo 是一种用纸制成、外观类似草料的光滑亮面材料，尤其用于制作帽子。
senses.collocation_en: Typical specialist combinations: toyo straw; a toyo hat.
senses.collocation_zh: 典型专业搭配：亮面纸草；亮面纸草帽。
senses.sentence_en: The milliner used toyo to make a lightweight summer hat.
senses.sentence_zh: 制帽师用亮面纸草做了一顶轻便的夏帽。

etymology_story.zh: toyo 从日语借入英语，作为材料名称，指主要在日本以涂虫胶的米纸制成的亮面仿草料，并用于制帽。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/toyo)
etymology_story.en: Toyo entered English from Japanese as the name of a shiny straw substitute, made chiefly in Japan from shellacked rice paper and used in hatmaking. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/toyo)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：toyo 是整体借入的单纯名词，不按英语词根、词缀拆分；材料义通常不可数。常见组合有 toyo straw（亮面纸草）、toyo hat（亮面纸草帽）；其中 toyo 是名词作定语，无须另立形容词词性。无常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: toyo is an unanalyzed loan noun, normally uncountable in its material sense. Combinations include toyo straw and toyo hat; toyo functions as a noun modifier, without requiring a separate adjective entry. It has no established common derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: paper straw（纸草）是较宽泛的近义名称；straw（草料、麦秆等）通常指天然植物材料；raffia（拉菲草纤维）来自棕榈叶。toyo 特指这一类纸制仿草材料，三者并非完全等同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Paper straw is the closest broader term; straw usually denotes natural plant material; raffia is fiber from palm leaves. Toyo specifically names this paper-based straw substitute, so these terms are not exact equivalents.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 纸变草，草成帽：toyo 是制帽的纸草材料。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Paper becomes straw, then a hat: toyo is paper straw for hatmaking.

senses.meaning_zh: 小溪；小河沟（苏格兰用语）
senses.meaning_en: A small stream, in Scottish usage.
senses.english_definition: A burnie is a small stream, especially when described in Scottish speech or writing.
senses.chinese_definition: burnie 指一条小溪，尤见于苏格兰地区的口语或文字。
senses.collocation_en: Typical regional combinations: a wee burnie; a babbling burnie.
senses.collocation_zh: 典型地域搭配：一条小溪；一条潺潺流淌的小溪。

senses.meaning_zh: 鬓角；连鬓胡子（非正式用语，常用复数）
senses.meaning_en: A sideburn, informally, usually mentioned in the plural.
senses.english_definition: Burnies are the strips of hair that grow down the sides of a person's face in front of the ears.
senses.chinese_definition: burnies 指沿面部两侧、耳朵前方往下长的鬓角毛发。
senses.collocation_en: Typical informal combinations: long burnies; trim your burnies.
senses.collocation_zh: 典型非正式搭配：长鬓角；修剪鬓角。
senses.sentence_en: He asked the barber to trim his burnies.
senses.sentence_zh: 他请理发师修剪一下他的鬓角。

etymology_story.zh: “小溪”义由苏格兰语 burn（溪流）加小称后缀 -ie 构成，字面意思就是“小溪”。另有非正式的“鬓角”义，对应 sideburn，属于不同的词义来源。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/burnie)、[柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/burnie)
etymology_story.en: The stream sense combines Scottish burn, meaning 'stream,' with the diminutive suffix -ie, literally giving 'little stream.' A separate informal sense means 'sideburn' and belongs to a different lexical origin. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/burnie), [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/burnie)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：溪流义为 burn（溪流）+ -ie（小称后缀）→ burnie；复数 burnies。相关形式有 burn、burns（溪流及其复数）。鬓角义是 sideburn 的非正式变体，常用复数 burnies；相关词有 sideburn、sideburns。表示“溪流”的 burn 与表示“燃烧”的 burn 是不同词源的同形词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: in the stream sense, burn + diminutive -ie → burnie; plural burnies. Related forms are burn and burns. The facial-hair sense is an informal variant of sideburn, commonly plural burnies; related forms are sideburn and sideburns. Stream-denoting burn and fire-denoting burn are etymologically distinct homographs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: brook（小溪）是通用英语中较接近的小水流名称；stream（溪流）适用范围更广，不一定强调小；sideburn（鬓角）对应另一名词义，是比 burnie 更中性的常用说法。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Brook is a close general-English equivalent for a small watercourse; stream is broader and need not emphasize small size; sideburn corresponds to the separate facial-hair sense and is more neutral and widely used.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 溪流 burn 加“小小的” -ie，就是 burnie；复数若出现在理发场景，则想 sideburns（鬓角）。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A burn made little with -ie is a burnie; in a barber's chair, plural burnies points instead to sideburns.

senses.meaning_zh: 奇事；奇物；令人惊奇的事物（苏格兰用语）
senses.meaning_en: A strange or remarkable thing, in Scottish usage.
senses.english_definition: A ferlie is something unusual that makes people feel surprised or curious.
senses.chinese_definition: ferlie 指让人感到惊讶或好奇的不寻常事物。
senses.collocation_en: Traditional regional combinations: see ferlies; an unco ferlie.
senses.collocation_zh: 传统地域搭配：见识奇事；一件极不寻常的奇事。
senses.sentence_en: The old storyteller had a tale about every ferlie in the glen.
senses.sentence_zh: 那位老说书人对山谷里的每一件奇事都能讲出一个故事。

senses.meaning_zh: 惊奇；值得惊讶的事（苏格兰用语，常见于固定说法）
senses.meaning_en: Wonder or a cause for surprise, especially in Scottish expressions.
senses.english_definition: If something is 'nae ferlie,' it is no cause for surprise.
senses.chinese_definition: 如果某事是 nae ferlie，就表示它不足为奇。
senses.collocation_en: Traditional Scottish expressions: nae ferlie; sma' ferlie.
senses.collocation_zh: 传统苏格兰语表达：不足为奇；没什么好奇怪的。
senses.sentence_en: It's nae ferlie he's tired after walking all day.
senses.sentence_zh: 他走了一整天，累了也不足为奇。

senses.meaning_zh: 奇异的；令人惊奇的（苏格兰及文学用语）
senses.meaning_en: Strange or remarkable, in Scottish and literary usage.
senses.english_definition: Something ferlie is strange or remarkable enough to make you wonder.
senses.chinese_definition: ferlie 形容某事物十分奇异或不寻常，足以引人惊叹。
senses.collocation_en: Attested literary combinations: a ferlie spell; in a ferlie fashion.
senses.collocation_zh: 有文献例证的文学搭配：奇异的魔咒；以奇异的方式。
senses.sentence_en: In the tale, a ferlie spell protected the traveler.
senses.sentence_zh: 在这个故事里，一道奇异的魔咒保护着那位旅人。

senses.meaning_zh: 感到惊奇；惊叹（苏格兰用语，现已少用）
senses.meaning_en: To wonder or marvel, in now-uncommon Scottish usage.
senses.english_definition: If you ferlie at something, you feel surprised or amazed by it.
senses.chinese_definition: 如果你对某事 ferlie at，就表示你对此感到惊奇或惊叹。
senses.collocation_en: Traditional grammatical patterns: ferlie at something; ferlie that ...
senses.collocation_zh: 传统语法搭配：对某事感到惊奇；惊讶于……。
senses.sentence_en: The villagers ferlied at the strange machine.
senses.sentence_zh: 村民们对那台奇怪的机器感到惊奇。

etymology_story.zh: ferlie 经中古英语传下，源于古英语 fǣrlīc（突然的、意外的），后来发展出“奇异的”和“奇事”等意义。它是继承下来的日耳曼语词，而非现代外来借词。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ferlie)
etymology_story.en: Ferlie descends through Middle English from Old English fǣrlīc, meaning 'sudden' or 'unexpected,' and developed the meanings 'strange' and 'a wonder.' It is an inherited Germanic word rather than a modern foreign borrowing. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ferlie)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：ferlie 通常整体识记，不能把结尾机械分析为现代英语副词后缀；变体拼写为 ferly，名词复数为 ferlies。词族包含同形的名词、形容词和动词；以 ferly 拼写时，动词形式为 ferlies、ferlied、ferlying。另有历史或方言副词用法，但不属于现代常用词性。[柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/ferly)、[苏格兰语词典](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/ferlie)
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: treat ferlie as a whole stem, without mechanically identifying its ending as a modern adverb suffix. Ferly is a spelling variant; the noun plural is ferlies. Its family includes noun, adjective, and verb uses; with the spelling ferly, verb forms are ferlies, ferlied, and ferlying. Historical or dialectal adverbial use also exists, but is not a common modern POS. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/ferly), [Dictionaries of the Scots Language](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/ferlie)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: wonder（奇事；惊奇）可对应名词义，也可表示“感到疑惑或惊奇”；marvel（奇迹；惊叹）通常更强调赞叹；strange（奇怪的）对应形容词义，但不必包含赞赏。ferlie 带有鲜明的苏格兰地域或文学色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Wonder covers a remarkable thing or the feeling it produces; marvel usually suggests stronger admiration; strange matches the adjective sense without necessarily implying approval. Ferlie carries a distinctly Scottish or literary flavor.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “意料之外”引出“奇异”：奇异的事物叫 ferlie，见到它便会惊叹。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Unexpected becomes strange: a strange thing is a ferlie, and seeing it makes you marvel.

senses.chinese_definition: latakia 是一种香气浓郁的烟草，名称来自叙利亚港口拉塔基亚。
senses.collocation_en: Typical specialist combinations: Latakia tobacco; a Latakia blend.
senses.collocation_zh: 典型专业搭配：拉塔基亚烟草；含拉塔基亚烟草的混合烟草。
senses.sentence_en: The label identifies the tobacco as a Latakia blend.
senses.sentence_zh: 标签表明，这是一种含拉塔基亚烟草的混合烟草。

etymology_story.zh: latakia 得名于叙利亚港口 Latakia，英语中的烟草名称最早记录于1833年。这是地名转为商品名称的例子。[韦氏词典](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/latakia)
etymology_story.en: Latakia takes its name from the Syrian seaport of Latakia, with the English tobacco term recorded from 1833. It illustrates a place name becoming the name of a product. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/latakia)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：地名 Latakia → 烟草名 latakia／Latakia；作为烟草名称通常不可数，不作英语词根、词缀拆分。常见组合有 Latakia tobacco（拉塔基亚烟草）、Latakia blend（含拉塔基亚烟草的混合烟草）；前置修饰属于名词作定语，无须另立形容词。烟草义无常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: the place name Latakia becomes the tobacco noun latakia or Latakia. The tobacco noun is normally uncountable and has no productive English root-and-affix breakdown. Latakia tobacco and Latakia blend use it as a noun modifier, without requiring a separate adjective entry. The tobacco sense has no established common derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有常用的严格同义词。tobacco（烟草）是上位词；smoking tobacco（吸用烟草）按用途分类；pipe tobacco（斗烟）指供烟斗使用的烟草或配方，可能含有拉塔基亚烟草，但不与之等同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym. Tobacco is the general category; smoking tobacco classifies the material by use; pipe tobacco names tobacco or blends intended for pipes and may contain Latakia without being equivalent to it.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 港口名成为烟草名：Latakia 地名 → latakia 烟草。
mnemonic_anchor.en: The port lends its name to the product: Latakia the place → latakia the tobacco.

etymology_story.zh: roset 是流传于苏格兰语中的历史词形，通常解释为中古英语 rosine 的词尾替换形式，与现代英语 rosin 同源。其动词义由名词发展而来，表示涂抹松香。
etymology_story.en: Roset survives in Scots and is generally explained as a form of Middle English rosine with a substituted ending, sharing its history with modern English rosin. The noun also developed a verb meaning to apply rosin.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：roset 为不可再作常用词根和词缀分析的整体词；名词可通过零派生用作动词。它没有常用的现代派生词族；rosin（松香）和 resin（树脂）是词源相关词，并非由 roset 派生。该方言词没有可靠的统一 CEFR 定级或通行考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: roset is an unanalyzed base, with conversion from noun to verb. It has no common modern derivational family; rosin and resin are historically related words, not derivatives of roset. This dialect word has no reliably established general CEFR level or standard examination tags.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: rosin 指常用于琴弓等处的松香，是最贴近的标准英语对应词；resin 泛指树脂，范围更广；colophony 是松香的专业名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Rosin is the closest standard English equivalent, especially for the material used on bows; resin is the broader substance category; colophony is a technical name for rosin.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 roset 与 rosin 连起来记：琴弓擦松香，摩擦力就增强。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect roset with rosin: rub it on a bow to help the hair grip.

senses.meaning_en: A nymph in Greek mythology who was transformed into a spring.
senses.english_definition: Arethusa is a nymph in Greek mythology who was changed into a spring while escaping from the river god Alpheus.

etymology_story.zh: Arethusa 经拉丁语承自希腊语专名 Arethousa；神话中的仙女为躲避河神阿尔菲俄斯而化为清泉。这个神话名字后来也被用作兰科植物的属名。
etymology_story.en: Arethusa comes through Latin from the Greek name Arethousa, borne by the nymph who became a spring while escaping Alpheus. The mythological name was later adopted for a genus of orchids.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：Arethusa 是整体借入的希腊语专名，不能按现代英语拆成有生产力的词根和词缀。植物属名写作 Arethusa，普通植物名可写作 arethusa，复数为 arethusas；没有常用的现代派生词族。该专名及植物名称没有可靠的统一 CEFR 定级或通行考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: Arethusa is a borrowed Greek proper name without productive English roots or affixes. The genus is capitalized as Arethusa; the common plant noun may be written arethusa, with the plural arethusas. There is no common modern derivational family, and neither use has a reliably established general CEFR level or standard examination tags.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 神话义没有严格近义词：nymph（水泽仙女等自然女神）是上位词，naiad（水仙女）范围更具体；植物义中的 dragon's-mouth orchid（龙口兰）是 Arethusa bulbosa 的通名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The mythological name has no exact synonym: nymph is a broader category, and naiad specifically denotes a freshwater nymph. In the botanical sense, dragon's-mouth orchid is a common name for Arethusa bulbosa.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住“仙女化泉”的画面，再把同名兰花与湿地联系起来。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the nymph becoming a spring, then connect her namesake orchid with wet ground.

etymology_story.zh: balbriggan 得名于爱尔兰都柏林附近的巴尔布里根镇，该镇曾以袜类和针织品生产闻名。地名先成为织物名称，复数形式又可转指这种织物制成的内衣。
etymology_story.en: Balbriggan takes its name from the Irish town of Balbriggan near Dublin, historically known for hosiery and knitted goods. The place name became a fabric name, and its plural also came to denote underwear made from that fabric.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：地名 Balbriggan → 普通名词 balbriggan，属于地名转化形成的材料名；balbriggan + -s → balbriggans，可表示内衣。balbriggan underwear 中的 balbriggan 是名词作定语；没有常用的现代派生词族。该历史性纺织词没有可靠的统一 CEFR 定级或通行考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: the place name Balbriggan became the common material noun balbriggan; adding -s gives balbriggans, which can denote underwear. In balbriggan underwear, the fabric noun modifies another noun. There is no common modern derivational family, and this historical textile term has no reliably established general CEFR level or standard examination tags.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cotton jersey（棉质针织单面布）是相关织物名称，但不必与历史上的 balbriggan 完全相同；knitted cotton（针织棉布）范围更广；hosiery（袜类及相关贴身针织品）主要指制品类别，而非某一种布料。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cotton jersey is a related fabric term but is not necessarily identical to historical balbriggan; knitted cotton is broader; hosiery chiefly denotes a category of knitted garments rather than a particular fabric.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 小镇名变布名：Balbriggan 镇 → 针织布 → 针织内衣。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Town to textile to underwear: Balbriggan → balbriggan fabric → balbriggans.

senses.meaning_zh: 马蹄铁防滑凸齿；蹄铁跟部的防滑凸起
senses.meaning_en: A projecting part of a horseshoe that improves traction.
senses.english_definition: A calkin is a projection on a horseshoe, especially at the heel, that helps prevent a horse from slipping.
